chapters.title: Chapter 2301 An Absurd Theory(2)
paragraphs: The entire room fell silent after Xie Mey revealed to them that Kulas had fallen sick literally the day after their departure. In order to properly test his theory, Kulas made it so that even if he were to fall sick after Tian Yang had left, they wouldn't tell him.
"Can we even call this a coincidence anymore?" Ren Xia sighed out loud. "Now, we need to see if Kulas recovers after your return. If he does..."
Ren Xia didn't dare to finish her sentence due to how ridiculous it would make her sound.
Tian Yang was also perplexed by the situation. Why would Kulas fall sick the moment he left the palace? Was he somehow involved with Kulas' situation?
Thus, Tian Yang and Ren Xia began living within the palace once again, patiently waiting for any changes from Kulas.
One month... three months... half a year later.
Tian Yang and Ren Xia's jaws dropped with disbelief when Kulas suddenly appeared before them with a broad smile on his face, looking as healthy as ever.
"You..." Tian Yang opened his mouth but closed it almost immediately after finding himself speechless.
"I am pretty much convinced that you're the cure to my situation," Kulas declared with a serious face. "However..."
He turned to look at Ren Xia and continued, "That said, there's also a possibility that you might be the cause instead. After all, you are always with my brother."
Since Ren Xia followed Tian Yang wherever he went, there was a chance that Ren Xia might be the one who was helping him recover.
Thus, in order to rule out any possibility, Kulas asked Tian Yang to leave the palace again. However, this time, Ren Xia had to stay behind.
Although Ren Xia despised the idea of leaving Tian Yang after spending the last several thousand years by his side, she had no choice if she wanted this testing to be over with.
Tian Yang left the palace a few days later, while Ren Xia stayed behind.

"Even if one of us might be the reason you're recovering from your phenomenon, it won't solve anything unless we figure out the core issue of it," Ren Xia said to Kulas. "It's not like we can stay by your side for the rest of our lives, after all.
Kulas sighed, "I am well aware of that. However, it's a starting point."
Kulas and Ren Xia continued their conversation, mostly with Ren Xia asking about the situation between the Giant Race and the Three Pillars of Heaven.
However, halfway into their conversation, Kulas had a mood swing and attacked Ren Xia.
"Kulas, you son of a bitch... I knew I was right to remain alert even if you looked normal."
Ren Xia cursed at him after avoiding his surprise attack.
Fortunately, Ren Xia was also at the True Immortal Realm, and she had been cautious of Kulas since Tian Yang left.

Kulas continued to attack Ren Xia while exuding immense killing intent. His family, who were always on alert and ready to act, quickly arrived to assist her. This was Ren Xia's first time seeing Kulas during one of his mood swings, and what she witnessed left her baffled.
"You call this a mere 'mood swing'?" she muttered with a dumbfounded look on her face.
Kulas's appearance had visibly shifted, his skin flushing an unnatural crimson, like an overripe tomato.
"He looks possessed!" Ren Xia remarked as she worked with Kulas' family to subdue him.
"Hey! How do we calm him down?!" she asked.
"We can't do anything but wait!" Xie Mey replied. "Once he's in this state, he will go on a rampage until he falls unconscious."
"Damn it! And how long will this last?!" "It typically lasts for a few hours, but it could last as long as several days!"
A few hours later, Kulas suddenly stopped moving, and his red complexion began to return to normal. However, Kulas didn't fall unconscious as Xie Mey had said.
"What happened? I came back as soon as I got your message." A familiar voice suddenly resounded.

Standing by the door was Tian Yang, who purposefully didn't travel too far from the Giant's Continent and immediately returned upon receiving Ren Xia's message, as she had contacted him the moment Kulas attacked.

"This crazy son of a bitch attacked me in the middle of our conversation," Ren Xia said. "And seeing how he calmed down the moment you returned, I guess we can only accept his theory as reality. For some reason, you're keeping whatever phenomenon is causing him to rampage and turn sick at bay."
Kulas, who had returned to normal, first offered his apologies to Ren Xia for attacking her before speaking to Tian Yang.
"So, as long as you stay at the palace, I won't have any mood swings."

However, Tian Yang then said, "Have you forgotten about what happened during the incident with the Three Pillars of Heaven? I was still at the palace at that time. Yet, you still had a mood swing, even killing one of them."
"That's..." Kulas shook his head. "I cannot explain that."
At that time, Tian Yang was chatting with Jing Ruye and Sun Rouxi inside his room, which wasn't far away from the throne room.
"But if you're still not convinced, I am willing to do a few more tests," he then said.
Tian Yang sighed, "There's no need. Who knows what might happen if we keep triggering your mysterious illness?"
"A phenomenon that won't trigger if you are here, huh? I have never heard of anything this bizarre before." Chao Shuying, who was also there, said out loud.
"What if he's the reason our father is sick in the first place?"
Someone there suddenly uttered.
"Which bastard dares to utter such nonsense?" Kulas was the first to respond, and he glared in the direction from which the voice came, his gaze full of anger.
If looks could kill, he would be able to massacre an entire army with his current expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 2302 Four Thousand Years
paragraphs: The one who made the remark subconsciously trembled in fear and hid behind his mother after hearing Kulas' words and sensing his killing intent.
"Even if you're my own son, I won't tolerate such bullshit!" Kulas spoke as he started walking toward his son. "I won't kill you, but I also won't hesitate to disown you!"

Seeing this, Tian Yang quickly spoke, "Relax. He has a good reason to be suspicious of me. I would do the same if I were in his shoes. Save your energy for something more useful, like figuring out the cause of your illness. No, it cannot even be called an illness. It's more like a phenomenon at this point."
"By the way, what did you speak to the Three Pillars of Heaven about previously? Perhaps the subject had triggered your phenomenon." Ren Xiaa suddenly asked.
"Well, we talked about..." Kulas started his sentence but abruptly halted midway. "Now that I think about it, what did we talk about?"

He wore a pondering look on his face as he tried to recall what he spoke about with the Three Pillars of Heaven. Yet, no matter how hard he tried, he couldn't seem to remember anything prior to his mood swing.

It was extremely odd, considering that he typically only lost memories of the time he spent while affected by the phenomenon. This implied that the phenomenon might have begun the moment their conversation began, which is why he couldn't remember anything.
"So, what now?" Tian Yang asked. "Although I may be able to prevent the phenomenon from occurring by being near you, it doesn't fix the core issue at hand."
"Just preventing it is good enough for now," Kulas said. "Once I deal with the issue with the Three Pillars of Heaven, I will focus on finding a real cure."
He turned to look at Ren Xia and continued, "Sorry, but I will have to borrow your husband for some time."
She frowned and replied, "Why are you making it sound so weird? We'll just be living here like before."
"No, it won't be like before, especially since we are at war. But don't worry, I'll ensure your safety even at the cost of my life."
Tian Yang laughed, "Big words from someone who still hasn't defeated me once. We can protect ourselves, so focus on your own issues.

Thus, Tian Yang and Ren Xia returned to living within the palace. However, just as Kulas said, it was different from before. From the tense atmosphere to the constant alertness around him, it made Tian Yang feel as though he was still fighting the Immortal Clans, even though he was not involved in the war personally.
Time passed in a flash, and Kulas remained healthy for the next two hundred years, further proving that Tian Yang's presence kept his phenomenon at bay.
Then, another three hundred years passed.

It has been five hundred years since Tian Yang started staying at the palace, and Kulas hasn't had a single mood swing, putting his family at ease. Although his family no longer were suspicious of Tian Yang, they definitely still didn't like him. The reason? It was simply due to jealousy.
Forget about his own children; even his wives were envious of their relationship.
"Aren't you jealous of your husband's relationship with ours?" One of them suddenly asked Ren Xia when they crossed paths in the halls.
Ren Xia chucked, "Why would I be jealous? If anyone is jealous, it would be Kulas. If he were born a woman, he would've definitely fallen head over heels for Tian Yang."
"That's..."
Kulas' wife couldn't believe how bold and rude Ren Xia was towards Kulas. "You speak as if you are close to my husband. I thought you were just Senior Tian's partner?

"I wouldn't call us close, but we were once engaged with each other. Of course, it wasn't of our own free will but the result of our parents' selfishness. Because of that, we'd often argue. It's the exact opposite relationship he has with my husband."
After that conversation, Ren Xia began getting to know Kulas' wives who weren't Chao Shuying, as they'd start approaching her to complain about Kulas, and she found it highly entertaining.
As time continued to pass, the Three Pillars of Heaven's assault on the Giant Race became more frequent, with giants being attacked almost once a week.
But despite all that, the Giant Race remained unyielding. If anything, their power grew, fueled by their anger toward the Three Pillars of Heaven.

By now, two thousand years have passed since their war began. Although most of the world was still unaware of it, some of the more influential and powerful factions have started to realize it. While they didn't plan to join the war, they began preparing for the worst-case scenario.
As for the progression in cultivation, nobody has managed to break through past the True Immortal realm yet.
Then, another two thousand years passed.

It has been four thousand years since Kulas' last mood swing, and because it has been so long, Kulas has begun to believe he has been cured. However, the moment he started being hopeful, the phenomenon returned.

It happened on one sunny day, while Kulas was cultivating with one of his wives. In the midst of their cultivation, Kulas had a mood swing and gravely injured her, nearly killing her, had Tian Yang not arrived in time to stop him.
"Fuck! Why has it returned after so long?!" Tian Yang cursed as he witnessed Kulas' phenomenon with his own eyes for the first time.

"Hey! Wake the hell up!" Tian Yang fought Kulas with incredible difficulty. Since Kulas never stopped training, even increasing the amount he trained, he had almost caught up to Tian Yang. Not only that, but the phenomenon boosted his strength tremendously. Of course, the naked sight of Kulas, who was just cultivating with his wife, didn't help at all.
Fortunately, Ren Xia and the others came to assist him. However, even with help, Kulas was almost unstoppable, and their clash destroyed over half of the palace over the next several days.

chapters.title: Chapter 2303 Acting as Giant Emperor Kulas
paragraphs: When Kulas finally calmed down after days of rampaging, his appearance underwent another drastic transformation, turning from a massive, unstoppable giant to that of a sickly old man with one foot in his grave.
He'd gotten so weak that he could hardly speak, much less stand.
After Kulas collapsed, his family brought him to his room to rest.
"To think it would happen again right when we were beginning to feel hopeful that he'd fully recovered..."
His family sighed, looking defeated and depressed as they stood around the bed.
"So, what now?" Ren Xia asked Tian Yang.
Tian Yang clenched his fists, feeling a sense of helplessness wash over his entire being.

"We've tried countless things in the past four thousand years, but alas... In the end, we were unable to figure out anything about his illness. At this rate, I will have no choice but to head to the Holy Continent."

"That might not be a good idea," said Ren Xia. "And I am not saying this because I don't want you to go. I mean, I don't, but if you leave, there's a chance that Kulas' illness might worsen. You have suppressed his illness by being near him, and despite his current situation, you might still be suppressing it. If you suddenly leave... his illness will worsen, and that's the best scenario. Worst-case, he'll die."
Tian Yang found Ren Xia's words to be very logical. If he were still suppressing Kulas' illness even at this moment, that suppressed illness might go on a rampage the moment he leaves.
Although it wasn't definitive and merely a theory, it was an immense risk that Tian Yang didn't dare to take, as his sworn brother's life was on the line.

Unable to leave the palace, Tian Yang continued trying to solve the mystery behind Kulas' illness from within. Unfortunately, he was not a medical expert, so he mostly helped Chao Shuying as her assistant.
Several more years passed, but Kulas hasn't woken up from his slumber even once, even though he used to wake up once a year.

Kulas' coma left his family in a precarious position, especially with the war against the Three Pillars of Heaven still ongoing. Fortunately, the Giant Race was already accustomed to such conflicts and knew how to respond even without Kulas's direct command. Even so, the absence of their leader could not be ignored. If the Three Pillars of Heaven were to learn of this, they would undoubtedly launch a full-scale assault.
One day, Kulas' wives approached Tian Yang.
"Senior Tian... This may sound very sudden, but do you think you can act as the Giant Emperor for the time being?"
"What?" Tian Yang almost couldn't believe his ears.
"We heard from our husband that he acquired the Great Mammoth Body Refinement technique from you, so you should be able to transform your body."
"But why are you asking me? Your sons can do it without the technique." Tian Yang said.
"Yes, but you're the only one at the True Immortal realm. Although we could replicate his appearance, we cannot do the same with his cultivation, as it'll be easily discovered."

"We're not asking you to lead the Giant Race or fulfill the role of an emperor. We just need you to show up and meet visitors once in a while so the Three Pillars of Heaven won't realize that our husband is absent." "If they learn that our husband is bedridden, they will definitely attack the Giant Continent with full force. If that happens... we will all perish before our husband even wake up."
Hearing this, there was no way Tian Yang could refuse, so he agreed to pretend to be Kulas.
Thus, Tian Yang had a new routine in his life. Once every few months, he would disguise himself as Kulas to meet with people and wander the continent just to reveal his presence.

Of course, Kulas' family didn't leave Tian Yang alone and had Xie Mey, who was the most familiar with him, assist him during the meetings. They continued with this farce for several hundred years, and Tian Yang had gotten so good at pretending to be Kulas that even his family would sometimes mistake him for the real Kulas.
Because of his efforts, the Three Pillars of Heaven remained oblivious about Kulas' real condition. One day, one of Kulas' wives approached Tian Yang.
"Senior Tian... allow me to apologize in advance, but I have a request for you..."
"What is it?"

"Back when my husband was still healthy, he would regularly interact with us... embrace us," she said softly. "Now, with him like this, that's no longer possible. It's been hundreds of years since we've embraced anyone, and with the war and everything else, we're all stressed and pent up...
She hesitated before continuing, "...Do you think you could help us?"
Tian Yang couldn't believe what he was hearing.

"You... Are you really asking me to sleep with my sworn brother's wives while he is bedridden?" he responded with a deep frown on his face. "Leave. I will pretend this interaction never happened, but don't you dare bring this subject up again in the future."
The wife sighed. Although she had anticipated such a response, she was still disappointed.
After apologizing to Tian Yang again, she left with an embarrassed feeling around her.
"Unbelievable..." Tian Yang shook his head.
The following year, Chao Shuying suddenly approached Tian Yang with a panicked look.
"S-Senior Tian! This is an emergency!"
"What happened? Did the Three Pillars of Heaven attack again?" "No! It's even worse than that! Some of our children have begun to have mood swings!"
"What?!" Tian Yang exclaimed.
He immediately followed Chao Shuying to another room, where several of Kulas' children were being restrained after going on a rampage.
"Did this just happen?" Tian Yang asked.

"Well... about that..." Chao Shuying rubbed her eyes and sighed, revealing, "Honestly, they have been showing signs for the last several years. However, we weren't certain it was the same illness affecting our husband, so we decided to watch over them for the time being until we were certain."

It's been hundreds of years since we've embraced anyone, and with the war and everything else, we're all stressed and pent up...
She hesitated before continuing, "...Do you think you could help us?"
Tian Yang couldn't believe what he was hearing.
"You...
Are you really asking me to sleep with my sworn brother's wives while he is bedridden?" he responded with a deep frown on his face.
"Leave.
I will pretend this interaction never happened, but don't you dare bring this subject up again in the future."
The wife sighed.
Although she had anticipated such a response, she was still disappointed.
After apologizing to Tian Yang again, she left with an embarrassed feeling around her.
"Unbelievable..." Tian Yang shook his head.
The following year, Chao Shuying suddenly approached Tian Yang with a panicked look.
"S-Senior Tian!
This is an emergency!"
"What happened?
Did the Three Pillars of Heaven attack again?" "No!
It's even worse than that!
Some of our children have begun to have mood swings!"
"What?!" Tian Yang exclaimed.
He immediately followed Chao Shuying to another room, where several of Kulas' children were being restrained after going on a rampage.
"Did this just happen?" Tian Yang asked.
"Well... about that..." Chao Shuying rubbed her eyes and sighed, revealing, "Honestly, they have been showing signs for the last several years.
However, we weren't certain it was the same illness affecting our husband, so we decided to watch over them for the time being until we were certain."

chapters.title: Chapter 2304 A Shocking Discovery
paragraphs: "Even if you weren't certain, you should've told me about it!" Tian Yang spoke loudly.
"Sorry..." Seeing his expression, Chao Shuying could only apologize like a child who knew they'd done something wrong.
"So, does this mean the illness is contagious?" Ren Xia suddenly asked.
"We considered that at first, but we don't believe that is the case," Chao Shuying said. "If it were contagious, it would've affected all of us much earlier."
"If it's not contagious, then they got it through other methods, such as their bloodline." Ren Xia remarked before turning to Tian Yang, staring at him with a perplexed face.
"What is it?" he asked. "If you know something, tell me."

She sighed before speaking, "What if the illness is caused by the Great Mammoth Body Refinement technique? What if it contaminated his bloodline? I considered this before, but I quickly tossed that thought away because if that were the case, his children would also be affected by the illness. Since it was exclusive to Kulas at that time, I thought that wasn't the case. However, now that his children are also affected..."
Tian Yang and Chao Shuying's eyes widened at Ren Xia's speculation.
Although it sounded ridiculous, it was the most logical explanation.
"The Great Mammoth Body Refinement was something I acquired in Han Zexian's Tomb, and the possibility that it might be a corrupted technique never crossed my mind, but now..."

While countless cultivation techniques in the world function flawlessly, there also exist those that are fundamentally flawed or even harmful to their users. The most common among them are techniques that grant immense power with little apparent effort at first—only for the cultivator to suffer a violent death later, when the hidden flaws of the technique finally manifest.

Such techniques are exceedingly rare in the modern era due to advances in cultivation knowledge. However, in the Primordial Era, when the cultivation world was still in its infancy, they were far more common.

Tian Yang couldn't believe how naive and trusting he had been. Han Zexian was a mysterious individual, someone the world knew almost nothing about, so why had he trusted the man's cultivation techniques so completely, without even questioning them?
Yet Tian Yang was far from alone in this. Almost everyone who had ventured into Han Zexian's tomb had trusted its rewards without question.

Perhaps the merciless trials themselves were to blame, grinding away doubt. After all, who would believe that someone willing to design trials where failure meant death would leave behind a corrupted technique as a reward?
"There's only one way to confirm this speculation..." Tian Yang suddenly spoke. "I have to study the technique until I have full comprehension."
"It's too risky! What if it also affects you?!" Ren Xia rejected the idea.
Tian Yang smiled and said, "Relax, I am only studying it with the intent of increasing my comprehension. I am not actually going to train it."
Starting from that day, Tian Yang spent nearly all of his time studying the Great Mammoth Body Refinement technique.

Time continued to pass, and as Tian Yang's comprehension of the Great Mammoth Body Refinement technique eventually surpassed even Kulas' own understanding, more and more of Kulas' children started to fall sick.
"I thought it was just a coincidence at first, but there's no doubt that the illness is more likely to affect men than women," said Chao Shuying.
Over two hundred of Kulas' children had fallen ill at this point, but only three of them were female. "Any progress with the Great Mammoth Body Refinement technique?" she then asked Tian Yang.
He nodded and responded with confidence, "There is definitely something odd about the technique, and I am very close to understanding it."

More than two thousand years had passed since Kulas fell into a coma. The Giant Race's war with the Three Pillars of Heaven dragged on, its end nowhere in sight. However, as more and more of Kulas's children began to fall ill, it became inevitable that the Three Pillars of Heaven would realize something was wrong.

It wasn't only the Three Pillars of Heaven who sensed that something was wrong. The giant citizens of the continent also noticed the palace's growing absence of presence, not to mention the constant disturbances emanating from within.

Another two hundred years later, even giants with no direct relation to Kulas began to suffer from similar mood swings. And because these episodes occurred openly within the cities, it became virtually impossible to prevent the truth from spreading.
During their mood swings, giants would attack any visitors who entered the continent. As a result, people eventually stopped visiting altogether.
Seeing an opportunity, the Three Pillars of Heaven seized upon these incidents as a pretext to officially declare war on the Giant Race, branding them a threat to humanity.

"The Giant Race has finally revealed its fangs! They have always harbored ill intent toward humanity! We sensed that something was wrong long ago, but lacked the evidence—until now! There is a reason they abandoned their humanity to form their own race!"

With such words, the Three Pillars of Heaven spread their propaganda throughout the Divine Heaven, instantly turning the Giant Race against humans. A year after the Three Pillars of Heaven's official declaration of war, Tian Yang finally unraveled the mystery behind the Great Mammoth Body Refinement technique.
"T-This is... impossible!" Tian Yang was left in shock by the discovery.
"What did you discover?" Ren Xia asked him.
He gritted his teeth and replied, "There is another technique within the Great Mammoth Body Refinement technique..."
"What sort of technique?"
He looked at her and continued, "A communication technique."
"What?" Ren Xia raised her eyebrows in puzzlement.
However, Tian Yang shook his head and apologized, "Sorry, but this is all I can tell you for now, as it contains forbidden information that requires your longevity to understand."

With a resolute expression, Ren Xia responded, "You've kept it to yourself for long enough, my dear. Why don't you share some of that burden with me? Even if I have to sacrifice some of my longevity, I want to know."

chapters.title: Chapter 2305 Contacting the Outer God Again
paragraphs: After hearing Ren Xia's words, Tian Yang sighed before responding in a worried voice, "I had to sacrifice several million years of longevity to learn this information. If it weren't for the pills, I would've never been able to learn it."
"A few million years, huh?" Ren Xia muttered in a low voice.

She'd be lying if she said she wasn't worried about losing so many years of her longevity. However, as his partner, she didn't want Tian Yang to endure the burden alone. After pondering for a moment, she spoke, "I am willing to lose a few million years if it means I can finally walk beside you. Although we've been together for so long, it always feels like I am slightly trailing behind you."
"Ren Xia..."

"Please, let me be selfish... really selfish for once..." she glared at him with a pleading gaze. "Also, it'll give me more motivation to break through to the next realm if I suddenly lose a few million years of my lifespan, and I don't know how much longer I have left to live."

Although cultivators who entered the Immortal Realm are called Immortals and are said to have an unlimited lifespan, that was only a speculation. A defeated smile tugged at Tian Yang's lips as he spoke, "Fine, I'll tell you. However, I'll stop the moment I sense anything even slightly wrong. Hell, we don't even know if a cultivator at the True Immortal realm has that much longevity." He proceeded to reach for his spatial ring before retrieving Han Zexian's diary, something he kept even though he had memorized all of its content.
"This is Han Zexian's diary, something I found inside his cavern. Try not to be too shocked about what you read."
He handed the diary to her, his hand uncontrollably trembling slightly.
"Thank you..." Ren Xia accepted the diary and took a moment to mentally prepare herself.
Once she was prepared, she opened the diary and began reading it.
A few seconds later, she lifted her head to look at Tian Yang and asked, "How do I know if my longevity is being consumed? I don't feel any different."
"You don't?" Tian Yang raised his eyebrows, looking puzzled by her statement.
When he first read the diary, he felt fatigued the instant he did, even though he had been perfectly normal before.
He then explained to her about his own experience.
"Nope, I don't feel any different, much less fatigued." Ren Xia said. "Maybe I'll feel it after reading some more."
She immediately went back to the diary.

As she delved deeper into the contents of Han Zexian's diary, her eyes widened with shock and disbelief at the discovery of the Outer Gods' existence, incomprehensible beings with unfathomable strength who lived beyond their world.
While the diary dumbfounded Ren Xia, Tian Yang stared at her with an astonished look of his own. "How much have you read?" he suddenly asked her.
"I'm almost done with it," she calmly replied.
"And you still feel completely fine?"
"Yes," she nodded.

"How?! Is it because you are at the True Immortal realm, and a few million years is nothing but a drop in the bucket, hence why you don't even feel it being consumed?" he wondered out loud. "No... even if that's the case, there's no way you wouldn't feel that much lifespan being forcefully drained!"
"I don't know what to tell you." Ren Xia shrugged as she returned to finishing the last few sentences in the diary.
A few moments later, she closed the diary and placed it down.
"Outer Gods, huh? I am still trying to grasp my head around such an existence actually existing..." "They really exist. I personally spoke with one, after all."
"What?" Ren Xia looked at him with wide eyes.
"What were they like? What did you talk about?
Tian Yang recalled his meeting with the ten-armed Outer God to her.

"He said he'd grant me a wish. I asked for talent, but he said that I already had it, so he gave me something else. As for what the something is... I have no clue. He also said that we'd meet again, but it's been several thousand years since that meeting."
"Hey... are you sure you're feeling fine?" Tian Yang continued with a worried frown. "If you're trying to act tough so I wouldn't be worried, it's actually having the opposite effect."
Ren Xia chuckled and said, "I swear I am feeling fine. What about you? Are you sure you had to sacrifice your longevity to learn this information?"

Tian Yang nodded, "Of course. I even tested it on some people from the Immortal Clans before. When I gave them the diary to read, they would all scream in pain until they stopped. When I forced them to listen to it, they all died a violent death."
Ren Xia raised an eyebrow and asked, "What were you trying to achieve by doing that?"
"I wanted to test the limit of this information and its restrictions. Unfortunately, I didn't really learn anything."
"Well, I am completely fine even after reading the whole thing, so something might've changed."
"I guess so... but we should remain alert in case the effects are delayed."

"Anyway, let's get back on topic. The Great Mammoth Body Refinement technique had a communication technique hidden within it. While it differs from the one in Han Zexian's tomb, the similarities suggest it reaches out to an Outer God—just not the one I spoke with."
"Does that mean Kulas used this technique and contacted the Outer God?" "That's... possible. However, we won't know for sure until Kulas wakes up and we question him."
"I know this will sound insensitive, but will he even wake up? It's been thousands of years, you know?"
Tian Yang sighed, "I won't give up until his last breath." Suddenly, he thought of an idea.

"Wait a second. If an Outer God is involved with Kulas' situation, perhaps I can ask another Outer God for help? I still remember the communication technique, so it might be possible to call for him again."

chapters.title: Chapter 2306 Contacting the Outer God Again(2)
paragraphs: "You want to contact an Outer God? Are you sure that's... safe?" Ren Xia wore a worried frown on her face after hearing Tian Yang's words.
"It should be. Nothing happened last time, and he didn't seem annoyed by it. If anything, he's probably expecting me to contact him again," he replied.
"Be careful then..." Ren Xia left the room a moment later.
Once he was prepared, Tian Yang recited the communication technique.

"O ancient gods beyond the veil of reason, where time coils and the stars weep—heed my call! I invoke the Nameless, whose shadows consume light, whose whispers unravel fate! Through the fracture of all that is, through the silence where even Dao crumbles... descend and make this world your own!"
Nothing happened for a few seconds, but Tian Yang wasn't as impatient as last time.
After several minutes of waiting, he finally felt his consciousness being drawn out of his body and speeding into the heavens.
After what felt like an eternity, he was in the starry sky again, and hovering before him was a massive entity with ten arms, surrounded by an unfathomable aura.
"I knew you'd seek me again, but to think you'd do it so soon," said the Outer God.
"It's been several thousand years, though..."
Tian Yang wasn't as overwhelmed by the god's presence this time.
"I have lived for billions... trillions of years. A few mere thousand years is no different than yesterday."
"Trillions of years...?" Tian Yang was left speechless by its casual remark.
His world wasn't even a million years old, yet the god before him had lived trillions of years? As ridiculous as it sounded, he didn't doubt it.
"So, why have you contacted me this time, mortal?"
"I have a question—a favor of sorts. But first, if I am bothering you, you can send me away, and I won't bother you again.
"It's fine, I am not bothered. It's not like there's anything else for me to do. I left behind a method to contact me for a reason."
"In that case, may I ask for your help? I have this friend who..."
Tian Yang proceeded to tell the god about Kulas' situation and the communication technique hidden within the Great Mammoth Body Refinement technique.
"Have you tried contacting the being through the technique yet?" The Outer God asked.
"Of course not. If Kulas' situation was caused by that technique and Outer God, I don't want to get involved with them."
"Yet you didn't hesitate to contact me?"
"I was curious at that time, and I had put so much effort and sacrificed so much of my lifespan. With that said, you don't seem dangerous."
"That is a foolish thing to assume. Fortunately for you, I am unlike the others, who wouldn't hesitate to sacrifice your kind for their own entertainment."
"How many Outer Gods are out there? And why are they doing this? Is it just for entertainment?"
"I cannot answer your first question, as you lack the longevity to know. As for your second question, it is true for some, but now all of them are trying to be entertained."
"So if I want to learn about the Outer Gods, I need sufficient longevity? Does this apply to everyone?" Tian Yang asked.
"Yes, all beings in your world require sufficient sacrifice to learn about us."
"Then how come someone I know managed to learn about the Outer Gods' existence without any sacrifice? At least that's what she said."
"That is not possible," said the Outer God. "They have either already paid the sacrifice before, or they don't realize it."

'There's no way Ren Xia already knew of the Outer Gods based on her reaction after reading Han Zexian's diary. Does this mean she simply didn't realize her longevity was being sacrificed? Like how some people can't feel pain?' Tian Yang wondered inwardly.

"Let's get back on topic. About your friend's issue... it is definitely caused by another Eternal—what you call Outer Gods. However, there's nothing I can do to help unless I confront that Eternal directly."
"That's...
Tian Yang didn't even need to ask to know that this Eternal wouldn't go through the trouble for a mere mortal, so he didn't say anything.
However, the Eternal continued, "Even if I want to help you, I would need to know the identity of the one behind it."
"Huh? You're actually willing to help me?"
"Well, that will depend on whether you'll return the favor and the identity of the Eternal."
"What do you need from me?" Tian Yang asked.
He wasn't surprised to hear that the Eternal wanted something from him, almost as if he'd anticipated it somewhere in his consciousness.
'There's nothing that is truly free in this world, after all,' he sighed inwardly.
"I am looking for something. That is the most I can tell you right now, due to your lack of longevity."

"The only ways for me to extend my lifespan are through treasures or cultivation," Tian Yang said. "The amount of treasures required to gain enough longevity is simply unfeasible, leaving cultivation as the only option. But the entire cultivation world has been stalled at the True Immortal Realm for thousands of years, unable to advance further despite our awareness of Celestial Qi."
"I am aware of the situation in your world. Since I need you to improve your cultivation to achieve my own goals, I shall assist you with reaching the next realm."
"Really?!" Tian Yang was ecstatic to hear such words.
"I cannot directly improve your cultivation," the Outer God said. "So instead, I will show you what you need to ascend."
As one of its ten arms pointed at him, Tian Yang felt something click within his mind—a sudden, profound realization, almost as if he had an enlightenment.
"This will be all for now. If you want me to help your friend, learn the identity of the Eternal behind him. Until next time, mortal. Ah, one last thing before I send you away. You may call me..."
When Tian Yang came back to it inside his room, he muttered, "Shura, huh? I wanted to ask him about the gift he gave me, but I guess that will have to wait until next time."

"Have you tried contacting the being through the technique yet?" The Outer God asked.
"Of course not.
If Kulas' situation was caused by that technique and Outer God, I don't want to get involved with them."
"Yet you didn't hesitate to contact me?"
"I was curious at that time, and I had put so much effort and sacrificed so much of my lifespan.
With that said, you don't seem dangerous."
"That is a foolish thing to assume.
Fortunately for you, I am unlike the others, who wouldn't hesitate to sacrifice your kind for their own entertainment."
"How many Outer Gods are out there?
And why are they doing this?
Is it just for entertainment?"
"I cannot answer your first question, as you lack the longevity to know.
As for your second question, it is true for some, but now all of them are trying to be entertained."
"So if I want to learn about the Outer Gods, I need sufficient longevity?
Does this apply to everyone?" Tian Yang asked.
"Yes, all beings in your world require sufficient sacrifice to learn about us."
"Then how come someone I know managed to learn about the Outer Gods' existence without any sacrifice?
At least that's what she said."
"That is not possible," said the Outer God.
"They have either already paid the sacrifice before, or they don't realize it."
'There's no way Ren Xia already knew of the Outer Gods based on her reaction after reading Han Zexian's diary.
Does this mean she simply didn't realize her longevity was being sacrificed?
Like how some people can't feel pain?' Tian Yang wondered inwardly.
"Let's get back on topic.
About your friend's issue... it is definitely caused by another Eternal—what you call Outer Gods.
However, there's nothing I can do to help unless I confront that Eternal directly."
"That's...
Tian Yang didn't even need to ask to know that this Eternal wouldn't go through the trouble for a mere mortal, so he didn't say anything.
However, the Eternal continued, "Even if I want to help you, I would need to know the identity of the one behind it."
"Huh?
You're actually willing to help me?"
"Well, that will depend on whether you'll return the favor and the identity of the Eternal."
"What do you need from me?" Tian Yang asked.
He wasn't surprised to hear that the Eternal wanted something from him, almost as if he'd anticipated it somewhere in his consciousness.
'There's nothing that is truly free in this world, after all,' he sighed inwardly.
"I am looking for something.
That is the most I can tell you right now, due to your lack of longevity."
"The only ways for me to extend my lifespan are through treasures or cultivation," Tian Yang said.
"The amount of treasures required to gain enough longevity is simply unfeasible, leaving cultivation as the only option.
But the entire cultivation world has been stalled at the True Immortal Realm for thousands of years, unable to advance further despite our awareness of Celestial Qi."
"I am aware of the situation in your world.
Since I need you to improve your cultivation to achieve my own goals, I shall assist you with reaching the next realm."
"Really?!" Tian Yang was ecstatic to hear such words.
"I cannot directly improve your cultivation," the Outer God said.
"So instead, I will show you what you need to ascend."
As one of its ten arms pointed at him, Tian Yang felt something click within his mind—a sudden, profound realization, almost as if he had an enlightenment.
"This will be all for now.
If you want me to help your friend, learn the identity of the Eternal behind him.
Until next time, mortal.
Ah, one last thing before I send you away.
You may call me..."
When Tian Yang came back to it inside his room, he muttered, "Shura, huh?
I wanted to ask him about the gift he gave me, but I guess that will have to wait until next time."

chapters.title: Chapter 2307 Soul Cultivation
paragraphs: "I'm done. Did you wait long?"
After his meeting with Shura concluded, Tian Yang went outside and spoke with Ren Xia.
"Huh? Did you fail to contact the Outer God?" Ren Xia asked.
"No, I succeeded. What made you think that I'd failed?" he asked with a puzzled face.
"I have been out here for less than a minute," she replied.
"Really?" Tian Yang mumbled with a dumbfounded face.
While he didn't speak with Shura for long, it definitely lasted for several minutes, not to mention how long it felt for his consciousness to enter the starry sky just to meet Shura.
"Not only did I speak with the Outer God, but I even received help from him. I'll tell you more inside."
Ren Xia nodded and went back inside the room.
Once the doors closed, Tian Yang recalled his conversation with Shura.
"The beings we call Outer Gods call themselves Eternals, and they have existed for trillions of years."
"T-Trillions of years?!" Ren Xia exclaimed in shock.
It was simply an unimaginable amount of time for someone who has only lived a few measly thousands of years.

"Not only did he say he'd help with Kulas's situation—as long as I uncover the identity of the Eternal interfering with him—but he also showed me how to reach the next cultivation realm," Tian Yang said, unable to hide his excitement.
"Huh? How does that even work?" she asked.

"It's hard to put into words," he replied. "It was as if he fed the knowledge directly into me, almost like passing on a technique. It felt exactly like a moment of sudden realization... like enlightenment itself.
"So... are you going to break through to the next cultivation realm soon?" she then asked.

A bittersweet smile suddenly tugged at his lips, and he replied in a somewhat defeated voice, "Just because I know the path required to enter the next realm, it doesn't mean I'll be able to get there soon. As a matter of fact, even with this knowledge, I highly doubt I'll be able to break through in the next ten... fifty thousand years."
"Fifty thousand years?! That long?!" Ren Xia exclaimed with a bewildered face.

He nodded. "At least fifty thousand years, so it could take even longer. And it's only this short because the answers were given to me. If I had to figure this out by myself, it could've easily taken ten times as long."
"Why does it take that long? Is it because of our understanding of Celestial Qi?"
"That is only a small portion. After we reach a certain level of understanding, we must cultivate Celestial Qi and also our souls."
"What? Did you just say our... soul?" Ren Xia raised an eyebrow at his last word.

In that era, the concept of cultivating one's soul was still in its infancy. The soul was the most sensitive and vulnerable part of any being, so most were reluctant to tamper with it, leaving only madmen willing to attempt such cultivation.
Because the subject was so rarely explored, there were scarcely any soul cultivation techniques in existence. And even if such techniques were freely offered, few—if any—would dare to practice them.
"So... did the Outer—Eternal give you a cultivation technique to strength the soul?" she then asked.
Tian Yang shook his head.
"Unfortunately, he did not."

Ren Xia sighed, "Although it's great that we now know how to reach the next realm, it doesn't really help. Not only do we need to create a cultivation technique for Celestial Qi, but we also need to cultivate our soul."
"Oh." Tian Yang suddenly spoke, "While he didn't give me a soul cultivation technique, he did give me a cultivation technique to cultivate Celestial Qi."
"Really?!" Ren Xia's eyes shone with bright excitement.
Tian Yang smiled at her reaction and asked, "You want it, too? I thought you wanted to ascend to the next realm through your own efforts."

Ren Xia sighed and said, "This and trying to sense Celestial Qi are two different things. Even I must admit that I am not talented enough to create a cultivation technique for Celestial Qi with my own efforts—at least not for several million years."
"Alright, I'll share the technique with you... but not now. I need to examine it to make sure there's nothing wrong with it first," he said.

Despite what Shura said, there was no guarantee that he wouldn't try to mess with him, as the Great mammoth Body Refinement technique did. "It's good to be cautious, especially when we are dealing with beings that are still beyond our comprehension," Ren Xia nodded. "Be careful."
"In the meantime... I will leave the continent to look for a soul cultivation technique," she added.
"Are you sure?"
She nodded.
"Even if we have a cultivation technique for Celestial Qi, we still need one for our souls. Unfortunately, there's really nothing for me to do here to help Kulas, and I have been idling enough."
"I understand. When will you leave?"
"I'll leave in a few months."
"Alright."

Several months later, Ren Xia left Giant's Continent to search for a soul cultivation technique. Meanwhile, Tian Yang remained on the continent and started studying the cultivation technique without cultivating it. A hundred years passed in the blink of an eye, and Ren Xia returned to the palace.
"How was the search?" he asked.

"It was a waste of time," Ren Xia rested her body on Tian Yang's as she sighed out loud. "Although I found several soul cultivation techniques, they were all trash and had a high fatality rate. However, on my way back here, I heard of a certain rumor—that the Three Pillars of Heaven have recently developed a safe and powerful soul cultivation technique."
Tian Yang raised an eyebrow at this information.
"The Three Pillars of Heaven, huh? So they still have the time to create new techniques while in the middle of a war," he sighed.
"Honestly, I was thinking about going there to check things out, but I wanted to return first to get your opinion," Ren Xia suddenly said.

chapters.title: Chapter 2308 Auction for the Soul Cultivation Technique
paragraphs: "You want to visit the Holy Continent?" Tian Yang frowned at Ren Xia's words. "Even though you keep saying that you don't want me to go?"

"Well, we are not going there with the same objectives. You want to investigate the Three Pillars of Heaven while I am merely trying to learn more about their soul cultivation technique," she replied with a shrug.

Tian Yang sighed, "Now that I know that the Three Pillars of Heaven are not the ones behind Kulas' situation, I no longer have any reason to investigate them. If only they weren't at war with the Giant Race."
"Speaking of investigating... have you had any progress with figuring out the identity of the Eternal behind Kulas' illness?" Ren Xia then asked.
He sighed, "I have tried, but the Eternal isn't answering me."

He'd tried contacting the Eternal using the communication technique found within the Great Mammoth Body Refinement technique, but unlike Shura, this Eternal refused to meet him, no matter how long he waited. And not wanting to bother the Eternal too much, he decided to attempt to contact the Eternal once every thousand years. While that may seem like a long time, if he considered an Eternal's experience and how differently they sensed time, even a thousand years was short.

To an Eternal, the passage of a thousand years might be no different from a single day, making daily contact seem inconsequential. However, Tian Yang refused to take such a reckless risk, as provoking an Eternal was not something he was willing to gamble with.
"Anyway, even if you went to the Holy Continent, would they let you in? What's the point of going there if you cannot even get the soul cultivation technique?" Tian Yang then asked.
"Actually, they plan on selling the soul cultivation technique," Ren Xia revealed, leaving Tian Yang speechless.
"Why would they sell something so valuable?" he asked.
She shrugged.
"Who knows?"

"It's probably defective, then. Even to this day, they've kept the information about Celestial Qi a secret. If it were truly something that would benefit them, they wouldn't give it away. There's no way a safe soul cultivation technique wouldn't benefit them. And I highly doubt the Three Pillars of Heaven are in need of money."

"Well, we wouldn't know unless we have the technique in our hands," said Ren Xia. "There are not many people who are richer than us right now, especially after we raided the Immortal Clans' treasury. Kulas also said we can use their resources if we ever need to, so we're almost guaranteed to outbid everyone. It's not like we have any other use for our wealth.
After a moment of silence, Tian Yang sighed, "Do whatever you want."
"Then I'll go buy the soul cultivation technique. The auction won't start for another ten years, so I'll stay here until then."

Over the next several years, the auction for the soul cultivation technique spread like wildfire. The Three Pillars of Heaven guaranteed its safety, but even they couldn't completely eliminate the people's suspicions, who all had the same worry as Tian Yang.

If the soul cultivation technique was truly safe and revolutionary, why would the Three Pillars of Heaven, known for keeping things for themselves until they no longer needed them, sell off such a priceless technique so quickly after developing it? Something was amiss.
Of course, the Three Pillars of Heaven had a response for the growing doubt.

"This soul cultivation technique may be powerful and safe, but it has extremely harsh requirements, so not just anyone can cultivate it. In fact, no one else besides the creator has been able to cultivate it successfully, hence why we are parting with it. Moreover, the decision to sell this technique was also made by its creator."
Ten years passed in the blink of an eye, and Ren Xia left the Giant Continent to participate in the auction for the soul cultivation technique.

The auction ended up being the most successful and largest auction to date, which surprised nobody, as this was the Three Pillars of Heaven's first time doing such an event. Millions—tens of millions of cultivators and wealthy individuals participated in the auction.
Before the auction began, the Three Pillars of Heaven revealed half of the soul cultivation technique to everyone present, giving them a small taste.
"Heavens! What a powerful soul cultivation technique! And this is only half of the entire technique?!"

Even though only half of the technique was revealed, the experienced cultivators present were still able to gauge its power from that alone. The Three Pillars of Heaven were also unconcerned about anyone completing the remaining half, as the technique was extraordinarily complex. Unless someone possessed unfathomable talent, as well as the same mindset and experience as its creator, there was virtually no chance of finishing it.
When the auction officially began, the very first bid reached an astounding one hundred million spirit stones! It was an amount that instantly removed over two-thirds of the competition there.
However, that was just the beginning, as the very next bid was two hundred million, instantly doubling the previous bid.

Seeing how rapidly the price was climbing, everyone expected the auction to end quickly. After all, only a single item—the soul cultivation technique—was up for sale, and at this pace, it would be over in a matter of minutes. Many had traveled for months, even years, just to attend, and the prospect of it ending so abruptly left more than a few feeling dissatisfied.
However, to everyone's absolute surprise, the auction would go on for hours with two people directly going against each other. "One billion spirit stones," Ren Xia casually bid.
"One billion and one million spirit stones." Her opponent bid half a second later.
Although Ren Xia could easily increase the bid by tens of millions at once, she decided to mess with her opponent.
"One billion and two million spirit stones."
"One billion and three million spirit stones."
An hour later...
"Three billion, five million, and one hundred thousand spirit stones!"
"Three billion, five million, and two hundred thousand spirit stones!" Ren Xia countered.
Thus, the auction dragged on.

chapters.title: Chapter 2309 Auction for the Soul Cultivation Technique(2)
paragraphs: "Heavens! Who is that woman bidding against Senior Ru Bing, who is known as the Gold Emperor—the wealthiest individual in the world?!" "I don't recognize her, but she's definitely disguising her true appearance right now."

Ren Xia's wealth and relentless bidding against the Gold Emperor left every guest there in awe, especially those who were in the business scene and understood how astonishing it was to fight the Gold Emperor with money.
However, some people there doubted whether Ren Xia really had so much wealth.
"What if she's just bidding out of her ass just to increase the price of the soul cultivation technique?"
"In the presence of the Three Pillars of Heaven and so many people? There's no way anyone would be that foolish!"
Eventually, the bid reached an astonishing five billion spirit stones.
"Five billion, two hundred million, and one thousand spirit stones!" The Gold Emperor shouted with clenched fists.
"Five billion, two hundred million, and two thousand spirit stones." Ren Xia countered in a calm voice, sounding as if she were just ordering a simple dish at a restaurant.
'Fuck! I do not believe that bitch truly has so much money!' The Gold Emperor cursed inwardly.
"Going once..."
"Going twice..."
"And—"
"SEVEN BILLION!" The Gold Emperor countered at the very last second, increasing the price by two whole billion in one go.
"Seven billion spirit stones?!"

Everyone was stunned by the Gold Emperor's bid. Even as the richest individual in the world, such an amount would strain his finances for a very long time. And for what? A soul cultivation technique that even the geniuses of the Three Pillars of Heaven had failed to cultivate. It seemed nothing short of a reckless waste.

The Gold Emperor, of course, understood this better than anyone. But at this point, he was no longer bidding for the technique itself. This had become a matter of pride—and he refused to lose to some nobody.
After making his bid, the Gold Emperor stood up and glared at Ren Xia.
"I do not believe you can outbid me! Even if you do, I doubt you actually have that much money!" he shouted at her.
Before she could respond, he continued, "If you can beat me, I'll eat all of the jewelry on me before everyone today!
As the richest individual in the world, the Gold Emperor naturally enjoyed flaunting his wealth, his entire body adorned with expensive jewelry.
"Going once..."
Ren Xia calmly met the Gold Emperor's gaze and sneered, "I hope you didn't eat breakfast today, then."
"Going twice..."
"Ten billion spirit stones!" Ren Xia loudly declared.
The Gold Emperor's eyes widened with shock and disbelief at her counter.
"T-There's no way you can actually pay such an amount! Even if you do, you'll definitely become homeless afterward!" The Gold Emperor exclaimed.
"Going once!"
"Goince twice!"
"And... sold! To the young lady at seat 194,224 for ten billion spirit stones!" Unsurprisingly, the Gold Emperor did not try to compete with Ren Xia's ten billion, allowing her to win.
However, just because he lost the auction didn't mean he'd have to immediately eat his own jewelry, as Ren Xia still had to prove that she had won legitimately by paying the ten billion.
After winning the auction, Ren Xia stood up and said to the Gold Emperor, "You should prepare to follow through in your own words."
Then, she went to pay for the soul cultivation technique.
It took several minutes, but the auctioneer eventually finished counting Ren Xia's payment.
"I have confirmed the payment of ten billion spirit stones! Thank you! Here is your soul cultivation technique!"
The auctioneer immediately handed the technique to her.
"Heavens! She actually paid ten billion without batting an eye!
Once it was confirmed that Ren Xia had paid the amount, everyone at the auction turned to look at the Gold Emperor.
"...This is..."
The Gold Emperor swallowed nervously as millions of gazes suddenly converged on him, cold sweat pouring down his body.
After a brief moment of silence, he cursed aloud, "Fuck!"

Then, without hesitation, he began stripping the jewelry from his body and swallowing it one piece at a time—starting with the rings on his fingers, followed by the crystal-adorned bracelets on his arms, his earrings, and finally his necklaces. As for the larger pieces that couldn't be swallowed whole, he forcibly shattered them into smaller fragments before downing them as well.
The Gold Emperor wore so much jewelry that it took several minutes for him to finish swallowing it all, while everyone watched wide-eyed, not daring to blink.
Once he was done, he shouted, "I AM A MAN OF MY WORDS! DO YOU HEAR ME, YOU—?!"
The Gold Emperor looked around, but he couldn't find Ren Xia.
"What? Where did she go?!"
He questioned the auctioneer, who quickly replied with a stiff expression, "Um... she left the moment you finished swallowing your first jewelry..."
The Gold Emperor coughed up a mouthful of blood in anger when he learned that Ren Xia hadn't even bothered to stay until the end.
He wasn't the only one left stunned. The others were equally dumbfounded. No one had even noticed her departure, as their attention had been entirely fixed on the Gold Emperor.

What transpired at the auction spread like wildfire that very day, with people everywhere scrambling to uncover Ren Xia's identity. A few days after the auction, Ren Xia returned to the palace and reunited with Tian Yang.
"Tada!" Ren Xia proudly revealed the soul cultivation technique to Tian Yang upon her return.
"How did you come back so fast?" Tian Yang was more puzzled by her transportation speed than anything, as the Holy Continent was on the opposite side of the world.

"By using the teleport formations that they've recently started to build around the world. They're incredibly convenient, albeit a little expensive. It required several trips through many cities and a few million spirit stones, but it only took five days to reach the Holy Continent," she explained.

sentences.text: "Heavens!

Who is that woman bidding against Senior Ru Bing, who is known as the Gold Emperor—the wealthiest individual in the world?!" "I don't recognize her, but she's definitely disguising her true appearance right now."

Ren Xia's wealth and relentless bidding against the Gold Emperor left every guest there in awe, especially those who were in the business scene and understood how astonishing it was to fight the Gold Emperor with money.
However, some people there doubted whether Ren Xia really had so much wealth.
"What if she's just bidding out of her ass just to increase the price of the soul cultivation technique?"
"In the presence of the Three Pillars of Heaven and so many people?
There's no way anyone would be that foolish!"
Eventually, the bid reached an astonishing five billion spirit stones.
"Five billion, two hundred million, and one thousand spirit stones!" The Gold Emperor shouted with clenched fists.
"Five billion, two hundred million, and two thousand spirit stones." Ren Xia countered in a calm voice, sounding as if she were just ordering a simple dish at a restaurant.
'Fuck!
I do not believe that bitch truly has so much money!' The Gold Emperor cursed inwardly.
"Going once..."
"Going twice..."
"And—"
"SEVEN BILLION!" The Gold Emperor countered at the very last second, increasing the price by two whole billion in one go.
"Seven billion spirit stones?!"
Everyone was stunned by the Gold Emperor's bid.
Even as the richest individual in the world, such an amount would strain his finances for a very long time.
And for what?
A soul cultivation technique that even the geniuses of the Three Pillars of Heaven had failed to cultivate.
It seemed nothing short of a reckless waste.
The Gold Emperor, of course, understood this better than anyone.
But at this point, he was no longer bidding for the technique itself.
This had become a matter of pride—and he refused to lose to some nobody.
After making his bid, the Gold Emperor stood up and glared at Ren Xia.
"I do not believe you can outbid me!
Even if you do, I doubt you actually have that much money!" he shouted at her.
Before she could respond, he continued, "If you can beat me, I'll eat all of the jewelry on me before everyone today!
As the richest individual in the world, the Gold Emperor naturally enjoyed flaunting his wealth, his entire body adorned with expensive jewelry.
"Going once..."
Ren Xia calmly met the Gold Emperor's gaze and sneered, "I hope you didn't eat breakfast today, then."
"Going twice..."
"Ten billion spirit stones!" Ren Xia loudly declared.
The Gold Emperor's eyes widened with shock and disbelief at her counter.
"T-There's no way you can actually pay such an amount!
Even if you do, you'll definitely become homeless afterward!" The Gold Emperor exclaimed.
"Going once!"
"Goince twice!"
"And... sold!
To the young lady at seat 194,224 for ten billion spirit stones!" Unsurprisingly, the Gold Emperor did not try to compete with Ren Xia's ten billion, allowing her to win.
However, just because he lost the auction didn't mean he'd have to immediately eat his own jewelry, as Ren Xia still had to prove that she had won legitimately by paying the ten billion.
After winning the auction, Ren Xia stood up and said to the Gold Emperor, "You should prepare to follow through in your own words."
Then, she went to pay for the soul cultivation technique.
It took several minutes, but the auctioneer eventually finished counting Ren Xia's payment.
"I have confirmed the payment of ten billion spirit stones!
Thank you!
Here is your soul cultivation technique!"
The auctioneer immediately handed the technique to her.
"Heavens!
She actually paid ten billion without batting an eye!
Once it was confirmed that Ren Xia had paid the amount, everyone at the auction turned to look at the Gold Emperor.
"...This is..."
The Gold Emperor swallowed nervously as millions of gazes suddenly converged on him, cold sweat pouring down his body.
After a brief moment of silence, he cursed aloud, "Fuck!"

Then, without hesitation, he began stripping the jewelry from his body and swallowing it one piece at a time—starting with the rings on his fingers, followed by the crystal-adorned bracelets on his arms, his earrings, and finally his necklaces.
As for the larger pieces that couldn't be swallowed whole, he forcibly shattered them into smaller fragments before downing them as well.
The Gold Emperor wore so much jewelry that it took several minutes for him to finish swallowing it all, while everyone watched wide-eyed, not daring to blink.
Once he was done, he shouted, "I AM A MAN OF MY WORDS!
DO YOU HEAR ME, YOU—?!"
The Gold Emperor looked around, but he couldn't find Ren Xia.
"What?
Where did she go?!"
He questioned the auctioneer, who quickly replied with a stiff expression, "Um... she left the moment you finished swallowing your first jewelry..."
The Gold Emperor coughed up a mouthful of blood in anger when he learned that Ren Xia hadn't even bothered to stay until the end.
He wasn't the only one left stunned.
The others were equally dumbfounded.
No one had even noticed her departure, as their attention had been entirely fixed on the Gold Emperor.
What transpired at the auction spread like wildfire that very day, with people everywhere scrambling to uncover Ren Xia's identity.
A few days after the auction, Ren Xia returned to the palace and reunited with Tian Yang.
"Tada!" Ren Xia proudly revealed the soul cultivation technique to Tian Yang upon her return.
"How did you come back so fast?" Tian Yang was more puzzled by her transportation speed than anything, as the Holy Continent was on the opposite side of the world.
"By using the teleport formations that they've recently started to build around the world.
They're incredibly convenient, albeit a little expensive.
It required several trips through many cities and a few million spirit stones, but it only took five days to reach the Holy Continent," she explained.

chapters.title: Chapter 2310 Kulas Awakens
paragraphs: "Teleport formations, huh? Since when did they start building those?" Tian Yang wondered out loud.
"Several hundred years ago. I heard the construction was being financed by the Three Pillars of Heaven, too."
"Do they have nothing else to do? They're getting much more involved with the world now, even though they barely had a presence not too long ago."
"It probably has something to do with their war against the Giant Race," said Ren Xia.
"Anyway, here is the soul cultivation technique."
She took out the technique from her spatial ring and handed it to him.
"Hm? Aren't you going to learn it first?" Tian Yang asked.
"I already took a look at it on my way back here. Unfortunately, I don't have what it takes to cultivate it," she sighed.
"Huh?" Tian Yang raised an eyebrow, clearly puzzled.
Since he hadn't been present at the auction, he had no way of knowing that the technique had been put up for sale precisely because only its creator had ever managed to cultivate it successfully.
Seeing his expression, Ren Xia quickly explained everything to him.
"A soul cultivation technique that only its creator can cultivate, huh? This isn't the first technique with such restrictions, so I'm not surprised. But..."
Tian Yang looked at Ren Xia with a weird face.
"Did you really have to spend ten billion spirit stones—our entire fortune on it? I know we have no need for money right now, but things might change in the future..."

They'd managed to amass such wealth after looting all of the Immortal Clans, but Ren Xia had spent it all in a single auction for a technique that had a high chance of not even benefiting them. Tian Yang couldn't fathom her thoughts.
A somewhat stiff smile tugged at Ren Xia's lips as she replied, "I figured that if anyone in this world could cultivate the technique, it'd be you."
Tian Yang facepalmed.
"That's your reason for spending that much money? Are you sure you weren't just messing around and got ahead of yourself?" Tian Yang glared at her, reading her like an open book.
"I-I may have gotten ahead of myself at the end, but there's no use dwelling on it now. It's not like we can refund it."
"Forget it. Let me see the technique."
Tian Yang grabbed the technique from her and immediately started reading it the next moment.
"So, what do you think about it?" Ren Xia asked him a minute later.
Tian Yang didn't respond and remained fixated on the technique.
"Dear?"
Thinking that he didn't hear her, she called out to him again.
However, Tian Yang remained silent.
In his eyes, the vast universe seemed to shrink until only he remained—alone, with the soul cultivation technique as the sole thing within his grasp.
Seeing the profound look in his eyes, Ren Xia stopped trying to bother him and patiently waited for him to wake up.
Tian Yang would not move an inch or even blink once for the next four hours, but eventually, he closed his eyes, delving deep inside his mind, where a name would resound repeatedly.
"Heaven's Indomitable Soul."
After staying in that state for nearly two weeks straight, Tian Yang finally opened his eyes and took a deep breath.
"So you've finally returned to reality," Ren Xia's voice resounded a moment later.
He lifted his head to look at her, who was standing in front of him with a worried look on her face.
"How long was I out?" he asked in a puzzled voice.
"Two entire weeks."
"I see..."
"I can assume that you've successfully cultivated the technique, right?" she then said.
He nodded and replied, "Yes, but this technique... It's not complete."
"What? The Three Pillars of Heaven sold an incomplete technique?" Ren Xia frowned, feeling like she'd been scammed.
"Actually, I'm not sure. It looks and feels complete, but my instincts are telling me otherwise. I'll need to spend more time before I can be certain," he said.
"Who made this technique?" he then asked.
Ren Xia shrugged.
"They never revealed the creator's identity, and I doubt they ever will."
"I wouldn't be surprised if that were the case."
"So, what do you think about the technique?" Ren Xia then asked.

Tian Yang pondered for a moment before responding, "It's a good technique... No, it's an amazing technique. Whoever created it is definitely a genius. Whether it's safe or not, I'll have to cultivate it to see for myself."
Ren Xia sighed, "Lucky you. Now that you have a soul cultivation technique, you'll be able to ascend to the next realm without any issue. I, on the other hand, still need one."
"Although I am not sure it'll work, I can try teaching you the technique once I master it," he said.
"Okay." She nodded.
Even though Tian Yang now had a soul cultivation technique, he didn't immediately start cultivating it and continued to focus on his Celestial Qi first.
Another hundred years passed in the blink of an eye, and during one random morning, Tian Yang, who had been cultivating in his room, suddenly opened his eyes.
"This aura!" He stood up and turned to face the direction of Kulas' room.
"Hey! This aura!" Ren Xia's voice resounded a second later.
Then, she entered his room and exclaimed, "Kulas is awake!" Tian Yang nodded, but there was a deep frown on his face.
"What's wrong?" she asked him.
"You should stay here. I'll meet Kulas alone."
"What? Why?" "I'm afraid there might be something wrong with him."
"Then we should definitely stick together! What if he attacks you?!"
"I'll be fine. Also, I can sense a familiar feeling coming from his aura..."
"Anyway, just stay here for now. I'll call for you if I need help."
Tian Yang didn't elaborate further and left the next moment, leaving Ren Xia speechless.
When he arrived at Kulas's room, several of his wives were already there. Yet, for some reason, they merely stood outside, staring at the door with nervous expressions, as though afraid to open it.

chapters.title: Chapter 2311 Shura's Gift
paragraphs: "Senior Tian!"
When Kulas' wives saw him, the stress on their faces instantly weakened, and they appeared more relieved.
"What's wrong? Why aren't you going inside?" he asked them.

The women turned to look at the door and swallowed nervously, before one of them responded, "There's an inexplicable feeling coming from the room... No matter how much we try to open it, our instincts prevent us from doing so."
"Is that so? Then get back. I'll check on Kulas alone."
Tian Yang walked to the door and opened it without any issue.
The moment the door opened, a sinister aura surged out of the room, causing the women outside to collapse unconscious.
Tian Yang felt overwhelmed by the aura, but he managed to hang onto his consciousness.
Despite the dreadful feeling, Tian Yang entered the room and closed the door behind him.
The inside of the room was pitch black, and Tian Yang could still see Kulas' silhouette by the bed, but he wasn't lying on it. Rather, he was standing beside it.
Tian Yang narrowed his gaze and spoke in a cautious tone, "Who are you?"
Although the figure belonged to Kulas, Tian Yang felt something was off—like he was standing before a different person.
Kulas turned his head with stiff movements until his red eyes glared at Tian Yang.
"So you are the one who has been interfering with my plans. A mere mortal like you..."
Tian Yang frowned as he instantly realized that he was currently in the presence of the Eternal behind Kulas' illness.
"Are you an Eternal?" Tian Yang had to confirm his identity.
"Oh? You knew about us?"
The Eternal responded in a surprised voice.
"No, I shouldn't be surprised. This makes perfect sense. After all, there's no way a mortal could cut off my influence."
"What are you talking about?" Tian Yang asked, genuinely puzzled by the Eternal's words.
The Eternal narrowed his gaze at Yuan.
"Who is the Eternal ordering you to mess with me?"
"I think you're misunderstanding something. Nobody is ordering me to do anything."
"Do you really expect me to believe you? You, who has been granted a 'gift' by an Eternal?"
The Eternal's words made Tian Yang recall the 'gift' that Shura gave him during their first meeting. However, he was never told what that gift was.
"I really don't know what you're talking about."
"The power to reduce another Eternal's influence... Whoever is behind you must be really powerful."
It was really subtle, but there was a hint of fear within the Eternal's voice.
"What...?" Tian Yang's eyes widened at the Eternal's words.
He has the power to reduce Eternals' influence? Is that why Kulas' illness wouldn't trigger when he was around? It finally made sense. Yet, he couldn't fathom why Shura would grant him such a gift.
"Whoever is behind you... Tell them to stop interfering with me, Zaaran!"
Tian Yang finally learned the identity of the Eternal behind Kulas' illness, and it was in a fashion that he never anticipated.
"What do you want with Kulas? Why are you trying to kill him?" Tian Yang suddenly asked.

"Kill him? Why would I kill such a useful puppet?" Zaaran sneered before continuing in an angry voice. "The reason he hasn't been able to wake up and finish his transformation is because of your interference, mortal!"
"What? Transformation?

"Did you really think a mortal like him would be able to create something like the Giant Race? If it weren't for you, he would've completed his transformation into a new existence—a true giant ages ago! But because of you, it was halted, and I am forced to possess his body and forcefully awaken him!" Tian Yang was left speechless by the revelation. He could never have imagined that the cause of Kulas's mood swings and illness was his ongoing transformation into a true giant—and that Tian Yang himself was the reason Kulas could not complete it, leaving him trapped in a coma.
However, if becoming a true giant required Kulas to descend into madness, then Tian Yang would rather see the transformation fail altogether. In fact, he'd purposefully prevent it from happening.
"Why are you trying to turn Kulas into a true giant? What is your goal here?" Tian Yang then asked.
"Isn't it obvious?" The Eternal responded with a cold smile. "I am doing this because he asked for it! Of course, I am not helping him for free. However, that is none of your business."
The Eternal suddenly started walking toward Tian Yang.
However, the Eternal abruptly stopped moving after only taking two steps.
"Tsk." The Eternal sucked his teeth in annoyance and muttered in a low voice. "Which reckless bastard gave you such a power? They must be out of their mind!"

Even though the Eternal wanted to approach Tian Yang, his power that reduced Eternals' influence made it difficult for the one possessing Kulas' body to approach him, as it would weaken his control over the body.
Tian Yang then said, "I don't care what arrangements you made with Kulas, but I won't allow you to play with his life as you please, even if you are an Eternal."

"Hahaha! And what do you think you, a mere mortal, can do to stop me?! Although you may be able to weaken our influence, you are overestimating your powers!" The Eternal laughed out loud as he unleashed immense killing intent.
Sensing the killing intent, Tian Yang instinctively acted and swung his arm, punching Kulas right in the face.
"Wake up!"
Kulas was sent flying to the other side of the room and slammed into the wall.
After a moment of silence, Kulas stood up and looked at Tian Yang, but his red eyes had disappeared and returned to their original color.
"I'm sorry for troubling you like this..." Kulas sighed.
While the Eternal had possessed his body, Kulas was conscious the entire time and witnessed their conversation.
"Why didn't you tell me that you were in contact with an Eternal?" Tian Yang asked with narrowed eyes, his voice full of disappointment.
