chapters.title: Chapter 2312 Leaving Kulas Behind
paragraphs: "Am I... that untrustworthy?" Tian Yang looked at Kulas with a saddened face.

"N-No! That's not it!" Kulas immediately responded, his voice full of pain. "You know there's no one I trust more than you in this world. However, I didn't want to trouble you—harm you with my knowledge."

"If you're worried that my longevity might be in jeopardy, then it was needless worry. In fact, you should've known that I was aware of their existence when I mentioned that I learned of forbidden knowledge that cannot be shared in Han Zexian's tomb."

Kulas sighed, "Indeed, I have considered that possibility. But I wasn't certain, nor did I want to risk it. Moreover, that's not what truly worried me. The Eternal helping me... I was worried that he might try to harm you."
"Well, now that I know everything—almost everything, care to fill in the gaps for me?" Tian Yang asked.

Kulas nodded and explained, "I learned of the communication technique hidden within the Great Mammoth Body Refinement while I was still inside the Immortal Confinement Dungeon, and I tried it out as a last-ditch effort. That's when I met the Eternal, who introduced himself as Zaaran. I pleaded with him for help, and he agreed but under one condition—that I must find something for him."

"Since it was my darkest time and I was desperate, I accepted Zaaran's terms. In return, he bestowed upon me a gift—my bloodline that allowed for the creation of the Giant Race. Then, under his instructions, I started building my own empire within the continent."
Tian Yang then asked, "What did Zaaran want you to find for him?"
He remembered that Shura also wanted him to find something when he asked him to help Kulas, but refused to tell him because he wasn't prepared to hear it.

"Honestly, I still have no idea what Zaaran wants me to find. He said that he'll tell me once I'm strong enough, when I reach the next realm. Oh, he was also the one who told me about Celestial Qi, even giving me a cultivation technique to cultivate it."

Kulas sighed loudly before continuing, "I know it's a little late, but I apologize for lying. I didn't actually discovery Celestial Qi myself, and I kept the technique to myself because I didn't want you to be suspicious of me."
Hearing this, Tian Yang began to doubt Shura even more. After all, Shura appeared to share the same goal as Zaaran, and for all he knew, the two might even be working together.
However, why would Shura give him the power to weaken an Eternal's influence, which ended up interfering with Zaaran's plans?
"Then do you know of an Eternal by the name of—" Tian Yang was about to ask Kulas if he knew Shura's name, but Kulas abruptly stopped him.

"Don't tell me anything! Although I may be fine now, this is only temporary. In fact, I can feel my consciousness slowly slipping away with every passing moment. I'll definitely return to being a madman soon, and Zaaran will learn everything you tell me."
Kulas looked at Tian Yang with a bitter smile and said, "Brother... I need you to do something for me..."
"If you're telling me to leave you, then you can—"

"Sorry, but I am not asking you." Kulas interrupted in a stubborn voice. chapters.title: Chapter 2313 Leaving Kulas Behind(2)
paragraphs: "We will leave this continent."
"Huh?"
Ren Xia looked at Tian Yang with wide eyes, as those were his first words after returning.
"What about Kulas?"
Tian Yang shook his head and sighed.
Then, he explained the entire situation to her.
"I get the gist of the situation, but... Are you really going to leave him behind?" Ren Xia looked at him with a worried frown.
Although she was slightly worried for Kulas, she was far more concerned for Tian Yang in this sort of situation, as it could easily develop into a heart demon in the future.

Tian Yang wore a resolute expression on his face as he replied, "I am not leaving him behind. But it's also true that we cannot help him—at least not in our current state. Once we leave, I will focus on trying to breakthrough to the next realm and figure out what these Eternals want from us!"
"If Kulas even lasts long enough for us to help him..." Ren Xia remarked.
Tian Yang clenched his fists and said, "Kulas is strong... I believe that he won't do something as foolish as ending himself!"
"Anyway, we're leaving at dawn, and we'll be taking whoever wants to leave with us."
"All of them?" Ren Xia raised an eyebrow.
"Of course not. I will only take those who haven't been affected by the illness, and those who are willing to leave with us."
"But only some of his wives and daughters aren't affected..." Ren Xia narrowed her gaze at him.
Tian Yang sighed, "Relax, I have no intention of touching Kulas' family, even if he is no longer here."
"I didn't say anything, though," she said.
"But I know what you're thinking."
"Do you, really?" Ren Xia sneered. "I was actually thinking that if you truly had some feelings for them, I wouldn't mind accepting a few more sisters."
Tian Yang looked at her wide eyes, his gaze full of disbelief.
He shook his head and sighed, "This isn't the time for jokes. Let's get ready to leave."
"I wasn't joking, though..." she muttered.
A few hours later, Tian Yang and Ren Xia went to the front gate and waited for dawn, which was only an hour away.
Half an hour later, a large group of people, around two hundred, walked out of the palace with a heavy atmosphere around them.

This entire group consisted of women, with more than half of them being Kulas' wives. Since the daughters were more closely connected to Kulas by blood, they were more likely to be affected by the Kulas' bloodline.
Naturally, Tian Yang had noticed long ago that the women were less likely to be affected by the illness, but there was nothing he could really do, even with that information.

When the group stopped before them, one of them stepped forward and said, "This is everyone who hasn't been affected by the illness yet. We all had a long talk, and although we all showed up, not all of us will leave. Some of us have decided to stay behind and remain with our husbands."
Soon, about a third of the group separated from the rest and approached Tian Yang.
"We have all decided to leave with you..."

Tian Yang looked at the group. There were several that he recognized and some that he didn't. Those he recognized consisted of Chao Shuying, Xie Mey, and the women who asked him to embrace them in Kulas' stead in the past.
As for those who decided to stay behind, most of them were Kulas' earliest wives—those who had been there since the beginning.
"That's all?" Tian Yang asked to confirm.
"Yes, we have all decided to stay here with our husband, regardless of what happens."
Tian Yang nodded.
"Good luck. I'll leave Kulas in your care."
Tian Yang didn't linger and immediately left the continent with Ren Xia and those who willingly followed him.
Meanwhile, inside his own room, Kulas held a dagger in his grasp, pointing the sharp blade toward his own chest.
"So he's finally left..." he muttered.
Once he confirmed that Tian Yang had left, a determined light flickered within his gaze.
"I will not let you harm my brother, Zaaran, even if it's the last thing I do!
Without hesitation, Kulas brought the dagger toward his heart, piercing it.
Kulas' body fell onto the ground the next moment, quickly creating a puddle of blood, and the light in his eyes dimmed.
However, just as the light faded and almost vanished, it suddenly brightened, even turning bright red.
He lifted himself off the ground and muttered, "What a foolish mortal. Did you really think you'd be able to stop me with such cowardly tricks?"
Zaaran looked into the distance and smiled.
"Now that the interference is gone, I can finally finish the transformation."
Shortly after Tian Yang left the Giant Continent, he suddenly halted and turned around.
"That's..."
His eyes widened when a crimson sphere appeared out of thin air and enveloped the entire continent, resembling the Immortal Ensaring Vault used by the Immortal Clans in the past.
"What is that?!" Xie Mey exclaimed after seeing the crimson dome. "I will be right back!"

Tian Yang gritted his teeth and immediately rushed back to the continent. However, the crimson barrier completely blocked his attempt. He tried to destroy the barrier, but even his strongest attack was unable to leave a mark on it.
"What are you doing?"

When he attempted to launch another attack, Ren Xia suddenly appeared behind him and stopped him. "You have already decided to leave Kulas behind. You can't turn back now, no matter what happens from this point forth."
"What can you do even if you return now?" she sighed.
After a moment of silence, Tian Yang turned around and returned to the group.
"Sorry for the delay. Let's leave quickly," he said to them before speeding into the horizon, away from the Giant Continent.
Soon, news of the Giant's Continent being covered in a crimson dome that even the Three Pillars of Heaven couldn't penetrate spread throughout the world.

chapters.title: Chapter 2314 A Sudden End to the War
paragraphs: After leaving the Giant's Continent, Tian Yang brought Kulas' family to a safe location before entering seclusion to focus on pushing his cultivation base to the next realm.
A hundred years... a thousand years... ten thousand years.
Years passed in the blink of an eye, and even after twenty thousand years, the Giant's Continent remained sealed by the mysterious crimson dome.
The crimson dome was so durable that even the Three Pillars of Heaven were unable to damage it, even after thousands of years of effort, much less destroy it.
Eventually, the Three Pillars of Heaven gave up on trying to invade the Giant's Continent. However, they remained vigilant and constantly monitored the continent.
As more and more time passed and the crimson dome showed no sign of weakening, the Three Pillars of Heaven started to lose interest, and their war with the Giant Race came to an unexpected halt.
Thirty thousand years... forty thousand years... fifty thousand years later.
"How is your progress?" Ren Xia approached Tian Yang and asked. "Your aura is getting sharper by the day, so your breakthrough should be pretty close, no?"
Tian Yang slowly opened his eyes after hearing her voice, and his aura that was gushing with Celestial Qi was immediately suppressed until it was essentially nonexistent.
"I have already reached my limit with Celestial Qi. I cannot refine more at this level, even if I want to. Unfortunately, I am still nowhere near close to reaching the next realm."
"Really? Even though you said it was achievable within fifty thousand years?"
"That was just a guess."
"What about now? Now that you're getting closer, you should have a rough idea how long it'd take, right?"

Tian Yang sighed. "While it's true that I've essentially reached my limit with Celestial Qi, arriving at this level made me realize it isn't the most important factor for my breakthrough. What truly matters is the soul, and I have only recently begun cultivating it.
"Speaking of cultivating your soul... how's the soul cultivation technique? Did you manage to complete it?" Ren Xia asked.
He shook his head.
"I had my hands full with Celestial Qi, so where would I find the time to complete it? However, I am certain that it's not finished."
"Is it even safe to cultivate an unfinished technique?"

"Normally, it isn't, but this technique is unlike any technique I have seen before. It may not be complete, but it functions like one." "If it doesn't matter, then what's the point of completing it?" Ren Xia wore a puzzled expression on her face.

"It may not affect my ability to cultivate it, but it will definitely affect its effectiveness. If I am going to offend a god-like being that lives beyond our world, I'll need to get as strong as I can so that I can protect what's important to me."
Tian Yang then asked, "Anyway, what's been going on outside lately? What are the Three Pillars of Heaven up to these days?"
"Just the usual. They're getting more and more involved with the rest of the world. But they seem to have picked up their pace recently. They're definitely up to something," she said.

Ever since their war with the Giant Race came to a halt, the Three Pillars of Heaven began actively expanding their influence throughout the Divine Heaven. Although they had always been untouchable and immensely influential, that power was largely confined to their own circle, and they rarely intervened in the outside world. Now, however, they were inserting themselves into nearly everything—from commerce to sects.
"I see..."

"Anyway, I'll stop bothering your cultivation and return to my own. There are many soul cultivation techniques being created these days, but I still haven't found any suitable for me, so I'll continue to focus on my Celestial Qi for now."
After giving Tian Yang a kiss on the lips, Ren Xia went to her own area to cultivate.
Time continued to pass, and in the blink of an eye, another twenty thousand years had passed. By now, over seventy thousand years have passed since Tian Yang left the Giant's Continent.
"I'm going out for a bit," Tian Yang said to Ren Xia.
Ren Xia looked at him with a smile and asked, "Are you going to meet with her?
He silently nodded.

"Alright. Try not to stay out too late," she said with a teasing smile, trying to sound like a mother. After leaving, Tian Yang traveled to a city that would've taken him a decade to traverse if it weren't for the teleportation formation. Although the teleportation formations were extremely convenient, they were still extremely expensive and were typically used for emergencies by wealthy figures or powerful cultivators.
In fact, even Tian Yang had to use them sparingly, especially after Ren Xia had spent most of their fortune on the soul cultivation technique.
Although they could easily earn plenty of money with their cultivation, they spent most of their time in seclusion, only leaving their personal world every few hundred years.
By this point, the names Tian Yang and Ren Xia—once feared throughout the world—had all but faded into obscurity, with barely anyone still aware of who they were.
After arriving at his destination, Tian Yang closed his eyes to cultivate while he waited for the other party to arrive.
"You're as diligent as ever. Do you ever rest?" A familiar voice suddenly resounded a few minutes after Tian Yang's arrival.
Tian Yang opened his eyes to look at the beautiful woman standing before him and smiled, "And you look the same as ever, Sister Sun."
"A gentleman would say something like 'you look even more beautiful than before'," she calmly teased.
"A gentleman... or a womanizer?"
Sun Rouxi chuckled, and the two of them started chatting.

After Tian Yang left the Giant Continent, the two would occasionally meet to catch up. However, their conversations were never merely casual. They also exchanged insights, knowledge, and discoveries related to cultivation.
"So, what's the Three Pillars of Heaven up to these days? Why are they expanding their influence so rapidly?" Tian Yang suddenly asked, his expression turned serious.

chapters.title: Chapter 2315 Creator of the Soul Cultivation Technique
paragraphs: "You make it sound like the Three Pillars of Heaven are scheming something," Ren Xia said calmly after hearing Tian Yang's question.

"Am I wrong? You're free to correct me if that's the case," Tian Yang replied. "There's no way the Three Pillars of Heaven—who spent most of their existence in secrecy, isolated within their own bubble—would suddenly involve themselves in nearly everything for no reason."
"Even if they are scheming something, what makes you think I'd be privy to such information?" Sun Rouxi questioned with a narrowed gaze. "Do you even know my position within the background?"
"I don't, but I doubt you're a nobody."
"Oh? What gave you that impression?"
Tian Yang answered with a calm smile, "Would a nobody be able to travel to the Giant Continent while another group is there on important business, let alone bring a friend along?"
"You're also talented enough to complete others' unfinished techniques. I wouldn't be surprised if you held an important position within your family."
Sun Rouxi chuckled, "You never struck me as the keen type. You're more like a reckless bull that charges headfirst into anything without thinking first."

"Anyway, to answer your earlier question... the Three Pillars of Heaven are definitely planning something, but I do not know what that thing is. While my position within the family isn't ordinary, it's nothing too special, either. Most importantly, I spend most of my time in seclusion, only coming out to meet with you occasionally, so I don't have the time to care about such trivial matters. As a matter of fact, I have no interest in whatever they are doing."
"Trying to become the first to enter the next realm? How close are you?" Tian Yang then asked.
"Well, I have enough Celestial Qi, so I only need to cultivate my soul now. Unfortunately, I am not experienced enough to give you an estimate of when I'll reach my goal. How about you?"

"I'm in the same boat. It took me so long just to cultivate my Celestial Qi. I cannot fathom how much longer cultivating my soul would take. Another fifty thousand years? A hundred thousand? Only time will tell." Tian Yang sighed.
"Speaking of soul cultivation... what soul cultivation technique are you using? You don't have to tell me if you don't want to."
"My soul cultivation technique is named Heaven's Indomitable Soul."
"Eh?" Sun Rouxi's eyes widened upon hearing this name, mouth even agape.
Tian Yang smiled and said, "That's right. It's the one your family sold some time ago."
"So you were the one who purchased it..." Sun Rouxi muttered in a daze. "Is this fate?"
"Well, it was Ren Xia who bought it."
Sun Rouxi suddenly fell silent, her gaze fixed on Tian Yang as though weighing a decision in her mind.
"What's wrong?" he asked.
"Since it's you... I'll let you in on a little secret."
"Hm?" Tian Yang raised an eyebrow.
"It's about the creator of that technique," she continued.
"Oh?"
Tian Yang's eyes flickered with intrigue as he leaned in slightly, his attention fully captured.
"The creator of that technique is... me!" she revealed with a wide smile.
"What?!" Tian Yang leaned back in shock, his eyes and mouth agape. He quickly snapped out of it and said, "There's no way! You're messing with me!"
Without explaining, Sun Rouxi started to recite the entire technique from the beginning to the end without missing a word.
"That doesn't prove anything... You could've just memorized it after reading it. It belonged to your family, after all."
Sun Rouxi sighed, "I don't know how else to convince you. To think you wouldn't believe me, even though I risked so much to reveal this secret that only a few in the family know..."
After a moment of silence, Tian Yang spoke, "Are you... being serious?"
"What would I even gain from lying to you?" she sneered.
"No way..."
Tian Yang could tell that she was being genuine just from her voice alone, leaving him speechless.
"You actually created this technique? You're even more amazing than I thought." Tian Yang swallowed nervously.
"I did spend pretty much my entire life dedicated to it, after all."
"And how long is that?"
"I started working on it shortly after I joined the Immortal Monastery, only finishing it a thousand years before it was sold."
"Why'd you decide to sell it?" Tian Yang continued to ask.

Sun Rouxi sighed softly. "It wasn't my decision. I wanted to share the technique openly, just to see if anyone besides me could cultivate it. But the family ignored my wishes and sold it for profit. They said the technique would naturally spread over time anyway, once no one proved capable of cultivating it, so they might as well profit from it. However, that never happened, and the new owner disappeared like a ghost after buying it."
She looked at him and smiled, "I never thought it would land in your hand, much less you successfully cultivating it."
"So, what do you think of my technique? Although it's not the only technique I've created, it's my proudest work," she spoke with an air of pride swirling around her, not even bothering to hide it.
Tian Yang chuckled and said, "It's obviously amazing. Even the best soul cultivation techniques that have come out recently cannot compare to it. However..."
"However?" Sun Rouxi raised an eyebrow.
"I think it can be improved," he continued with a smile.

Although Tian Yang had long referred to it as incomplete, he realized that wasn't accurate. The technique was, in fact, complete, as it could be cultivated properly. Rather than being unfinished, it simply had room for improvement, and that was what he told her.
"...Huh?" Sun Rouxi's jaw dropped after hearing his words.
Seeing her reaction, Tian Yang quickly realized his mistake. Telling the creator of the technique that it could be improved had been undeniably rude.
"Sorry, I didn't mean to offend you—"
"I don't care about that," she quickly interrupted.
"Tell me more," she continued with a solemn expression.
Instead of taking offense, she seemed genuinely intrigued, a spark of excitement flickering in her eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 2316 Improving the Soul Cultivation Technique
paragraphs: "Uh... even if you tell me to explain... my understanding of the technique is nowhere near enough to explain it in detail," he said in a somewhat awkward tone.

Sun Rouxi frowned at his response and immediately responded, "Then how do you know the technique could be improved? You got my hopes up for nothing!" "As I said, I don't have enough experience to explain myself. I'll do it once I reach a deeper understanding of the technique.'
"Fine, I'll wait. But if it turns out that you were lying to me, I'll be very upset and angry at you."
Tian Yang nodded.
"Alright."
The two of them chatted for a little longer before they parted and returned to their own dwelling.
Upon returning home, Tian Yang immediately entered seclusion to cultivate the soul cultivation technique.
Time continued to pass.
Five thousand years... ten thousand years... twenty thousand years.
"How is your progress with the soul cultivation technique?" Sun Rouxi asked Tian Yang on their sixth meeting since she revealed herself to be the creator of the Heaven's Indomitable Soul technique.
Tian Yang smiled and said, "Not much compared to last time, but I have reached a level of understanding where I can explain to you about why I think the technique can be improved."
"I'm listening."
Tian Yang proceeded to explain his discovery and shared his thoughts on how he believes it can be improved.
Sun Rouxi didn't respond for a long time after Tian Yang was finished.
Eventually, she looked at him with a cold smile and said, "If you dare call yourself talentless after today, I'll feed you to the pigs."
Tian Yang could only offer a silent smile in response.
"Hey, where are you staying right now?" Sun Rouxi suddenly asked. "Are you still staying in your personal world?"
"Hm? I am. Why are you asking?"
"Make some space for two people. I'm going to stay with you for a while," she said.
"What?!" Tian Yang exclaimed. "Why so suddenly?"
"What do you think? I want to improve the soul cultivation technique.
"Can't you just do it with the information I've provided you?"

"I can, but it won't turn out the way you envisioned, and there is still room for your comprehension to grow. It'd be a hassle to meet like this every time I want to speak to you, so I'll just stay with you until the cultivation technique is refined. Don't worry, I won't intrude on your time with your wife."
Tian Yang shook his head and said, "That's not what I am worried about. And room for two? Who else is coming with you?"
"Who else but Ruye?"
"Ah, Senior Sister Jing. You really stick close to each other, huh?"

"She's the only close friend I have. And it wouldn't be wise to leave her alone with my family for too long. They don't really like her because of her original background, and she's currently there as my 'servant'."
"In any case, I don't mind, but I need to speak with Ren Xia first. We share the world, after all."
"Alright. Let's meet again in ten years, then."
After they parted, Tian Yang returned home to let Ren Xia know the situation. Meanwhile, Sun Rouxi prepared for her departure from the family.
"I was wondering when this day would come since you started meeting with her again," Ren Xia sighed after hearing the situation.
Tian Yang raised an eyebrow and asked, "Why would you be expecting this situation?"
"You really don't know?" "..." Tian Yang remained silent.
"...In any case, you don't need my approval for such trivial matters. It's not like we're the only two occupying this world, anyway."
Ten years later, Tian Yang met up with Sun Rouxi, who brought along Jing Ruye this time.
"What did your wife say?" Sun Rouxi asked.

"Does it even matter? You look like you're already prepared to move in..." Sun Rouxi sighed, "Do you have any idea how much effort it takes to sneak out every time I meet you? Because of that time I ran away from home to work as a sect elder in the Immortal Monastery, my family has been keeping a close eye on me since then."
Tian Yang raised an eyebrow at her words and asked, "What about this time?
"I snuck out, of course. There's no way they'd let me leave for an extended period of time alone. Hell, I'll definitely be grounded once I return home."
"Grounded...? It's not like you're a child..." Tian Yang shook his head.
"No... since you created such a powerful soul cultivation technique, they have a good reason for wanting to keep you safe."
"Enough talking. Let's go to your world before they realize I am gone. It was less bothersome before because they barely left the Holy Continent. However, they're everywhere these days."
Thus, Tian Yang brought Sun Rouxi and Jing Ruye to his personal world.
"Wow... so this is your personal world..."
Sun Rouxi and Jing Ruye were left in awe after seeing it for the first time.
"This place is so vast—much larger than even the ones at my family!" Sun Rouxi said.
"It was much smaller before, but we had to make some adjustments after a certain incident."
Although Tian Yang trusted Sun Rouxi, he kept the situation with Kulas a secret from her to avoid unnecessary risk.
"Isn't it expensive to maintain such a large world?" Jing Ruye asked.
"Yes, it requires half a million spirit stones a month to maintain it."
"That much?! Where are you even getting that much money from?" she asked.
"Monster cores are very profitable these days, especially Immortal-level cores. A single one can easily sell for tens of millions of spirit stones."
"Where do you even find the time to hunt for monster cores? Don't you spend more of your time in seclusion?" Sun Rouxi asked.
"Yes, that's why we're getting help from others. We're not the only ones living here."
"Hm? Who else lives here?"
"That's... I'll tell you in the future." Tian Yang said.
"Well, I don't really care, so you don't need to tell me if you don't want to," said Sun Rouxi in a calm voice. "Anyways, let's get started with the soul cultivation technique."
"Alright."

chapters.title: Chapter 2317 Sun Rouxi's Feelings
paragraphs: Sun Rouxi said, "Although I want to improve the soul cultivation technique, I won't be the one making the actual changes. You will, and I'll assist you."
Tian Yang looked at her with a puzzled face.
"Aren't you the creator of the technique?" he asked.

"Yes, but the technique is already 'complete' in my eyes. Even if I want to improve it, I don't think I can. Therefore, I'll assist by helping you improve your understanding, and if you have any questions about the technique, I'll be able to answer them."
Thus, Sun Rouxi and Jing Ruye started living in Tian Yang's private world.
A few days later—
"Tian Yang, I almost forgot." Sun Rouxi suddenly approached him with a solemn look on her face. "There's something I need to tell you."
"What is it?" he looked at her with a raised eyebrow.
"It's related to the Three Pillars of Heaven and... the Immortal Clans."
"What? The Immortal Clans? They're still relevant?" Tian Yang was genuinely surprised to hear their name after so long.
He had assumed they had vanished from the world entirely, as no one had spoken of them since their downfall.

Since he had never exterminated every last member of the Immortal Clans, they were undoubtedly still alive somewhere. However, they had weakened to such an extent that they could barely be recognized as an organization and went into hiding.

Sun Rouxi then spoke, "Well, they had been in hiding ever since their downfall, so I'm not surprised you forgot about them. Anyway, right before I left my family, I heard that they've found the remnants of the Immortal Clans and offered to help them regain their footing."
"What?" Tian Yang immediately frowned at this information.
"Why the hell would they do something like that?"
Sun Rouxi shrugged, "I don't know the details since I only overheard some of the elders in my family talking about it, and I am only telling you because of your relationship with the Immortal Clans."
"Did you hear anything else?" he then asked.
She shook her head.
"What are you going to do?" she asked a moment later.
Tian Yang fell silent for a long minute before releasing a deep sigh.

"I have already claimed my debt from the Immortal Clans, so whatever they do from this point forth is no longer my concern, even if they are trying to rebuild. As long as they don't block my path, I'll leave them be."
Sun Rouxi smiled and teased, "You've really grown up."
"Stop treating me like a kid."
"Sure, sure."
They returned to working on the soul cultivation technique.
Time passed swiftly, and before they realized, over a hundred years had passed since Sun Rouxi started staying with Tian Yang.
"Rouxi, we've been here for a hundred years now, you know?" Jing Ruye suddenly remarked as she poured Sun Rouxi a cup of tea.
"What about it? Are you wondering when we'll return home?" Sun Rouxi asked.
"Well, I am curious about that, but that's not what I am talking about." Jing Ruye said as she poured her own tea.
After she took a sip, she continued, "I'm talking about your progress with Tian Yang."
"Oh, the cultivation technique? We're making tremendous progress every session."

Jing Ruye narrowed her eyes at Sun Rouxi and asked, "Are you actually that dense, or are you pretending to be stupid? Please don't mock me, Rouxi. I have been aware of your feelings for him since our days at the Immortal Monastery. Although I understood why you couldn't go after him before, things are different now, no?"
"That's..." Sun Rouxi's expression stiffened at Jing Ruye's straightforwardness.

Jing Ruye smiled faintly as she continued, "Even if you claim you see him as nothing more than a little brother, now that you're both powerful cultivators who have lived for tens of thousands of years, there's no way you still view him as the same immature brat you once did."
"You may be a genius when it comes to creating techniques, but you're still a naive maiden at heart."
Sun Rouxi shook her head and sighed, "In this vast world, you're the only one who would dare to talk to me in such a manner while knowing my background."
"Well, we're not sworn sisters for nothing," Jing Ruye chuckled.

After a moment of silence, Sun Rouxi spoke, "Listen here, Ruye. Regardless of my feelings for Tian Yang, it doesn't change the fact that he already has a partner. Who am I to interfere in their relationship?"
Jing Ruye looked at her with a dumbfounded face.

"Is that concern what's preventing you from moving forward, or is that just a convenient excuse for your cowardice? You know that men with power and influence rarely limit themselves to a single wife, right? Even your father is no different."
"Don't bring my father into this. And if you really think there's nothing wrong with it, why don't you approach him?" Sun Rouxi sneered.
"Eh?" Jing Ruye pointed at her own face and asked, "Are you really giving me permission to approach him?"
"What...?" Sun Rouxi raised her eyebrows, looking confused.

"To be honest with you, Tian Yang is very attractive. Not only is he one of the most powerful men in the world, but he's also handsome. If he weren't living a seclusive life, he would be surrounded by women. As for me... I have been single my entire life, so I have no problems approaching him. The only reason I've held back is because of you, Rouxi. But if you truly don't mind me approaching him, then..."

Sun Rouxi stared at Jing Ruye, her best friend and sworn sister, with her mouth and eyes agape, looking bewildered by such a statement. Seeing her response, Jing Ruye decided to take things a step further. She quickly gulped down the rest of her tea and stood up.
"W-Where are you going?" Sun Rouxi asked.
"Hm? Isn't it obvious? I have been single for long enough, and there's an attractive, handsome man so close—"
"No! You can't have him! I forbid you!" Sun Rouxi suddenly slammed her teacup on the table, destroying both the cup and the table.
Seeing this, a stiff smile tugged at Jing Ruye's lips.

As long as they don't block my path, I'll leave them be."
Sun Rouxi smiled and teased, "You've really grown up."
"Stop treating me like a kid."
"Sure, sure."
They returned to working on the soul cultivation technique.
Time passed swiftly, and before they realized, over a hundred years had passed since Sun Rouxi started staying with Tian Yang.
"Rouxi, we've been here for a hundred years now, you know?" Jing Ruye suddenly remarked as she poured Sun Rouxi a cup of tea.
"What about it?
Are you wondering when we'll return home?" Sun Rouxi asked.
"Well, I am curious about that, but that's not what I am talking about." Jing Ruye said as she poured her own tea.
After she took a sip, she continued, "I'm talking about your progress with Tian Yang."
"Oh, the cultivation technique?
We're making tremendous progress every session."
Jing Ruye narrowed her eyes at Sun Rouxi and asked, "Are you actually that dense, or are you pretending to be stupid?
Please don't mock me, Rouxi.
I have been aware of your feelings for him since our days at the Immortal Monastery.
Although I understood why you couldn't go after him before, things are different now, no?"
"That's..." Sun Rouxi's expression stiffened at Jing Ruye's straightforwardness.

Jing Ruye smiled faintly as she continued, "Even if you claim you see him as nothing more than a little brother, now that you're both powerful cultivators who have lived for tens of thousands of years, there's no way you still view him as the same immature brat you once did."
"You may be a genius when it comes to creating techniques, but you're still a naive maiden at heart."
Sun Rouxi shook her head and sighed, "In this vast world, you're the only one who would dare to talk to me in such a manner while knowing my background."
"Well, we're not sworn sisters for nothing," Jing Ruye chuckled.
After a moment of silence, Sun Rouxi spoke, "Listen here, Ruye.
Regardless of my feelings for Tian Yang, it doesn't change the fact that he already has a partner.
Who am I to interfere in their relationship?"
Jing Ruye looked at her with a dumbfounded face.
"Is that concern what's preventing you from moving forward, or is that just a convenient excuse for your cowardice?
You know that men with power and influence rarely limit themselves to a single wife, right?
Even your father is no different."
"Don't bring my father into this.
And if you really think there's nothing wrong with it, why don't you approach him?" Sun Rouxi sneered.
"Eh?" Jing Ruye pointed at her own face and asked, "Are you really giving me permission to approach him?"
"What...?" Sun Rouxi raised her eyebrows, looking confused.
"To be honest with you, Tian Yang is very attractive.
Not only is he one of the most powerful men in the world, but he's also handsome.
If he weren't living a seclusive life, he would be surrounded by women.
As for me...
I have been single my entire life, so I have no problems approaching him.
The only reason I've held back is because of you, Rouxi.
But if you truly don't mind me approaching him, then..."
Sun Rouxi stared at Jing Ruye, her best friend and sworn sister, with her mouth and eyes agape, looking bewildered by such a statement.
Seeing her response, Jing Ruye decided to take things a step further.
She quickly gulped down the rest of her tea and stood up.
"W-Where are you going?" Sun Rouxi asked.
"Hm?
Isn't it obvious?
I have been single for long enough, and there's an attractive, handsome man so close—"
"No!
You can't have him!
I forbid you!" Sun Rouxi suddenly slammed her teacup on the table, destroying both the cup and the table.
Seeing this, a stiff smile tugged at Jing Ruye's lips.

chapters.title: Chapter 2318 Sun Rouxi's Feelings(2)
paragraphs: "Haa..." Jing Ruye released a deep sigh a moment later when Sun Rouxi refused to elaborate after her outburst.

"You're really cruel, Rouxi. Why are you forbidding me from approaching Tian Yang when you don't even have any feelings for him? You're no different from a child not sharing a piece of candy that doesn't even belong to you."
"Who said I don't have any feelings for him?! I have had my eyes on him since the Immortal Monastery!" Sun Rouxi immediately replied.
However, she'd subconsciously spoken, and when she realized what she had just said, her entire face flushed with redness.
"W-Wait a second... That's not—" Sun Rouxi stopped midway when she couldn't think of an excuse.

Jing Ruye touched the smug-looking smile on her face with a finger and teased, "Now that wasn't so bad, was it? Telling the truth, that is. I bet you feel like a mountain has been lifted off your shoulders now, especially when you've held such feelings in for so long."
Sun Rouxi opened her mouth, but no words came out. Then, her face flushed even redder when she realized that she really felt lighter.
"Now you just need to say that straight to Tian Yang himself," Jing Ruye continued.
"Impossible!" Sun Rouxi exclaimed.
Jing Ruye sighed, "Listen here, Rouxi. Your feelings will remain nonexistent until you actually tell him."

Sun Rouxi rubbed her eyes and sighed, "Although you've been with the Sun Family for many years, there are still a lot of things you aren't aware of about my family—my bloodline. Even if I wish to embrace Tian Yang, my bloodline forbids me from doing so."
"That... doesn't make any sense at all." Jing Ruye said with raised eyebrows.
"Sorry, but this is something that I cannot share, even if it's with you."
"I..." Sun Rouxi fell silent after a single word.
"Let's end this here. I'm tired."
Sun Rouxi didn't give Jing Ruye a chance to object and quickly disappeared into her room.
A few months later, Tian Yang and Sun Rouxi got together for another study session.
"Is there something on my face?" Tian Yang asked when he noticed Sun Rouxi staring at his face with a weird expression.
"H-Huh? Your face? N-No..."
Tian Yang noticed that something was off about her but decided not to stick his nose into her business. He figured that if she wanted to tell him, she would.
"Then let's begin."
Despite her best efforts, Sun Rouxi couldn't relax when in Tian Yang's presence.
'Damn it! It's all Ruye's fault! If she hadn't tricked me into saying all those weird things, I wouldn't be like this! I can barely look at him in the eyes without blushing!' she cried inwardly.
For the next several days, Sun Rouxi struggled to remain concentrated on improving the soul cultivation technique, as Tian Yang's presence constantly occupied her mind.
From his scent to his handsome face, her mind would constantly wander to a weird place she'd never experienced before.

'What the hell am I doing? I need to get rid of these useless thoughts!' Eventually, Tian Yang could no longer remain oblivious and sighed, "Do you want to stop here? If anything is troubling you, I am willing to listen..."
Tian Yang's calm voice snapped Sun Rouxi back to reality.
'Even though I am supposed to be the mature one...' she sighed inwardly.
"Sorry, it's nothing. Let's continue."
Sun Rouxi managed to remain focused for the last several days.
"Thanks for your time." Tian Yang said to her at the end of their session.
"I have nothing but time," she calmly replied.
"...How long do you intend to stay here? Until I improve the technique? That could take thousands of years."

"I don't care how long it takes. Even if it takes a million years, I am going to see this through until the very end. After all, this might be the last time that I will have any true freedom," she revealed with a heavy sigh.
Tian Yang frowned at her ominous words.
"What do you mean by that?"
"It's family matters."
After a moment of silence, Tian Yang spoke, "Are your parents forcing you into a marriage?"
Since this was a common problem within influential families, Tian Yang figured this might be the cause of Sun Rouxi's concern. After all, she belonged to one of the top backgrounds in the world.
"What?"
However, Sun Rouxi looked at him with a dumbfounded face.
"Of course not. What even gave you such thoughts?"
"I mean... isn't that a common trend among women from influential backgrounds?" Tian Yang asked.

Sun Rouxi sighed. "That's true—but do you know where I come from? The Three Pillars of Heaven. There's no background more influential than ours, and arranged marriages are usually nothing more than political tools or ways to strengthen alliances."

"That being said, it's not like I have no pressure at all, especially these days, where the Three Pillars of Heaven are trying to spread their influence. I wouldn't be surprised if they are considering it. However, I'd rather die than be forced to live with someone I don't even like, and my family is very aware of that."
"Then..."
"It's because I ran away from home again, and this time it's much longer than before. Once I return, I'll definitely be grounded for a very, very long time."
"Is that so..."
Sun Rouxi then teased, "What would you do if I were forced into an arranged marriage? Would you try to stop it?"
Tian Yang fell silent for a bit before responding with a smile, "If you ask for my help, I'll do everything in my power to stop it."
Sun Rouxi's eyes widened, her gaze flickering with delight at his response.
"I see..." she muttered before standing up. "Then I'll see you again next time."
However, instead of returning to her residence, Sun Rouxi went to find Ren Xia.
"Sorry for bothering you, but can we talk for a bit?" Sun Rouxi asked Ren Xia after she answered the door.

chapters.title: Chapter 2319 Sun Rouxi's Feelings(3)
paragraphs: Seeing Sun Rouxi standing before her, Ren Xia smiled and said, "Is this related to Tian Yang?"
Sun Rouxi hesitated for a brief second before silently nodding her head.
Ren Xia chuckled, "I was wondering when you'd approach me. So, should I start calling you 'sister' now?"
"H-Huh?" Sun Rouxi stared at her with wide eyes filled with disbelief.
"Hm? Aren't you here to ask for my permission to approach Tian Yang?" Ren Xia tilted her head and asked.

"Well..." Sun Rouxi swallowed nervously before asking, "Why are you acting so casual about this? Another woman is asking to share your partner, you know? If I were in your shoes, I wouldn't be able to remain so calm."
Ren Xia smiled and replied, "You may know my husband, but you don't know anything about me. Come inside. Let's sit down first."

Once they were seated, Ren Xia continued, "While I may seem calm and generous, I am actually a very selfish being. However, I am also rational, and I know that it's unreasonable for me to hog Tian Yang for myself. A man as charming and powerful as Tian Yang is destined to have multiple partners, and quite frankly, I'm shocked and blessed to have him to myself for so long."

"Anyway, I have already told him that if he were to find another lover, I wouldn't intervene as long as that woman is decent enough, so you can rest assured that I won't object as long as he accepts you."
"I see... Thank you..."
Sun Rouxi left shortly after.
'What a straightforward and charming individual. It's no wonder Tian Yang fell for her...' Sun Rouxi thought to herself as she returned to her own living quarters.
Although she had received Ren Xia's approval, Sun Rouxi didn't immediately approach Tian Yang. Not only was she not mentally prepared, but she still had to consider several things.
Time continued to flow like an endless river, and in the blink of an eye, another thousand years had passed. Yet, Sun Rouxi's relationship with Tian Yang hadn't progressed in the slightest.
"Hey, what are you doing?" Ren Xia suddenly approached Sun Rouxi with a slight frown and asked. "It's been a thousand years since I gave you my approval, so why aren't you doing anything?"
Sun Rouxi sighed, "I need time to mentally prepare myself. Although it's been a thousand years, the time we spent together only adds up to a few years."
"I understand the first part, but you're just trying to make excuses in the second part." Ren Xia then asked, "What are you worried about? That he might not accept your feelings?"
Sun Rouxi remained silent, but her answer was as clear as day.

Ren Xia spoke a moment later, "I can almost guarantee you that he won't reject you. Even if he does, it's not the end of the world. Do you have any idea how many times he'd rejected me before he accepted me?"
"Really?" Sun Rouxi looked at her with a surprised face.
"Of course."
Hearing such words, Sun Rouxi suddenly felt more courageous.
"Fine... I'll talk to him during our next session."
A few years later—
"Thanks for today."
Tian Yang smiled at Sun Rouxi after their study session ended.
"Hey, Tian Yang, I have a weird question for you." "What is it?"
"How do you see me?"
"I don't quite understand—"
"You know exactly what I am trying to say!" Sun Rouxi interrupted.
After a moment of silence, Tian Yang calmly responded, "At first, you were like a mentor. But as we got closer, I started to see you as an elder sister."

Sun Rouxi spoke softly, "Back then, you were just a reckless little troublemaker. Over time, though, I began to see you as a little brother. I do have a younger brother of my own, but we were never close—nothing like real siblings. You were the one who showed me what it truly felt like to have a brother."
She smiled, a hint of bitterness in her expression. "But these days... no matter how much I want to keep seeing you that way, I can't. Somewhere along the way, I started seeing you as a man."
"Sister Sun..." Tian Yang's eyes widened at her words, and he swallowed nervously.
"Don't... Don't call me that anymore..."
Tian Yang fell silent, speechless at her unfamiliar behavior.
"You don't have to give me an answer right away, but I do hope that you'll be able to give me one before I have to leave."
Not wanting Tian Yang to see her flushed face, Sun Rouxi quickly turned around and began walking away.
"Wait!"
However, Tian Yang swiftly stretched his arm and grabbed her soft hand, stopping her movements.
"Wh-What is it?" she asked in a nervous tone.
"You don't have to wait that long since I will give you an answer now..."
Tian Yang suddenly pulled her toward him and directly into his embrace.
"Tian Yang..."
Sun Rouxi glared at his handsome face with flickering eyes, and before she realized, her eyes began closing by themselves.
Seeing her reaction, Tian Yang didn't hesitate and moved his head closer until their lips touched.
After a moment of savoring each other's saliva, Tian Yang pulled back and said with a smile, "This is my answer. What should I call you now if not Sister Sun?"
"Just call me by my name..."
"Alright, Rouxi."
"So... where do we go from here?"
After a moment of silence, Tian Yang smiled and said, "We can take this slowly if you want."
Tian Yang knew that she wasn't as straightforward and touchy as Ren Xia, so he didn't rush things with her.
"Okay..." Sun Rouxi nodded, her face still flushed.

From that day onward, Tian Yang and Sun Rouxi began meeting far more frequently. Their time together was no longer devoted solely to refining the soul cultivation technique, but also to gradually deepening their relationship.
As time passed, Sun Rouxi gradually shed her reserve and, following Ren Xia's advice, even began to take a more assertive approach.
Then, one day, Sun Rouxi invited Tian Yang into her room, where their relationship took a step—several steps forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 2320 Embracing Sun Rouxi
paragraphs: After Sun Rouxi invited Tian Yang into her room, she gently pulled him down onto the bed with her, her voice soft as she whispered, "Be gentle... this is my first time."
Seeing her bashful expression, Tian Yang felt warmth surge through him, as though a raging flame had been lit within his heart.
Without any delay, Tian Yang helped Sun Rouxi undress before removing his own clothes.
"You're... beautiful," Tian Yang muttered as he gazed upon her flawless figure that looked as though it was sculpted by the Heavens themselves.
Her slender figure, porcelain-like skin, and a gaze so alluring it could soften even the coldest heart made her undeniably captivating.

Sun Rouxi was certainly beautiful, though not in a way that demanded attention at first glance like Ren Xia. Instead, she possessed a quiet allure—one that deepened and grew more enchanting the longer one looked.
"Stop staring so much..." Sun Rouxi muttered as she covered her bashful expression with her arms, but her subconscious actions left her twin peaks exposed.
With Sun Rouxi's naked breasts beckoning his attention, Tian Yang could no longer control himself and immediately buried his face in them.
"Ah?!" Sun Rouxi released a surprised moan at the sudden sensation, her entire body shivering in delight.
"Mmm~!"
Sun Rouxi gently bit her lips as Tian Yang feasted upon her body like a starving beast.
Many minutes later, once Sun Rouxi was completely soaked downstairs, Tian Yang readied his sword and positioned it before her cave.
His gaze met hers, and after a moment of silence, Sun Rouxi quietly nodded her head.
After confirming her desire, Tian Yang no longer hesitated and pushed his sword into her entrance, penetrating deeply and drawing blood.
"Aaah~!" Sun Rouxi released her loudest moan yet.
"Tian Yang~!" She suddenly wrapped her arms around his body and embraced him tightly, her body trembling nonstop.
Tian Yang embraced her back before moving his body. His movements were slow and gentle at first, but as pleasure consumed him, his pace gradually quickened.
Even though this was her first time, Sun Rouxi showcased surprisingly high endurance, and the two of them went on to cultivate nonstop for the next several days.
"If I were to go back in time and tell my past self about today, I doubt she'd believe me, even if beaten to death," Sun Rouxi suddenly joked as they rested on the bed, their body soaked in sweat.
Tian Yang chuckled before agreeing with her.
After that day, the two of them would always visit the bedroom after their study session, which became even more frequent.
"Congratulations. It looks like two of you have finally become real partners," Jing Ruye said to Sun Rouxi after noticing a change in her aura.
"Thank you... and I mean for pushing me forward. If it weren't for you, I probably wouldn't have been able to be honest with myself, let alone approach Tian Yang."
"Don't sweat it. This is what sworn sisters are for," she chuckled.
"What is it?" Jing Ruye asked when Sun Rouxi suddenly went silent.
"You... Were you serious before? When you said that you fancied Tian Yang."
"Huh?" Jing Ruye's eyes widened at her unexpected inquiry.
"I know you likely said those things to force me to act, but if they were your true feelings... I wouldn't mind if you also approached him."
After hearing her words, it was Jing Ruye's turn to fall silent.

A moment later, she shook her head with a faint smile. "While it's true that Tian Yang is a very charming man, and I wouldn't mind getting closer to him, my feelings aren't as deep or resolute as yours. Even though we live in the same place and see each other often, we're little more than acquaintances.
"If I were to approach him with such half-hearted feelings, it would be an insult to both you and him."
"If that's how you really feel, I won't press further," said Sun Rouxi.
Time continued to flow.
One hundred years... three hundred years... one thousand years.
"Now that I have full mastery of the soul cultivation technique, I just need to actually refine the technique," said Tian Yang. "And in order to do that, I will need to..."
"Enter seclusion, right?" Sun Rouxi continued with a calm smile. He nodded and said, "Unfortunately, I don't know when I'll finish. It could take a year or a thousand years."
"Don't worry. No matter how long it takes, I'll be here to wait for you."
Before entering seclusion, Tian Yang spent a few months with Sun Rouxi and Ren Xia. Of course, they spent most of their time in the bedroom.

A few years after Tian Yang entered seclusion, Ren Xia decided to leave the world to see if there was anything new happening outside. As Ren Xia wandered through a nearby city, she overheard a conversation between some pedestrians, and this piece of information greatly bewildered her.
"Wanna hear something interesting? Apparently, the crimson barrier that sealed off the Giant's Continent for tens of thousands of years suddenly vanished."
"What...?" Ren Xia's entire body stiffened the moment she heard such words.
"Hey! Tell me everything you know about that!" Ren Xia approached these pedestrians and retrieved a handful of spirit stones to show them.
The man swallowed nervously at the sight of the dazzling spirit stones and immediately continued, revealing everything he knew to her.

"I heard it from a friend of mine—a sailing merchant who frequently crosses that area," the man said. "He told me that on his return trip, the crimson dome that was always along his route had suddenly vanished."
"How long ago was this?" "He told me about it three days ago, but it'd been almost two months since he saw it."

Once the man had revealed everything he knew, Ren Xia paid him and immediately wandered off to learn more about the situation. However, even after weeks of asking around, she was unable to find any more information on the Giant's Continent. Therefore, she decided to visit the place herself to confirm the rumors.

Seeing her bashful expression, Tian Yang felt warmth surge through him, as though a raging flame had been lit within his heart.
Without any delay, Tian Yang helped Sun Rouxi undress before removing his own clothes.
"You're... beautiful," Tian Yang muttered as he gazed upon her flawless figure that looked as though it was sculpted by the Heavens themselves.
Her slender figure, porcelain-like skin, and a gaze so alluring it could soften even the coldest heart made her undeniably captivating.
Sun Rouxi was certainly beautiful, though not in a way that demanded attention at first glance like Ren Xia.
Instead, she possessed a quiet allure—one that deepened and grew more enchanting the longer one looked.
"Stop staring so much..." Sun Rouxi muttered as she covered her bashful expression with her arms, but her subconscious actions left her twin peaks exposed.
With Sun Rouxi's naked breasts beckoning his attention, Tian Yang could no longer control himself and immediately buried his face in them.

"Mmm~!"

When you said that you fancied Tian Yang."

chapters.title: Chapter 2321 Overwhelming Bloodlust
paragraphs: Although Ren Xia had decided to see for herself whether the crimson dome had really vanished or not, she didn't immediately head there.
Instead, she returned home first to let Sun Rouxi know of the situation.
"What? The crimson dome has vanished?" Sun Rouxi was unsurprisingly surprised to hear this news.

"It's just a rumor right now, but I am going to confirm it with my own eyes. Although I would love to wait for Tian Yang to emerge from his seclusion before doing anything, we have no way to know when he's coming out, and disturbing him will be dangerous, so I can only do this without him."
"I understand what you're trying to do, but it sounds dangerous," said Sun Rouxi.

"Don't worry, I won't do anything reckless and will only be investigating from afar. Once I confirm that the crimson dome has truly vanished, I will immediately return to wait for Tian Yang before doing anything else."
"Should I come with you just in case?" Sun Rouxi offered to join her.

However, Ren Xia shook her head and said, "No, you should stay here in case Tian Yang comes out early. Moreover, you're being hunted by your family right now, correct? Unless you want to risk being caught, I suggest you stay here, where it's safe."
"If you say so."

Despite being older than Ren Xia, Sun Rouxi couldn't help but view and respect her as an elder sister. Not only was Ren Xia Tian Yang's first partner, but she had also played a crucial role in bringing Sun Rouxi and Tian Yang together.
Ren Xia left shortly after, traveling straight to the Giant's Continent.
"Heavens..." Ren Xia muttered in a daze upon arriving at her destination and witnessing the situation with her own eyes.
"It's really gone..."
The crimson dome that had sealed the Giant's Continent for nearly a hundred thousand years had suddenly vanished without warning. However, that wasn't all.
"Not only did the barrier vanish, but this place... is overflowing with bloodlust!

Despite her vast experience and even having fought the Immortal Clans head-on, Ren Xia couldn't help but tremble in fear as overwhelming bloodlust engulfed the entire continent, a visible red mist seeping from the land like steam rising from boiling water.
"What the hell happened there?" she swallowed nervously.
Although she wanted to use her divine sense to investigate, her instincts screamed at her to leave.
'I have already accomplished what I wanted to here, so there's no point staying here. Let's get out of here before something goes wrong...'
Ren Xia followed her instincts and turned around to leave.
However, right at that moment, Ren Xia suddenly felt a pair of eyes gazing directly at her.
'Fuck!'
Ren Xia didn't even dare to turn around to face the gaze and continued fleeing at maximum speed.
Yet, even without looking, Ren Xia could tell who was looking at her.
'I knew it! That troublesome bastard is still alive!'

Fortunately, the person behind the gaze didn't chase after her, and Ren Xia managed to return to land safely. Even though Ren Xia had returned to land, she didn't look back or stop moving until she returned to her personal world. "So? How did it go?" Sun Rouxi sighed in relief after seeing Ren Xia return safely.

Ren Xia responded while clenching her fists, "The barrier is gone. Not only that, but that place is overflowing with bloodlust. It felt like I was in the presence of a horde of starving wild beasts. Moreover... Kulas is still alive."
"The Giant Emperor? You met him?
Ren Xia shook her head and explained, "No, but I sensed his gaze on me. It was a terrifying feeling. Even now, I can feel his gaze searing my back."
Hearing this, Sun Rouxi fell silent with a pondering expression on her face.
"What are you thinking about?" Ren Xia eventually asked.

"My family. There's no way they don't already know about this, and I am worried about what they might do now that the barrier that stopped their war is gone. Will they pretend the war never happened, or will they try to continue where they left off?"
"It's been nearly a hundred thousand years since the war ended. Do you really think they'll try to restart it after so long?" Ren Xia swallowed nervously.

"Although I don't know why they even want to fight the Giant Race in the first place, I can say with certainty that they despise losing, and not winning the war is no different from losing. So, there's a high possibility that they will restart the war, especially now that they've grown even more powerful."

Sun Rouxi understood her family better than anyone, and sure enough, the Three Pillars of Heaven had learned about the crimson done vanishing months ago and had been preparing to invade the Giant's Continent ever since.
A year later, after completing their preparations, the Three Pillars of Heaven invaded the Giant's Continent with the greatest force they had ever assembled.

However, their army—comprised of ten True Immortals, a hundred Golden Immortals, a thousand Silver and Bronze Immortals, and ten thousand Immortal Ascension cultivators—was annihilated within a single day, sending shockwaves through both the Three Pillars of Heaven and the entire world.
"What?! Our entire force was annihilated in a single day?! That's impossible!" When the news first broke, disbelief was universal, especially among the Three Pillars of Heaven.

"I don't know what happened on the continent, but every Life Tracking Tablet monitoring our forces has been shattered. That only happens when the lives they track are extinguished," revealed one of the elders.

"To defeat so many Immortals in less than a day... this wouldn't be possible even if everyone on that continent were an Immortal," another Elder speculated. "There can only be one explanation—they possess someone who has surpassed the Immortal Realm... someone who has reached the next realm."
The moment this possibility was voiced, the entire hall fell silent, the atmosphere shifting dramatically.

chapters.title: Chapter 2322 The Final Push to the Next Realm
paragraphs: "Until we have an expert beyond the Immortal Realm ourselves, we must avoid fighting with the Giant Race. Fortunately, there's a very high chance that their Giant Emperor won't be able to leave their continent, so as long as we don't approach them, they also can't do anything to us!"
"Shouldn't we give a proper name to the realm beyond the Immortal Realm now? Saying that every time is a mouthful."
"There's only one thing stronger than an Immortal—a God. So why don't we just call it the God Realm?"
"God Realm, huh? Sounds good."

After realizing the possibility that Kulas had achieved the God Realm, the Three Pillars of Heaven instantly halted their assault on the Giant's Continent. However, while they stopped attacking with large forces, they continued to send small groups of assassins and scouts to keep an eye on the Giant Race.
And just as the Three Pillars of Heaven had predicted, the Giant Race remained on the continent, seemingly with zero desire to leave for whatever reason.
Time continued to pass, and after a few more thousand years, Tian Yang emerged from his seclusion.
"I did it! I have managed to refine the soul cultivation technique!"
"I'm glad for you, dear, and as much as I'd like to celebrate, there's something you should know first," said Ren Xia.
The excitement on Tian Yang's face instantly vanished at Ren Xia's ominous words.
"What happened?" he asked in a solemn tone.
"The crimson barrier that has sealed the Giant's Continent for thousands of years is no longer present, and the Three Pillars of Heaven resumed their war with the Giant Race."
"What?! When did this happen?! What about Kulas?!" Tian Yang was full of questions.

"It occurred three thousand years ago, a few years after you entered seclusion. Although the Three Pillars of Heaven attacked shortly after the crimson barrier vanished, they failed miserably and haven't attempted to invade them again. As for Kulas... there's no news of him, but he's definitely alive."
Ren Xia recalled what she experienced when she went to check out the Giant's Continent.
"What? You went to the Giant's Continent by yourself? That's so dangerous and reckless!" Tian Yang exclaimed.
"You're the last person I want to hear that from!" Ren Xia rebuked.
Tian Yang sighed and then said, "I'll deal with that later. First...
He turned to look at Sun Rouxi and said, "Here, let me share the new technique with you. If you cultivate it, your progress will definitely skyrocket."
Sun Rouxi nodded and accepted the new and improved soul cultivation technique.
"What about you?" Tian Yang looked at Ren Xia afterward. "You might be able to learn this technique since it has been tweaked."
"Although I already have a soul cultivation technique that I am cultivating, there's no harm in trying, I guess..."
Tian Yang transferred the technique to her the next moment.
"Are you going to leave now that the technique has been improved?" Tian Yang asked Sun Rouxi some time later.

"I..." Sun Rouxi hesitated for a moment before speaking, "I have given this question much thought ever since I approached you. If our relationship hadn't progressed, I would've definitely returned home. However, now that things are this way, I don't really have any reason to return—No, I have a reason not to return. After all, if I return home, I won't be able to see you again for god-knows-how-long, and I don't want that."
"Rouxi..." A warm smile tugged on Tian Yang's lips.
"But..." Sun Rouxi suddenly continued, "I must warn you that my family will not sit still and will definitely hunt me down. If you don't want to deal with that, then I'll return to my family."
Tian Yang smiled and said, "If I wasn't scared of the Immortal Clans, what makes you think I would be afraid of the Three Pillars of Heaven?"
"My family is nothing like the Immortal Clans. It's like comparing heaven and earth." Sun Rouxi shook her head.
"I know. That's not the point." Tian Yang said with a stiff smile.
"Anyway, I'll deal with the Three Pillars of Heaven if they ever try anything."
Ren Xia then spoke, "As long as their war with the Giant Race continues, I doubt they will have the time to look for you."
She turned to look at Tian Yang and continued, "What are you going to do now?"
"I will go outside to collect more information on the situation. Don't worry, I won't even approach the Giant's Continent until I know of the full situation.
"Alright. Then I'll try to cultivate this soul cultivation technique.
Some time later, Ren Xia and Sun Rouxi entered seclusion while Tian Yang left the world to collect information.
After several years of investigation, Tian Yang learned everything he could and returned home.
"Hm? You're done already?" Tian Yang was surprised to see that both of them had emerged from their seclusion so soon.
"The soul cultivation technique doesn't work for me," Ren Xia said.
"Me neither, even though I can cultivate the original one perfectly fine..." Sun Rouxi sighed, feeling depressed that she couldn't experience the improved technique for some reason.
"Is that so... That's a pity."
"Well, I kind of figured something like this would happen, anyway." Sun Rouxi shrugged.
"So, what now?" Ren Xia asked.

After a moment of silence, Tian Yang spoke, "According to the rumors, Kulas has already reached the next realm, now known as the God Realm. Now that I have improved my soul cultivation technique, I am going to make the final push and attempt to enter the God Realm myself."
Ren Xia and Sun Rouxi nodded, as they also had the same idea.
"Let's play a game. The winner of this race will receive a favor from the other two." Ren Xia suddenly said. "I won't lose this time," said Tian Yang.
"A favor, huh? I'm in." Sun Rouxi nodded.
Thus, the three of them entered seclusion at the same time with the goal of entering the God Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 2323 Entering the God Realm
paragraphs: A thousand years... ten thousand years... a hundred thousand years have passed since Tian Yang and the others entered seclusion to break through to the next realm.
Despite how much time has passed, nobody has yet to emerge from their seclusion.

"I have enough Celestial Qi, and my Soul Strength is even stronger than my Celestial Qi at this point. In fact, I can even feel myself standing only a step away from the God Ream. Yet, I cannot take that final step for some reason. I am missing something, but what?" Although he only needed to take one more step to enter godhood, Tian Yang wouldn't figure out how to take that step for another five thousand years.
But eventually, he takes that final step and enters the God Realm.
"I have achieved it! The God Realm!" Tian Yang trembled with excitement as his entire body surged with Celestial Qi.
However, now that he had truly entered the God Realm, he could immediately tell that it was not the end—that beyond it stretched even higher levels, waiting to be reached.

After entering the God Realm, Tian Yang left seclusion to see if the other two had finished before him. However, when he walked out of his immortal cave and looked at the other two caves, the entrances were still closed, meaning that he was the first one to have a breakthrough.
"I am first, huh?"
Since he had no way of knowing when they would finish, Tian Yang left his world to gather information about the outside world and the current state of the Giant's Continent.

Although a hundred thousand years passed in the blink of an eye for Tian Yang, it was a tremendous amount of time for everyone else. In fact, the cultivation world experienced a tremendous surge in growth roughly fifty thousand years ago, when the Three Pillars of Heaven began sharing their cultivation techniques with others. Of course, these techniques were not given freely, and only those who agreed to ally with them in the war against the Giant Race were granted access.

As the Three Pillars of Heaven and the cultivation world continued to progress, the Giant Race remained quiet within their territory. But despite their seemingly secluded life, the Three Pillars of Heaven remained vigilant toward them, especially since none of their scouts had made it back.

Over the past hundred thousand years, the Three Pillars of Heaven launched two full-scale assaults on the Giant's Continent. The first came twenty thousand years after their initial invasion, but when it failed just as miserably, they waited another seventy thousand years before attempting a second assault.
For their second assault, they had help from other powers. Yet, not a single one of them managed to make it out of the Giant's Continent alive.
Moreover, Tian Yang learned that the cultivators from the Three Pillars of Heaven were still trying to enter the God Realm and that he was the first in this world, besides Kulas, to reach this level.

Although the Three Pillars of Heaven had decided not to attack the Giant's Continent until they also had a cultivator in the God Realm after their first failure, they became impatient and attacked anyway.

After preparing himself, Tian Yang used the communication technique to contact Shura.
Several minutes after the summoning, Tian Yang found his consciousness drifting through the starry sky like the previous two times.
"It's been a while, Senior Shura." Tian Yang greeted first.
"Senior? I may be much older than you, but I do not care about mortal customs. Just call me by my name," said Shura.
"I understand, Shura."
"Looks like you have finally achieved the realm of godhood—at least in mortal terms. Now, I can finally tell you about my goal."
"Before that, I want to tell you the name of the Eternal who is messing with my friend. His name is Zaaran.
"Zaaran, huh? He's a tough one to deal with... No, quite frankly, I don't think there's anything I can do to him, and it's not because I lack the power to deal with him."
"Then why?" Tian Yang asked with a frown on his face.

"He's under a different group, and the leader of that group is even more troublesome, especially since he's one of the three most powerful Eternals in the universe. Although I can speak with Zaaran, I cannot force him to stop, and he's not the type who listens to others who aren't in his group."

Tian Yang fell silent after hearing the situation from Shura. Although he didn't want to say it, fearing it might offend Shura, Tian Yang no longer had a reason to help now that Shura couldn't assist him with Kulas. 'It would be safer if I just say that I'll continue to help him...' he thought to himself.
Shura continued, "While I cannot directly help you with your friend, I can tell you Zaaran's weakness and how you can remove his influence from your friend."
"Oh?" Tian Yang's eyes flickered with excitement and hope upon hearing such words.

"Zaaran's weakness is the Yin Element. As long as you destroy the connection between Zaaran and your friend, you will be able to sever Zaaran's influence. I will also teach you a technique that will allow you to sense said connection."
Shura immediately transferred a technique into Tian Yang's mind.

"I gave you an additional gift to make up for my lack of ability. It will allow you to sense an Eternal's influence. In other words, you will know if you come across a mortal influenced by an Eternal as long as you touch them."
Tian Yang was pleasantly surprised by the additional gift. In fact, this second gift was incredibly useful, as it allowed him to know if someone had been influenced by an Eternal.

"There is one thing you must keep in mind about that power. Although it can sense an Eternal's influence, it will only work on those weaker than me or near my level, so you won't be able to sense it if that Eternal is much stronger than me," Shura warned.

chapters.title: Chapter 2324 Absolute Power
paragraphs: After hearing Shura's words, Tian Yang asked, "If you don't mind me asking, how strong are you compared to the others?"
Shura pondered for a moment before responding in a confident voice, "I am likely amongst the top ten strongest Eternals out there."
"That's pretty impressive, no?"
"Of course, it is."

"Alright. Then what about your goal? What are you trying to look for? Is it the same thing that Zaaran is after?" Tian Yang suddenly asked, trying to catch Shura off guard with his straightforward question.
Yet, Shura calmly responded with a clear voice, "Yes, it is the same thing. In fact, every Eternal that is involved in your world are all looking for the same thing."
Hearing this, Tian Yang couldn't fathom what was in his world that could possibly attract the attention of these god-like entities.
"Aboslute Power." Shura spoke a moment later, revealing his goal, his voice full of longing.
"It is a power left behind by the Absolute Being, the strongest Eternal to ever exist."
Tian Yang suddenly felt fatigued after learning of this information.
'My longevity had been sacrificed! And so much of it!' he cried inwardly, feeling like hundreds of millions of years had been taken from him.
If he hadn't reached the God Realm, this forbidden knowledge would've definitely killed him, even if he didn't know the limit of his longevity.

"If you—and all these other Eternals—desire this Absolute Power so much, why don't you just come here and get it yourself rather than letting someone do it? Not only are you messing with our lives, but aren't you afraid that we might steal the power for ourselves?" Tian Yang asked after recovering some of his energy.
Shura burst out laughing at Tian Yang's words and said loudly, "If we were able to enter your world, we would've done so ages ago!

"Unfortunately, the power of the Absolute Being prohibits us from getting close to your world. Our influence is also limited within your world, so we can only rely on the mortals to act as our limbs. And since most Eternals see mortals as nothing but tools, they don't care about what happens to your people and are willing to go to extreme lengths to fulfill their own desire."
Tian Yang gritted his teeth and clenched his fists in frustration after learning the reason behind the Eternals' activities within their world.
"So the reason Zaaran destroyed Kulas' and his family's lives is just so he could find this Absolute Power? So they can become more powerful? What bullshit!" Tian Yang roared at the injustice.
Shura then replied, "The Absolute Power doesn't just make us more powerful. It will literally make us the most powerful entity in this entire universe."
"You guys are already powerful enough! Why do you need to become more powerful, let alone the most powerful being in the universe?!" Tian Yang asked.

"For the same reason you mortals continue to seek greater power. For the same reason the wealthy endlessly amass more wealth. For the same reason you pursued the God Realm even after attaining immortality," Shura said. "Instinct and nature drive us all—we are no different in that regard. It is never enough... and it never will be."
Tian Yang couldn't argue with Shura, as there was no fault in his words.
After a moment of silence, Tian Yang asked, "Can you tell me more about this Absolute Being?"
"I would, but you lack longevity."
"I still lack longevity? Even though I've reached the God Realm?" TIan Yang was speechless.
"Now that you've entered the God Realm, you should be aware that you're only at the lowest level, and that there are more steps to climb before you truly achieve godhood."
Of course, Tian Yang was already aware of this fact. The cultivation realms before God Realm were all the same, so why would this realm be any different?

"With that being said, there's really no reason to sacrifice so much longevity just to learn about the Absolute Being. You already know the most important thing—that he was the most powerful being in this universe. Why do you need to know more? Why seek knowledge you have no use for?
"That's..." Tian Yang didn't know how to respond.
After a moment of silence, he sighed, "You're right. Then can you tell me how to find this Absolute Power?"
Shura shook his head and said, "Unfortunately, nobody knows how to find it. We are only certain that it exists within your world, but that is the limit of our knowledge."
"Can't say I'm surprised..." Tian Yang muttered. If the Eternals knew the location of the Absolute Power, they would've already acquired it long ago.
"Then what does it look like? And how would I know that I am close to it?" he then asked.

"Since nobody has ever seen the Absolute Power with their eyes, nobody knows what it looks like, but you should know that you've stumbled upon it the moment you do, since it will be unlike anything you've seen before."

"What? Not only do you not know of its location, but you don't even know what it looks like? You might as well tell me to find a ghost!" "If you are thinking that the Absolute Power is in the form of a treasure or something similar, then you are wrong. It has no physical form. Also, since it has the power to restrict an Eternal's power, then you will feel your powers weaken when you are near it, as I have gifted you some of my powers before."
"Your gift? You mean my ability to weaken another Eternal's influence?" Tian Yang remarked. "How would I know if such a power weakens when I can't even feel it?"
"What did you just say?"
Even though Tian Yang couldn't see Shura's face, he could somehow tell that there was a frown on it right this moment.
Shura continued speaking in a stern voice, "The power to weaken an Eternal's influence? I never gave you such a power! Explain yourself!"
