chapters.title: Chapter 2325 Searching for the Absolute Power
paragraphs: "Huh? You didn't give me such an ability?" Tian Yang wore a dumbfounded look on his face after hearing this. "But that's what Zaaran said."

"I don't care what Zaaran said! That bastard is too stupid to think because if he could, then he would know that I have no such powers! In fact, the only Eternal with the ability to weaken another Eternal's influence is the Absolute Being!" Shura responded. "Now! Explain to me why you think you have such power!" he urged.
Tian Yang nodded and proceeded to explain what happened with Kulas—how Kulas would fall sick when he left, and how Zaaran's influence would weaken whenever he was nearby.
"HAHAHAHA!"
Shura burst out laughing after learning everything, his loud voice shaking the starry sky and Tian Yang's very soul.
"Tian Yang, you little bastard! Not have you already come across the Absolute Power, but you have likely even come into contact with it!" Shura revealed loudly, unable to contain his excitement.
"What?! I don't remember doing such a thing!" Tian Yang exclaimed. "Are you sure it's not a misunderstanding?"

"No, I am certain. I just checked your body for my power, but as expected, it's not there. My power inside your body has been extinguished by the Absolute Being's power! That, or my power never even reached you!"
"Try to retrace your steps! Do you remember coming into contact with anything otherworldly?"
Tian Yang closed his eyes and recalled his entire life. Yet, he was unable to find anything like that.
"No, but since I don't know what the Absolute Power looks like, there's no way for me to really know."

Shura sighed, "I would look through your memories myself, but with the Absolute Power shielding you, I won't be able to do such a thing. But this is still a great thing, since we know that you've come across it before, so it will only be a matter of time before we find it."
Tian Yang could see Shura's massive silhouette trembling with immense excitement.

Seeing this, he couldn't help but wonder if he could take the Absolute Being's powers for himself. That way, he would finally have the power to fight back these Eternals. However, he also wasn't sure if he could even acquire such unfathomable power as a mortal.
The Eternals wouldn't use mortals to find the Absolute Power if the mortals even had a slight chance of obtaining it for themselves, after all.
"So, what now?" Tian Yang asked.

"What...? I'm not sure, since this changes everything." Shura said. "You're likely the closest being to finding the Absolute Power right now, so I will give you my full support. Once you find it and I acquire it, I will grant you any wish you want. With the Absolute Being's power, literally anything is possible."
Tian Yang suddenly realized something and said, "If you take the Absolute Power... will our world still be safe from the Eternals?"

After a moment of silence, Shura spoke, "The Absolute Being's influence will probably linger for some more time, but it will definitely disappear eventually. However, without the Absolute Power, the Eternals will no longer have a reason to bother you. I can also promise to continue protecting your world with the power."
"Okay," Tian Yang nodded.
Of course, he didn't completely trust Shura even at this point. In fact, he was still thinking about acquiring the power for himself.

"Anyway, you need to retrace your steps. Return to every place that you've been to," Shura then said. "I also want you to contact me at every location. If I don't respond to you, then it's because you're near the Absolute Being's power."
"I will do just that then."

"I would grant you more powers to assist you, but as long as you are influenced by the Absolute Being's powers, we, Eternals, won't be able to influence you. Until next time, my fateful little friend."
Shura ended their connection at that point.

After Tian Yang returned to his world, he wanted to immediately start looking for the Absolute Power. However, he couldn't just disappear without a word. Jing Ruye was in seclusion as well, so he couldn't rely on her.
Instead of waiting for them to emerge from their cultivation, Tian Yang wrote on the ground with a sword, telling them that he will be out for some time.
Once he was done, Tian Yang left his personal world and began retracing his steps.
However, because of the situation at Giant's Continent, he had no choice but to skip that place as well.
"If I am going to retrace my steps, I might as well start from the very beginning."
With that thought in mind, Tian Yang returned to his origin—in the small village that he'd grown up in with Meng Lili.
However, since it'd been over a hundred thousand years since he left, when he returned, the village was no longer what he remembered. In fact, it had completely vanished from the face of the earth.
After taking a moment to reminisce his memories of Meng Lili, Tian Yang contacted Shura.
A few minutes later, Shura responded to his call.
"I am in the village where I grew up after my parents abandoned me. This is where I will be starting my search for the Absolute Being's power," he revealed to Shura.
"I understand."
Shura ended the connection immediately, leaving no room for conversation.
Now that he'd confirmed the Absolute Power wasn't present at his village, Tian Yang traveled to his next destination, the Immortal Monastery.
'Now that I think about it, I haven't returned to the Immortal Monastery ever since that incident...' Tian Yang thought to himself as he hovered before the Immortal Monastery.

Although the Immortal Monastery was completely different from the one in his memories since they had to rebuild after a certain incident, at least it was still there, and it even appeared to be doing even better than before it was nearly destroyed by the Immortal Clans.

chapters.title: Chapter 2326 Searching for the Absolute Power(2)
paragraphs: Shortly after arriving at the Immortal Monastery, Tian Yang contacted Shura.
"I am currently at the Immortal Monastery, where I spent the majority of my youth."
"I see."
Shura ended the connection almost instantly.
Tian Yang didn't immediately travel to the next destination. Instead, he lingered at the Immortal Monastery, silently observing them from the sky.

Although most of the sect had changed, he recognized several buildings and areas, such as the Bamboo Garden, which managed to survive the Immortal Clan's attack due to it being disconnected from the main part of the sect.
After lingering above the sect for some time, Tian Yang noticed a presence approaching him from the sect.

A few moments later, a middle-aged man with sharp facial features stopped before Tian Yang and greeted, "Greetings. I am the Sect Master of this sect, Wu Wing. Do you have any business with the Immortal Monastery?"

The middle-aged man, the current Sect Master of the Immortal Monastery, sensed Tian Yang's presence as soon as he arrived. Yet, he assumed Tian Yang was simply passing by and ignored him. But when Tian Yang lingered, however, he had no choice but to approach.
Moreover, since Tian Yang was in the God Realm and the Sect Master was only at the True Immortal realm, he couldn't sense Tian Yang's cultivation level.
'I can't sense his cultivation even though we're so close!' The Sect Master cried inwardly after realizing this.
"I used to be a disciple here," Tian Yang calmly replied. "Before this place was renovated, that is. Are you responsible for rebuilding this place?"
The Sect Master's eyes widened slightly at Tian Yang's words.
"You're a first generation disciple? Then you're my Senior! What happened in the past must've been traumatic for you..."
"No, I was away at that time and managed to avoid it." Tian Yang shook his head.

"Is that so... Anyway, to answer your question, no, I am not responsible for what you are seeing now. It was the last Sect Master and the disciples who stayed that did all of the work. I only replaced him a few years ago."
"So you're the third Sect Master, huh? Well, I was only reminiscing about the past. I apologize if my presence bothered you."
"There's no way! You're a first generation disciple! If anything, it's an honor to have you! Would you like a tour around the sect?" Wu Wing suddenly asked.
Tian Yang didn't immediately give a response.
After pondering for a moment, he nodded, "Alright. I have some time.
Wu Wing then led Tian Yang to their front gate and started giving a tour himself.
"What was life like in the sect back then?" Wu Wing asked as they toured the sect.
Tian Yang recalled his own experience and the atmosphere of the sect and its disciples back then, comparing them to what he was looking at now.
"What about the first sect master—our ancestor? What was he like?"

Tian Yang shook his head and said, "Unfortunately, I never got to meet him. But from what I heard, he was an ambitious individual who deeply cared for the sect and wanted it to stand at the top of the world."
He then asked, "What happened to him after the incident?"
"The Ancestor has been in seclusion ever since the previous Sect Master took power."
"So he's still at the sect?" Tian Yang raised an eyebrow.
"Yes, that's right. However, he hasn't left for over a hundred thousand years. Honestly, we don't know if he's even still alive..."
Tian Yang suddenly shifted his head to look in a certain direction. It was subtle, but he could sense a powerful aura coming from the direction, and it was still within the sect.
"He's still alive," Tian Yang calmly said.
Wu Wing's eyes widened with shock.
"Y-You can tell?!"
Tian Yang offered a silent confirmation.
"Thank you, Senior!"
Wu Wing bowed to him.
"By the way, I haven't heard your name yet."
"My name..." Tian Yang hesitated for a moment before responding with a fake name. "...is Xiao Yang."
Since he was the reason the Immortal Clans uprooted the Immortal Monastery, he didn't dare to reveal his real name, as there was a good chance the Sect Master would recognize him.
"Senior Xiao, then."
They continued to tour the sect.
Since the Sect Master himself was leading Tian Yang, their presence instantly attracted the attention of the disciples.
"Who is that man besides the Sect Master?"
"I have never seen the Sect Master smile like that before!"
Even the Sect Elders were intrigued by Tian Yang's identity, but none of them dared to approach.
Eventually, they finished touring the sect.
"Thank you for today, Sect Master. I am truly glad to see the Immortal Monastery, where I grew up, has become such a magnificent place."
"It was a pleasure to meet you today, Senior Xiao. I have learned a lot about our own sect, even some lost knowledge. If you ever feel like visiting again, our sect will always welcome you."
The Sect Master retrieved a medallion and offered it to him.
"As long as you have this medallion, you will be an honored guest at the Immortal Monastery."
"Thank you."
Tian Yang didn't linger and set off to his next destination.
A few days later, he arrived at a city near a vast ocean. Despite how much time has passed, the place looked almost identical to when he last visited.
This was where people went if they wanted to travel to the Giant's Continent and where Tian Yang first met Huang Xiao Li and her family.
He contacted Shura shortly after arriving.
The connection went through, but they didn't exchange any words, as Shura closed the connection almost immediately afterward.
"The only place to check now would be the Giant's Continent, but..." Tian Yang pondered for a moment before flying across the vast ocean and towards the Giant's Continent.
A few days later, he stopped when he could see his destination at the horizon. Yet, he didn't try to get any closer and stared at it from a distance with wide eyes.
Even without needing to get close, he could sense an intense and malicious aura coming from the continent.
2-3 chapters a day in March!

chapters.title: Chapter 2327 Searching for the Absolute Power(3)
paragraphs: "I don't even need to get close to it to sense Zaaran's influence that envelopes this entire place..." Tian Yang sighed.
"Kulas... are you still alive?"

After lingering for some time, Tian Yang tried to contact Shura. Although he wasn't on Giant's Continent, he was close enough. If the Absolute Being's powers existed on the Giant's Continent, it would likely still affect him to some extent.
A minute later, Shura responded to his call.
"I am currently at the Giant's Continent, where I have spent the majority of my life."
Once again, Shura ended the connection without a word.
Afterward, Tian Yang prepared to visit other places. However, just as he turned around and began flying away, he sensed a powerful gaze directed at him.
Tian Yang instantly halted his movements and turned around to face the gaze that was coming from the Giant's Continent.
The gaze felt familiar yet foreign at the same time.
"Kulas... No... Zaaran!" Tian Yang gritted his teeth and clenched his fists in frustration.
Now that he was in the God Realm, he was able to penetrate the invisible barrier that surrounded the Giant's Continent and blocked off surveillance, looking directly into it with divine sense.
When Tian Yang used his divine sense to observe the situation, he was left utterly shocked by what he saw.

A massive gathering had formed around Colossal Mammoth City. Nearly the entire Giant Race surrounded it, their colossal bodies bowed in deep prostration as they worshipped the palace—or whatever resided within it.
When Tian Yang looked deeper and extended his divine sense inside the palace, he could see a massive silhouette seated in Kulas' room, silently staring back at him with crimson eyes.

The instant Tian Yang's gaze met the crimson eyes, a terrifying aura erupted from the silhouette, sending a violent ripple surging outward from the island and nearly lifting the surrounding ocean into the air.
The aura, without doubt, belonged to an expert in the God Realm, but Tian Yang could also sense something otherworldly mixed in.

Tian Yang didn't dare to linger any longer and immediately fled the scene. He could tell just by the aura that he was no match for Zaaran at this moment, so there was no reason to endanger himself by staying there.

The eruption of that terrifying aura didn't just drive Tian Yang away—it also alerted the experts watching the Giant's Continent from nearby islands, most of whom belonged to the Three Pillars of Heaven.
Once they sensed the aura, they immediately reported back to the Three Pillars of Heaven, confirming their suspicions that Kulas had reached the God Realm.

Realizing that Kulas had evolved into a powerhouse they could no longer confront on their own, the Three Pillars of Heaven began aggressively forming alliances, claiming that the Giant Race would soon launch an invasion on the human race.
In truth, they had no concrete evidence that such an invasion would occur. The claim was merely a pretext—one used to further their own agenda. Little did they know, they were right on the money.
Tian Yang continued to backtrack his steps for the next few years, returning to every single location he'd gone in the past.
Unfortunately, even after going to every location, he was unable to find the Absolute Being's power.

"I have been to every location except one, but I no longer have access to that place," Tian Yang explained to Shura at the last location. "Han Zexian's Tomb. It existed on the Giant's Continent before, but it has since disappeared."
Shura then spoke, "The Absolute Power isn't at that place."
"How do you know?" Tian Yang asked.
"Because the Absolute Power is too powerful to be contained in a small dimension like that. Moreover, you were able to contact me in the past from that location."
"Oh, right... I almost forgot about that. Then what should I do now?"

Shura pondered for a moment before responding, "The Absolute Power might have sealed your memories—at least the part where you found it. The only way for you to fight the Absolute Power and regain your memories is to gain the power of Eternals."

"What?" Tian Yang's eyes widened at such words. "But I am a mortal. How can I obtain the power of an Eternal, much less wield it? Also, I thought that an Eternal's power is useless against the Absolute Power, so how can I possibly...

"Frankly, I don't know if it's possible for a mortal to wield our power. However, it's worth trying. As for your other concern... I am also just guessing. There's a chance it might work and a chance it won't. There's no way of knowing until you try. I'll tell you more once you reach the next level."
"Alright..."
The connection ended there and Tian Yang returned home.

Upon returning to his own world, Tian Yang immediately resumed cultivation. Unable to contend with Kulas at his current level, he had no choice but to break through to the next realm, not to mention his situation with Shura.

Unfortunately, that was far easier said than done. Although Tian Yang knew exactly what was required for the next level, the demands were so immense that reaching it within any meaningful timeframe was all but impossible.
Yet, he had no choice but to try. Moreover, Ren Xia and Sun Rouxi had yet to emerge from their seclusion, so there wasn't anything else he could do.
Five thousand years... ten thousand years... twenty thousand years after Tian Yang entered the God Realm, Sun Rouxi emerged from her seclusion.
"Congratulations on your breakthrough."
Tian Yang could sense her breakthrough even before she emerged, so he was prepared to greet her the moment she came out of her immortal cave.
"How long has it been since your breakthrough?" Sun Rouxi asked him with a defeated smile after realizing that she wasn't first.
"About twenty thousand years, I guess."
"If I had been able to cultivate the improved soul cultivation technique, I would've definitely come out first," she sighed.
"Most likely." Tian Yang nodded, not refuting it.

chapters.title: Chapter 2328 What Makes Them Different?
paragraphs: After Sun Rouxi emerged from her seclusion, Tian Yang briefed her about the current situation in the world, as well as his current goal.

"What? You're already aiming for the next level when you've just entered the God Realm?" Sun Rouxi looked at him with concern. "I know it's natural for cultivators to always seek advancement, but you seem unusually rushed. Is this because of Kulas?"

Since Tian Yang only revealed the information of Eternals to Ren Xia, Sun Rouxi was unaware of his full situation. However, she could tell that he was keeping something from her. Yet, she didn't pursue it and patiently waited for him to reveal it once he was prepared.
"Something like that," Tian Yang nodded.
"I know I am just wasting my breath by saying this, but don't push yourself too hard."

"I won't. I have already gotten past the hardest part, which is entering the God Realm. Now, it's mostly a trial of endurance and patience since it'll likely take twice as long to reach the next level."

Now that Sun Rouxi had emerged from her cultivation, Tian Yang's daily routine changed slightly. Rather than spending all of his time cultivating, he would occasionally spend some time with her in the bedroom.
Time continued to pass, and after another twenty thousand years, Ren Xia also came out of her Immortal Cave, her cultivation now at the God Realm.
"I'm last...?" Ren Xia sighed with a defeated look after realizing that she was the last to enter the God Realm.
"Tian Yang was first," Sun Rouxi said.
"I guess we both owe you a favor then. Of course, you still owe me one, in case you forgot," Ren Xia said, reminding him of their previous bet.
"Don't worry, I haven't forgotten," said Tian Yang before he briefed her on the situation.
"What? You visited the Giant's Continent? I know I don't have the right to criticize you since I did the same thing, but... Haaah...!" Ren Xia sighed out loud.
"I didn't go inside, but I saw the situation inside the continent with my divine sense," Tian Yang continued before explaining exactly what he saw to Ren Xia.
Ren Xia shivered after learning the situation and said, "I guess the illness has spread to the rest of the Giant Race. I don't even want to imagine what they might do next."
"The Three Pillars of Heaven believe the Giant Race will invade our land," said Tian Yang.
Sun Rouxi shook her head and said, "Knowing them, they are saying that just to make forming alliances easier."
"Even if that's true, I also think that the Giant Race will invade our land soon. They are looking for something, and they will stop at nothing to achieve their goal," Tian Yang sighed.
"What are they looking for?" Ren Xia asked with a raised eyebrow. "And how do you know?"
"I... spoke with 'that'." Tian Yang gave a vague response since Sun Rouxi was present and he didn't want to reveal the forbidden knowledge so suddenly.
"That...?" Sun Rouxi looked at him with a confused expression.
Meanwhile, Ren Xia immediately understood what he meant and nodded, "I see."
She looked at Sun Rouxi a moment later and spoke, "Don't you think we should tell her about 'that'? She's in the God Realm, so she has enough longevity."
Tian Yang and Sun Rouxi's gaze met the next second.
"There's something we've been keeping a secret from you because it contains knowledge that requires you to sacrifice your longevity to learn."
"I knew you were hiding something from me, but to think it was something like this... Alright, tell me. I don't care if I have to sacrifice some of my lifespan," Sun Rouxi quickly came to a decision.
Tian Yang nodded and revealed the existence of Eternals to her, as well as Kulas' real situation. However, he kept the knowledge about the Absolute Being and its power a secret for the time being.
"Eternals, huh?" Sun Rouxi muttered with a slightly surprised look on her face.
"You're not as shocked as I expected," Ren Xia remarked.

She shrugged lightly. "I've spent most of my life surrounded by outrageous things, so I've grown somewhat resistant to this sort of revelation. In fact, now that I know about Eternals, I've finally solved one of the biggest mysteries of my life."

"What's that?" Tian Yang inquired. "The Enlightened One," she replied with a solemn face. "He claims to receive revelations and teachings from Heaven, and despite his undeniable results, I have always been skeptical of it. However, things are different now."
"So you think that the Enlightened One is being backed by an Eternal?" Ren Xia remarked.
"It's highly likely," Tian Yang said.

"According to Shura, all of the Eternals are looking for the same thing within our world, and since they cannot approach our world for whatever reason, they require someone already here to do their bidding. In return, they'd grant their puppet power and knowledge."
"Is that so..." Sun Rouxi mumbled with a pondering face.
"By the way, are you feeling okay?" Tian Yang suddenly asked as he looked at Sun Rouxi.
"Hm? I feel fine. Why do you ask?" she calmly replied.
"Seriously? You don't feel even a little fatigued after sacrificing your longevity?" Tian Yang looked at her with wide eyes.

Sun Rouxi nodded and said, "I know what it feels like to have an unnatural amount of your longevity vanish in the blink of an eye, but I didn't feel anything like that. In fact, I don't think I had to sacrifice any longevity."
Tian Yang's jaw dropped after hearing her words. Sun Rouxi's situation was exactly the same as Ren Xia.
'Their longevity isn't being sacrificed even after learning about Eternals? How is that possible?' Tian Yang cried inwardly.

He was certain that those he forced to learn the forbidden knowledge had died after having all of their longevity sacrificed, so what makes Sun Rouxi and Ren Xia so different? 'Is it because I cultivated with them?'
A weird thought suddenly entered his mind.

"I've spent most of my life surrounded by outrageous things, so I've grown somewhat resistant to this sort of revelation.
In fact, now that I know about Eternals, I've finally solved one of the biggest mysteries of my life."
"What's that?" Tian Yang inquired.
"The Enlightened One," she replied with a solemn face.
"He claims to receive revelations and teachings from Heaven, and despite his undeniable results, I have always been skeptical of it.
However, things are different now."
"So you think that the Enlightened One is being backed by an Eternal?" Ren Xia remarked.
"It's highly likely," Tian Yang said.

"According to Shura, all of the Eternals are looking for the same thing within our world, and since they cannot approach our world for whatever reason, they require someone already here to do their bidding.
In return, they'd grant their puppet power and knowledge."
"Is that so..." Sun Rouxi mumbled with a pondering face.
"By the way, are you feeling okay?" Tian Yang suddenly asked as he looked at Sun Rouxi.
"Hm?
I feel fine.
Why do you ask?" she calmly replied.
"Seriously?
You don't feel even a little fatigued after sacrificing your longevity?" Tian Yang looked at her with wide eyes.
Sun Rouxi nodded and said, "I know what it feels like to have an unnatural amount of your longevity vanish in the blink of an eye, but I didn't feel anything like that.
In fact, I don't think I had to sacrifice any longevity."
Tian Yang's jaw dropped after hearing her words.
Sun Rouxi's situation was exactly the same as Ren Xia.
'Their longevity isn't being sacrificed even after learning about Eternals?
How is that possible?' Tian Yang cried inwardly.

He was certain that those he forced to learn the forbidden knowledge had died after having all of their longevity sacrificed, so what makes Sun Rouxi and Ren Xia so different? 'Is it because I cultivated with them?'
A weird thought suddenly entered his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 2329 The Giant Race Invades!
paragraphs: 'There's no point overthinking about something I have no clue about. I should just treat it as a happy miracle that neither of them had their longevity sacrificed,' Tian Yang thought to himself and immediately stopped pondering about it.
"So what's our plan now?" Ren Xia asked some time later.
Tian Yang explained to her that he was already trying to advance to the next stage of God Realm.

"I met Kulas—Zaaran when I visited the Giant's Continent. Not directly, but I immediately knew that I lacked the power to stop him at my current level. If I want to have any hope of stopping him, I need to reach the next level before him."
"The next stage, huh? That'll probably take you another hundred thousand years if not two or three," Ren Xia remarked.
"What do you plan on doing then?" Tian Yang asked.

"Well, I can follow your lead and immediately continue my cultivation, but I need to stretch my body for a little first." Ren Xia responded before she suddenly grabbed his robes and started dragging him away. "You can continue your cultivation... after you spend a few years with me."
"You..." Tian Yang was speechless.
Ren Xia looked at Sun Rouxi and added, "You had plenty of 'alone time' with him for the last twenty thousand years, so you won't mind if I hog him for a few years, right?"
Sun Rouxi could only silently shake her head with a smile on her face.
"I'll work on my cultivation techniques and see if I can improve Heaven's Indomitable Soul," she said a moment later.
Thus, Ren Xia dragged Tian Yang into her bedroom, where they would cultivate with each other countless times for the next decade.

Once Ren Xia had her full and was satisfied, she finally released Tian Yang. However, right as Tian Yang prepared to enter another seclusion, Jing Ruye emerged from her seclusion with a defeated look on her face.
"I... don't think I have what it takes to enter the God Realm," she released a defeated sigh.

"Hell, I'd only managed to get to True Immortal because of Sister Rouxi. If it hadn't been for her assistance and the countless treasures she gave me, I doubt I would've ever entered the Immortal Realm."
"It's too early to give up. Most cultivators don't successfully break through on their first seclusion," Sun Rouxi tried to encourage her.

"That may be true for the other realms, but the God Realm is a real bottleneck for the untalented. It draws a line between the mediocre and those truly destined for cultivation. Forget entering the God Realm; after all this time I still can't sense Celestial Qi."
"Even if you give up on yourself, I won't give up on you, so I will personally guide you," said Sun Rouxi.
"You really don't need to..."
"I have plenty of time, anyway."
"Thank you... Sister Rouxi..."
Thus, Sun Rouxi added guiding Jing Ruye into her routine, and Tian Yang entered seclusion again.
A few weeks later, Ren Xia decided to leave the private world to wander the outside for a breath of fresh air.
Yet, days after she left, Ren Xia immediately returned to the world.
"It's finally happened! The Giant Race has left their continent and begun their invasion!" Ren Xia interrupted Sun Rouxi and Jing Ruye's lecture, dumbfounding them with this news.
"When did this happen? What is my family's response?" Sun Rouxi immediately inquired about the Three Pillars of Heaven's reaction.

"It started literally yesterday. The Three Pillars of Heaven response is what you're likely thinking right now. They, alongside their alliance, are going to fight. It's war. A real large-scale war between powerful cultivators. This is unprecedented.

"Heavens... this will wreak catastrophic havoc across the world. Countless innocent lives will be lost..." Jing Ruye covered her mouth, stunned by the thought of the chaos the war would bring. Any battle between two Immortals was devastating enough—she couldn't fathom hundreds, perhaps thousands, of them clashing simultaneously across the land.
Sun Rouxi was speechless, but the disgust on her face was as clear as day.
"Why do things like this have to happen when Tian Yang isn't available? He's definitely cursed." Ren Xia sighed.
Sun Rouxi then said, "Fortunately, it hasn't been long since he entered seclusion, so it'll likely be fine even if we disturb him. In fact, the faster we do it the better."

Ren Xia shook her head and said, "Even if he comes out of seclusion right now, there's nothing he can really do unless he's powerful enough to stop their leader—Kulas." Sun Rouxi opened her mouth only to close it without uttering a word.
"Let's just watch and let it play out for now," Ren Xia spoke a moment later.
"You're right. There's no need to act recklessly when we have little to no option at this moment."
Thus, Ren Xia and Sun Rouxi decided to let the war play out and watch from the shadows.

Although the Giant Race had finally left their land and visited the human world for the first time in tens of thousands of years, they didn't invade all at once. They began by sending only a few giants to wreak havoc—seemingly testing the waters. Even so, the Three Pillars of Heaven and their allies struggled immensely, as it took dozens of experts at the Immortal Realm to handle a single giant at the same level.

Of course, it didn't take long for the humans to realize just how powerful the Giant Race had become. Every single giant they fought were literally unstoppable, as they all resembled a madman who lost all reason and only acted upon their primal instinct. "What the hell is wrong with these giants?! They don't react even after getting stabbed or losing their limbs! Even beasts run away or react to pain! It's like we're fighting undead beings!"

The giants were so relentless that the only way to truly stop them was to destroy their heart or smash their brains. Otherwise, they would continue to struggle even if they lost all of their limbs. And this left the Three Pillars of Heaven—the human race absolutely terrified. 2-3 chapters a day in March!

chapters.title: Chapter 2330 The Giant Emperor Enters the Battlefield
paragraphs: "Fucking hell! This monster refuses to give up even when half of his body is missing!"
"D-Don't stop attacking! Stop wasting energy on his limbs and aim only for his heart and head! That's the only way to stop these monsters!"
The Divine Heavens shook throughout the day in multiple regions as the Giant Race invaded and the Human Race attempted to stop them.

The Three Pillars of Heaven had been confident they could crush the Giant Race at any time, but the war quickly shattered that certainty and filled them with unprecedented fear. Realizing they were struggling even while the giants merely tested them with small incursions, they began desperately recruiting more allies.
Those who had doubted the Three Pillars of Heaven's real motive were forced to accept reality after the invasion really happened and agreed to join the alliance.

Thus, the creation of the world's largest alliance was formed, with tens of thousands of large families and sects joining together to fight against the Giant Race. Time passed. With the Giant Race striking only every few years, the humans had time to regroup and breathe—but each invasion saw the giants return stronger than before.
After a thousand years had passed, the Giant Race started invading even more frequently, attacking once a year and in larger numbers.
The Three Pillars of Heaven have tried to negotiate with the Giant Race several times during this period, but all of the messengers they sent to the Giant Continent never returned.
Ten thousand years later, the Giant Race stopped holding back and began invading the rest of the world in mass, instantly overwhelming the humans with their numbers.
With tens of thousands of giants let loose and rampaging around the world, the entire Divine Heavens was quickly engulfed in flames.
Thousands... tens of thousands of people died daily during the invasion, and the number of casualties only increased as the war dragged on.

In the midst of the war, the humans realized that the giants were moving in a pattern and that they only visited new places, meaning that once they explored a certain area, they would not return, almost as if they were searching for something.

Upon realizing this, those who could not fight took shelter in old battlefields. Although most of these places were destroyed beyond recognition, it was at least safe. "These giants are searching for something, and if we find it first, it could turn the tide of the war."
The Three Pillars of Heaven redirected part of their effort to the search, but with no clue what they sought, they were groping in the dark. Yet, that didn't deter them from trying.

After another twenty thousand years, a cultivator from the Three Pillars of Heaven finally reached the God Realm. The world celebrated and recorded the unprecedented event—unaware that three other cultivators had attained the God Realm tens of thousands of years earlier.

With the emergence of this God Realm cultivator, the humans instantly turned the tide of the war, as the cultivator could single-handedly slaughter the giants, who were all still within the Immortal Realm.

However, since there was only one God Realm cultivator, there was only so much he could do against a massive army of giants that were spread throughout the Divine Heavens, not to mention that more giants would constantly invade the land. But as time passed and more cultivators reached the God Realm, the humans started eliminating the giants faster than they could be replaced.

Nearly a hundred thousand years had passed since the Giant Race began their invasion, and just as humanity was regaining confidence, a sudden shift occurred, and for the first time, the Giant Emperor left the Giant Continent while leading an army.
"T-The Giant Emperor is finally taking action for the first time since the beginning of the war!"
"What are their numbers?!"
"T-Ten thousand! This is their biggest invasion yet! The Emperor himself has probably led the remaining forces for one final push!"
"So we've finally reached the end, huh? Once we deal with the Giant Emperor and the rest of his forces, we can finally put an end to this war."
The Three Pillars of Heaven and countless backgrounds quickly came together, forming their most powerful and largest army yet to confront the Giant Emperor.
Shortly before the two sides clashed, a certain individual emerged from his seclusion.
"Tian Yang! You're finally out!" When Tian Yang emerged from his seclusion, the first person to greet him after a hundred thousand years was Jing Ruye.
Seeing the urgent expression on her face, Tian Yang immediately inquired about the situation.
"What happened?"
Jing Ruye wasted no time explaining everything to him.

"The situation is worse than I thought..." Tian Yang muttered, shaking his head at the news. He had expected the Giant Race to search their lands for the Absolute Power eventually, but he'd focused on cultivation—believing Sun Rouxi or Ren Xia would intervene if things ever grew dire.
"Where's Sun Rouxi and Ren Xia?" he asked her a moment later.

"They wanted to wait for you to finish your seclusion before acting, but they couldn't sit still after hearing that the Giant Emperor had appeared and left a month ago to gather information on him. I would've gone with them, but they insisted that I stay here just in case you returned."
Tian Yang rubbed his eyes and sighed, "These two idiots. Why didn't they just come and get me when the situation is this dire?"
"Actually, they tried... Several times, at that. However, there was an invisible force around your Immortal Cave that prevented them from approaching you," Jing Ruye explained.
"What?" Tian Yang was surprised to hear this, as he had no idea what could've caused such a phenomenon. Unfortunately, he didn't have the time to ponder about it.
"Where is Kulas now?" Tian Yang asked.
After Jing Ruye gave the location, he left his personal world and headed there at once with Jing Ruye following him since she no longer had a reason to stay behind.
2-3 chapters a day in March!

chapters.title: Chapter 2331 Joining the Fight Against the Giant Emperor
paragraphs: Somewhere in Divine Heaven, two massive armies faced off—one enormous in number, the other immense in size.
"Giant Emperor, your atrocities against us humans will end here!"
The person leading the human army shouted at the Giant Emperor who was leading an army of ten thousand giants.
"You'll stop me? With that pathetic army of yours?" Kulas laughed out loud, his voice full of disdain.
Suddenly four figures radiating overwhelming auras stepped forward to face Kulas—each a God Realm cultivator.
"There are four of us in the God Realm on our side, while you're the only one on your side. The outcome of this war is already decided," one of them said.
Kulas smiled calmly. "Four against one? If you'd had a few more, you might've stood a chance."
Kulas suddenly erupted with his hidden aura, flooding the area with a suffocating presence that instantly overwhelmed the four God Realm cultivators.
"T-This is—!"
"He's already achieved the second level of God Realm?! How is that possible?!"
When the humans realized Kulas's true cultivation, their confidence shattered and dread rippled through the ranks before the battle even began.
Deep frowns and grimaces contorted the four God Realm cultivators' faces, as if they'd just swallowed a live fly.
Kulas laughed loudly; his voice shook the air, splintering the nearby mountains—already weakened by his presence—into crumbling shards.
Meanwhile, two figures with concealed presences watched the situation unfold from afar.

"That son of a bitch has already broken into the second level! Even if Tian Yang emerges from seclusion now, he'll still be a step behind," Ren Xia said, clenching her fists in frustration as Kulas' presence washed over her.
"Even if we join the battle to help, I don't think we can beat him," Sun Rouxi said, frowning as she searched for a solution.
"Our only hope is that Tian Yang reaches the second level before the battle ends."

At the same time, the final battle between humanity and the Giant Race erupted. While the four God Realm cultivators concentrated on Kulas, the rest of the forces engaged the giant army—and in the blink of an eye tens of thousands of miles of land were laid waste.

The moment the battle erupted, dozens of heaven-splitting martial techniques converged on Kulas, who towered above the tallest nearby mountain. His skin, now a deep crimson, repelled the assaults effortlessly without so much as a scratch.

"Hahaha! It'd take almost no effort to kill you, but that'd be too boring, so let me enjoy this for a little bit!" Kulas laughed out loud as he treated the fight like it's nothing more than a casual game.
Meanwhile, the four God Realm cultivators fought with everything on the line. In their eyes, if they lost to Kulas, humanity would be doomed.
Time passed quickly, and in just three short days the humans had defeated over half of the giant army. Though they paid dearly, suffering hundreds of thousands of casualties.
Meanwhile, Kulas paid no mind to his dwindling forces, focusing instead on slowly wearing down the four God Realm cultivators, humiliating them with overwhelming prowess.
"I doubt the battle will last until the end of the week at this rate..." Sun Rouxi shook her head as she watched members from her own family being killed in action.
After a moment of silence, she continued.
"At this rate, the battle will end before Tian Yang even shows up." Sun Rouxi turned to look at Ren Xia and continued, "I want you to return home and see if you can wake up Tian Yang."
"What are you going to do?" Ren Xia asked even though she already had an idea.
"I am going to join the battle," she calmly responded.
Ren Xia didn't try to argue and nodded.
"I will wake him from his seclusion even if I have blow up his Immortal Cave."
After saying such words, Ren Xia turned around and flew away.
However, before she could really go anywhere, a massive crimson barrier suddenly materialized around the battlefield, preventing her from leaving.
"What the hell?!"
"Where do you think you're going?"
A loud voice resounded, causing Ren Xia to turn toward the sound, where Kulas was staring at her with a cold grin on his face.
"Kulas, you bastard!" Ren Xia growled with a frown on her face.
"Did you really think I wouldn't notice you watching from there? I was merely pretending that I didn't notice!" he laughed. "Where's Tian Yang?" Kulas then asked.
"Why do you care?"
"I have been purposefully delaying the war just to see what he'd do, but turns out I had wasted my time."
"If you want to see him that badly, let me go. I was about to fetch him before you intervened," Ren Xia said, silently hoping that Kulas would agree.
Kulas pondered for a moment before responding, "No. It will be more entertaining to meet him after I kill everyone here. However, I will keep you alive so I could torture you right in front of him."
"Is that so..." Ren Xia mumbled.
"I have always wanted to punch your annoying face, and this is the perfect opportunity!"
Realizing that she had no other option, Ren Xia withdrew her weapon and flew at Kulas.
Seeing this, Sun Rouxi also joined the battle.
The members of the Three Pillars of Heaven were shocked to see Sun Rouxi.
"Sun Rouxi! Where the hell have you been all these years?!" One of the four God Realm cultivators exclaimed with disbelief after seeing her.
"Save the talk for later!" Sun Rouxi shouted as she retrieved a treasure that took the shape of a golden wheel.
"Che!"
Thus, Ren Xia and Sun Rouxi joined the battle against Kulas.
"Hahaha! Things are finally getting entertaining!" Kulas smiled as he unleashed even more aura.
"Just how much more power is this monster hiding?!"
"I can't breathe!"
"H-Help m—"
Kulas' pressure was so overwhelming that every cultivator below the Immortal Realm had their hearts burst from the strain, instantly annihilating half of the army.

His skin, now a deep crimson, repelled the assaults effortlessly without so much as a scratch.
"Hahaha!
It'd take almost no effort to kill you, but that'd be too boring, so let me enjoy this for a little bit!" Kulas laughed out loud as he treated the fight like it's nothing more than a casual game.
Meanwhile, the four God Realm cultivators fought with everything on the line.
In their eyes, if they lost to Kulas, humanity would be doomed.
Time passed quickly, and in just three short days the humans had defeated over half of the giant army.
Though they paid dearly, suffering hundreds of thousands of casualties.
Meanwhile, Kulas paid no mind to his dwindling forces, focusing instead on slowly wearing down the four God Realm cultivators, humiliating them with overwhelming prowess.
"I doubt the battle will last until the end of the week at this rate..." Sun Rouxi shook her head as she watched members from her own family being killed in action.
After a moment of silence, she continued.
"At this rate, the battle will end before Tian Yang even shows up." Sun Rouxi turned to look at Ren Xia and continued, "I want you to return home and see if you can wake up Tian Yang."
"What are you going to do?" Ren Xia asked even though she already had an idea.
"I am going to join the battle," she calmly responded.
Ren Xia didn't try to argue and nodded.
"I will wake him from his seclusion even if I have blow up his Immortal Cave."
After saying such words, Ren Xia turned around and flew away.
However, before she could really go anywhere, a massive crimson barrier suddenly materialized around the battlefield, preventing her from leaving.
"What the hell?!"
"Where do you think you're going?"
A loud voice resounded, causing Ren Xia to turn toward the sound, where Kulas was staring at her with a cold grin on his face.
"Kulas, you bastard!" Ren Xia growled with a frown on her face.
"Did you really think I wouldn't notice you watching from there?
I was merely pretending that I didn't notice!" he laughed.
"Where's Tian Yang?" Kulas then asked.
"Why do you care?"
"I have been purposefully delaying the war just to see what he'd do, but turns out I had wasted my time."
"If you want to see him that badly, let me go.
I was about to fetch him before you intervened," Ren Xia said, silently hoping that Kulas would agree.
Kulas pondered for a moment before responding, "No.
It will be more entertaining to meet him after I kill everyone here.
However, I will keep you alive so I could torture you right in front of him."
"Is that so..." Ren Xia mumbled.
"I have always wanted to punch your annoying face, and this is the perfect opportunity!"
Realizing that she had no other option, Ren Xia withdrew her weapon and flew at Kulas.
Seeing this, Sun Rouxi also joined the battle.
The members of the Three Pillars of Heaven were shocked to see Sun Rouxi.
"Sun Rouxi!
Where the hell have you been all these years?!" One of the four God Realm cultivators exclaimed with disbelief after seeing her.
"Save the talk for later!" Sun Rouxi shouted as she retrieved a treasure that took the shape of a golden wheel.
"Che!"
Thus, Ren Xia and Sun Rouxi joined the battle against Kulas.
"Hahaha!
Things are finally getting entertaining!" Kulas smiled as he unleashed even more aura.
"Just how much more power is this monster hiding?!"
"I can't breathe!"
"H-Help m—"
Kulas' pressure was so overwhelming that every cultivator below the Immortal Realm had their hearts burst from the strain, instantly annihilating half of the army.

chapters.title: Chapter 2332 Joining the Fight Against the Giant Emperor(2)
paragraphs: With half of their forces killed in an instant, the human army was sent into a frenzy panic.
"He killed so many of us with just his presence alone!"
"I-It's over! That monster is too powerful!"
"Don't give up yet!" One of the four God Realm cultivators shouted at them, snapping them out of their panic.
"Hurry up and deal with the rest of the giants! We'll need as much help as we can get with the Giant Emperor!" said another God Realm cultivator.
While the army regained their composure and continued to deal with the rest of the giants, Ren Xia and the other God Realm experts focused on Kulas.

Ren Xia and Sun Rouxi were obviously much stronger than the other four God Realm experts, and it didn't take long for them to realize this fact. "Heavens! When did you achieve the God Realm?!" One of them couldn't help but ask Sun Rouxi.
"Who is that woman?! To think there'd be such a powerful expert out there this entire time!" Another questioned Ren Xia's identity.
"Are you bastards crazy?!" Sun Rouxi snapped at them. "This isn't the time for side conversations!"

Her words quickly snapped their minds back into order. However, even with the addition of Ren Xia and Sun Rouxi, the six of them were still struggling against Kulas. Moreover, they were certain that he was still hiding more power.
"Sun Rouxi, do you have any idea how we can defeat this monster?!" One of the four God Realm cultivators asked. "You're the smartest in our family, after all!"

"Why the hell are you asking me? What happened to the 'Enlightened One'? Why didn't you ask him, Father? I'm sure he could guide you to victory with his prophecies!" Sun Rouxi glared at the man, who turned out to be her father.

Her father, Sun Hongjia, gritted his teeth and responded, "We've tried, but he's been in a seclusion even before the war began. He's spoken with us a few times through letters, but he's never mentioned anything about the Giant Race or a war."

"Then why didn't you force him out of seclusion? Our entire world is at stake, you know?" "I'm sure this is also within his prophecies. If the situation is truly as grave as it seems, then he would've already appeared."
Sun Rouxi clenched her fists and gritted her teeth in frustration at her father's blind trust and faith in the Enlightened One.
'Even though so many years have passed, I see that you are still as foolish as before...' Sun Rouxi sighed inwardly.
"Unfortunately, I have no clue how we can defeat him," she shook her head a moment later.
"I know someone who might, but he's not here. If we can stall him long enough, perhaps..."
"You know someone who can defeat this monster when even the six of us combined cannot?! Who is this monster?!" Sun Hongjia exclaimed in a shocked voice.
Sun Rouxi had a strong urge to respond with 'my dao companion', but she managed to keep her control in check.

Time continued to pass, and at the end of the day, the human army managed to defeat the remaining giant army, allowing them to assist Sun Rouxi and the others. However, the pressure coming from Kulas' aura was so intense that the Immortals couldn't even approach without exhausting their spiritual energy to shield themselves from it.
It was at this point that the Immortals realized that they couldn't help even if they wanted to, and all they could do was watch from afar as their remaining hope slowly gets beaten down by Kulas.
"Tian Xianzhong!" Sun Hongjia exclaimed when Kulas suddenly landed a fatal blow on one of them.

Tian Xianzhong was sent flying away, only stopping when the Immortals went to stop his fall. "I-I am still alive... but... I don't think... I can... continue..." he muttered as he coughed up many mouthfuls of blood.
"One down!" Kulas laughed madly, attacking them with nothing but his bare fists—each blow obliterating everything for miles with just the sheer force coming from his punches.
After taking care of one, Kulas became more aggressive as he picked up his pace, quickly defeating the second... then a third.
After another half a day, only Ren Xia, Sun Rouxi, and Sun Hongjia remained.
And not before long, Sun Hongjia also retired from the battle after losing both of his arms when he had no choice but to block Kulas' attack directly with his body.
"And now, there are only two left..." Kulas smiled as he glared at Sun Rouxi and Ren Xia.
Although both of them were still in good shape and only suffered minor injuries up to this point, Kulas was completely fine in comparison, only sweating slightly, like he'd just finished a light jog.
Kulas' gaze suddenly halted on Sun Rouxi before asking in a curious voice, "What is your relationship with Tian Yang?"
"Why do you care?" she sneered.
"So I can decide whether I should just kill you now or save you for later, like that bitch. So, are you also another woman who ensnared my sworn brother?
Sun Rouxi hesitated to answer, as there were many members of the Three Pillars of Heaven present as witness, including her own father.
"I have no idea what you're talking about," Sun Rouxi eventually responded with a stiff smile.
If there was a chance that they survived this, she didn't want to entangle Tian Yang with her family's drama.
"In that case, you may die."
Kulas immediately attacked.
"Hey, are you seriously going to ignore me?!" Ren Xia cried out loud in disbelief when Kulas flew right past her and directly at Sun Rouxi.
With all of Kulas' attention directly on her, Sun Rouxi felt the battle had increased in difficulty tremendously, reaching a point where she could only focus on evading and nothing else.
Ren Xia didn't stop attacking Kulas, but he continued to ignore her, treating her as if she was just an insignificant fly that could be taken care of at will.

In just a mere hour, Sun Rouxi found herself on the verge of death, unable to retaliate. Had it not been for the life-saving treasures in her possession, she would've likely died several times already. "Stop your pointless struggle and die for me already!" Kulas roared as his aura intensified even more.
The sudden shift in pressure caught Sun Rouxi off guard for a heartbeat—and Kulas seized the moment, landing a crushing, direct punch.
Sun Rouxi's body—an ant before an elephant compared to Kulas's fist—was sent flying, leaving a streak of blood across the sky.
"Sun Rouxi!" Ren Xia exclaimed with fear in her voice.
As she rushed to check on Sun Rouxi, Kulas intercepted and blocked her path, a malicious grin on his face before his fist slammed into her.
Kulas purposefully held back, so Ren Xia managed to survive it. Unfortunately, both of her arms were broken at that moment.
"Now, how should I take care of you before Tian Yang arrives?" Kulas mumbled in a low voice.
Meanwhile, the rest of the army fell into despair after seeing Kula defeat their final hope.
"It's really over now..."
"There's nobody in this world who can stop him..."

chapters.title: Chapter 2333 Appearing Just in Time
paragraphs: Some time later, Kulas started to approach Ren Xia with a wide grin on his face.
"I'll just rip you limb from limb for now."
Kulas took several steps before suddenly halting his movements.
His head turned to look in a different direction from Ren Xia, and an excited grin appeared on his face as he exclaimed with exhilaration, "He's finally here!"
In the next moment, a powerful ripple appeared from afar, and the crimson barrier that had blocked their view shattered into countless fragments that poured from the sky like a crimson rain.
"KULAS!!!"
An enraged voice resounded the next moment as a silhouette appeared from the horizon, quickly closing in on them.
Before anyone could make out the silhouette's face, hundreds of swords materialized from thin air around Kulas and rained down upon him.
Kulas raised his arms in a defensive posture he had never used since the war began—then the blades struck, piercing his skin and drawing blood for the first time.
While the spectators were shocked by the scene of Kulas being injured, Ren Xia's gaze never left the silhouette even for a split second.
"You're late, you idiot..." she released a sigh of relief after seeing Tian Yang's face.
Tian Yang stopped right beside Ren Xia and asked, "Where's Rouxi?"
The smile on her face froze as her gaze shifted to where Sun Rouxi had crashed just seconds earlier.
"She's..."
But before she could finish her sentence, Tian Yang interrupted, "I can still sense her presence. Go to her. I'll take care of Kulas myself."
Ren Xia silently nodded before rushing to Sun Rouxi without hesitation.
Kulas didn't bother to stop Ren Xia this time, as his attention was now fully on Tian Yang.
"You'll take care of me? Even though you're still in the first level of the God Realm?" Kulas suddenly spoke with a smile on his face.
"..." Tian Yang didn't respond.
Indeed, his cultivation was still at the first level of God Realm. Ren Xia didn't notice simply because she was in no condition to pay attention to such details.
After a moment of silence, he calmly sighed, "Unfortunately, I was unable to advance to the next level. However, that's precisely why I managed to make it here in time to stop you."

Kulas tilted his head in a confused manner and spoke, "Even if you have arrived before I could torture your lover, I fail to see how you'll be able to stop me. That being said, even if you had advanced to the next level, you still wouldn't be able to defeat me."
Tian Yang went silent again. He knew Kulas was right—that even if he arrived, he would not beat him. Still, learning Sun Rouxi and Ren Xia were in danger left him unable to stand idly by.
"Hey, Kulas... No, Zaaran, I have a proposition for you."
"What?" Kulas raised his eyebrows.
"I know why you're doing all of this and what you're looking for. What if I tell you that I know where to find it?" Tian Yang said with a confident smile.
"Hahaha! And here I was wondering what nonsense you'd spew! What the hell do you know about me?!"
"Absolute Power." Tian Yang spoke with voice transmission so that the others wouldn't be able to hear it.
When Kulas heard the name, his laughing immediately stopped, and he glared at Tian Yang with a serious expression.
"How the hell do you know about that? Did the Eternal behind you tell you?" Kulas narrowed his eyes.
"Not only that, but I have already found it. If you back off for now, I'll tell you its location."

"Bullshit! If you truly had the Absolute Power in your possession, you wouldn't be here trying to bargain with me right now! Even if what you say is true, the Eternal behind you would never allow it! Why the hell are you trying to bargain with me when you can just hand it over to the one you're working for?"
"Because I don't trust him."
"And you trust me? Do you really believe that I'd fall for such an obvious lie?"
"No, I don't trust you either. In fact, I don't trust any Eternal. And since you're pretty much all the same in my eyes, I might as well bargain with someone who has what I want currently."
"Are you referring to that bitch? You're really going to give me the Absolute Power for a woman? I can easily destroy your world afterward with that power, you know?
"That's a risk I am willing to make."
After a moment of silence, Kulas asked, "What proof do you have that you know where to find the Absolute Power?"

"Do you remember what you said to me? That I had a power that weakened your influence? That wasn't a gift given to me by an Eternal. I have somehow acquired some of that power after coming into contact with the Absolute Power."
"That's—!!!" Kulas' eyes widened with shock after hearing such evidence.
Then, a massive grin tugged at his lips, one that reached from ear to ear.

"Very well! You've got a deal! If you lead me to the Absolute Power, I, Zaaran, will not only spare you and your partner, but I will even leave your world alone! However, the moment I sense any bullshit, I'll immediately kill you and everyone in this world."
Tian Yang nodded. "Give me a moment."
He went to Ren Xia's side, who was still feeding Sun Rouxi medicine. Jing Ruye, who purposefully waited before making an appearance, was also there, her eyes soaked in tears.
"How is she?" Tian Yang asked
"Her life isn't in danger, but she won't be able to move for some time."
Tian Yang nodded and then said, "I'm going to leave with Kulas for a bit. I'll return once everything is over."
"Alright. Make sure to explain everything once you're back," she calmly nodded.
Without another word, Tian Yang returned to Kulas and said, "Follow me."
In the blink of an eye, they both disappeared into the horizon, leaving everyone there puzzled and stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 2334 Sealing Kulas' Soul
paragraphs: After leaving the battlefield, Tian Yang led Zaaran east.
As they traveled, Tian Yang questioned, "If you're just looking for the Absolute Power, why are you doing all of this? Was there really a need to start a war with us?"
"The fastest and most efficient way to find the Absolute Power is to conquer the world and search every inch of it without delay," Zaaran calmly answered.
"Then why are you the only Eternal to make such drastic measures?" Tian Yang continued to ask.
"And how do you know that? I am certainly not the only Eternal with this idea. I am merely the first one to achieve it," he remarked with an arrogant smirk.
Tian Yang trembled at Zaaran's words that implied there were multiple Eternals attempting to conquer the Divine Heavens.
"However, once I acquire the Absolute Power, the other Eternals will lose interest in this world, so the faster you give it to me, the faster we'll leave you alone."
Tian Yang silently gritted his teeth at Zaaran's words that were very similar to what Shura told him.
A few days later, Tian Yang suddenly slowed down to a halt.
He turned around and faced Zaaran, who wore Kulas' face and asked, "I have one last question for you. Is Kulas still there?"
Zaaran remained silent for a good second before responding with a smile, "Of course, he's still alive. Otherwise, I wouldn't be able to make use of him."
"What about his consciousness? What will happen to him once you leave?"
"His consciousness will return, but I cannot guarantee you that he will return to the person he was before."
Tian Yang tightened his fists at such words even though this was something he'd already anticipated.
"Enough questions. How much longer before we reach the Absolute Power? If you are trying to delay this for whatever reason, I swear..."
"Relax, we're almost there."
Tian Yang turned around and continued to move.
A few more days later, Tian Yang stopped again.
"We're here," he announced in a calm voice.
Zaaran's eyes lit with excitement as he scanned the area. They were in the heart of a vast mountain range, surrounded by nothing but peaks and empty land.
Moments later, he frowned and spoke, "Where the hell is the Absolute Power? I cannot sense it!"
A subtle grin tugged at Tian Yang's lips as he spoke, "But it's right in front of you."
"What?!"

Zaaran used multiple techniques, even one only available for Eternals, but when he still failed to see the Absolute Power, he erupted with anger, instantly wiping away the nearby mountains with his explosive aura.
"You must be messing with me! How dare you try to make a fool out of me, you insignificant mortal!!!" Zaaran roared, releasing his entire cultivation base.
The pressure coming from Zaaran's aura was so immense that blood flowed from Tian Yang's eyes and nose. Yet, the smile on his face only became more prominent.
"What would I gain from lying to you?" Tian Yang calmly shook his head. "I am even willing to swear on my soul that it's here."
"Then why can I not see it?!" Zaaran rebuked.
"Why are you asking me, a mere mortal?" Tian Yang shrugged. "I do not believe you! This is your last chance to tell me the truth! Otherwise, I will kill you and everyone in this world!"
Tian Yang closed his eyes and sighed.
"I'll help you see it. However, your aura is too intense for me to even get close to you, so put it away," he said a moment later.
Zaaran hesitated for a brief moment but eventually listened and retrieved his aura.
Tian Yang slowly approached him.
"Now, close your eyes."
Zaaran didn't question it and closed his eyes.
"I will now help you see the Absolute Power."
Tian Yang placed a finger on Zaaran's forehead.
"Once I tell you, open your eyes."
One second... two second... three seconds.
"Okay, you can open your eyes now."
After ten seconds, Zaaran slowly opened his eyes with excitement.
"What...?"
But when he opened his eyes, the ruined mountains and desolate land were gone. Tian Yang was gone too, and Zaaran now found himself suspended in the starry sky... in his original body.
Zaaran was bewildered for a long moment before realizing that his connection to Kulas' body had been forcefully severed and that he had been fooled by Tian Yang.
"THAT FUCKING MORTAL!!!" Zaaran eurpted with rage, his fury sweeping the starry sky and extinguishing the flickering lights around him.
Meanwhile, Kulas' consciousness slowly returned after Zaaran was removed from his body.
"Tian Yang..." Kulas glared at him with a stiff smile. "How are you feeling?" Tian Yang asked.
"Fine... for now." Kulas sighed. "I don't know how you achieved this, but it's only tempeoraily. Even now, my body refuses to listen to me."
"I know..."
A moment later, Kulas' body started shrinking until he was the size of a human again.
Then, with stiff movements, Kulas extended his arms and gave Tian Yang a manly hug.
"It's a miracle that I get to have this brief moment with you. Now, kill me before he regains control and wreck havoc in this world."
Kulas released Tian Yang and tilted his head, offering his neck.
Tian Yang silently nodded his head and raised his sword.
"See you in my next life, brother." Kulas smiled.
Tian Yang's arms trembled, and hesitation flashed in his eyes.
However, when he saw that Kulas' eyes were beginning to turn crimson again, Tian Yang tightened his grip on the sword and shouted, "Until next time, brother!"
The next instant, a sword arc streaked through the sky, slashing across Kulas' neck.
The cut was so swift and precise it seemed Kulas' head remained attached, but in reality, he was decapitated.
However, Kulas didn't immediately die because of his powerful cultivation, and Zaaran regained control the next second.

"Don't think you've won just because you destroyed this mortal's body, you bastard!" Zaaran roared. "As long as his soul is unharmed, I can just create another vessel and walk this earth again! You can destroy his soul, but that will permamently remove him from this world and erase any chance of him being able to reincarnate! Moreover, I can always find another vessel to control! You will never win againgst me!"
"Shut up!" Tian Yang shouted as he plunged his sword into Kulas' heart.
"I don't care how long it takes. I swear I will get rid of a parasite like you!"
With both the head and heart destroyed, Zaaran could no longer control Kulas' body.
However, a moment later, Tian Yang could see Kulas' soul escaping from the corpse and attempting to escape.
Many thoughts flashed inside Tian Yang's head at that moment.
Suddenly, he retrieved a treasure from his spatial ring and used it to contain Kulas' soul, preventing it from going anywhere.
"Luckily, we didn't sell all of the Immortal Clans' treasures and kept a few useful ones to ourselves..." Tian Yang mumbled.
"Sorry for imprisoning you like this, Kulas, but this is neccassry. I hope for your understanding, and I will definitely free you from that parasite one day."
Some time later, Tian Yang returned to his world, where the others were waiting for him.

chapters.title: Chapter 2335 Arriving at the Holy Continent
paragraphs: "Tian Yang! You're safe!" Ren Xia leaped into his embrace the moment she noticed him entering their personal world.
Tian Yang quickly spread his arms to catch her, who immediately started kissing him.
"What happened to Kulas?" Ren Xia asked a moment later, her arms still wrapped around his neck.
"I killed him... sort of..." Tian Yang sighed.

He retrieved the treasure he used to seal Kulas' soul and explained the situation, "After destroying Kulas' body, his soul attempted to escape, so I sealed it inside this treasure. If I hadn't done so, Zaaran would've created another vessel for Kulas' soul and returned to wreaking havoc again."

"Does that mean a cultivator at the God Realm cannot die without their soul being destroyed? That we can replace our physical body endlessly?" Ren Xia muttered with a dumbfounded face. "Or is it because Kulas' soul is being influenced by an Eternal that makes it possible?"
Tian Yang shook his head and said, "There's still a lot we don't know about the God Realm, but things should become clearer as time passes."
He looked around and asked, "By the way, where's Rouxi?"
Ren Xia rubbed her eyes and released a soft sigh before responding, "She went back with her family."
Tian Yang raised an eyebrow and asked, "Did she choose to go back with them, or..."

"No, her father brought her back. I wanted to protest, but her injuries were more serious than I initially thought, and I was in no condition to stop them from taking her away. Jing Ruye also went back with her."
"I understand." Tian Yang calmly nodded.
"You're a lot calmer than I expected you would be. What if she never returns?" Ren Xia asked.
"If she doesn't return, I'll just go to her. I have always wanted to visit the Holy Continent, anyway."
"I see... What are you going to do now?" she then asked.
"I am going to visit Xie Mey and the others first. After that, I'll continue my cultivation and hopefully advance to the next level."
"Okay."
Tian Yang left the world for several months before returning and entering seclusion.
Time passed swiftly, and in the blink of an eye, a hundred years have passed since the war with the Giant Race concluded.
After the war, the world united to repair the devastation. For decades it enjoyed an unprecedented peace—until disturbances began to stir once more.
However, the disturbance lurked in the shadows, unknown to most of the world for a long time. Eventually it could no longer be contained, and it engulfed countless families across the world.
When Tian Yang emerged from his seclusion after five hundred years, he asked Ren Xia, "Any news from Rouxi?"
"No, but her family's in the spotlight again."
"What is happening this time?"
"The Three Pillars of Heaven are trying to conquer the world," Ren Xia calmly responded.
"Excuse me?" Tian Yang's eyes widened at her words, not daring to believe his ears for a moment.

"I mean, they're trying to take advantage of their position as the leader of the alliance during the war. Even though the war has ended, the Three Pillars of Heaven still want the alliance to continue with them as the leader, and with how many families and sects are involved in this alliance, it would make them the most powerful family in the world, essentially turning them into the emperor of this world," she elaborated.

Tian Yang rubbed his eyes and sighed, "The Three Pillars of Heaven have always been the most powerful family in the world. But their power and influence were still limited. However, all of that would change if they had the backing of the majority of backgrounds in the world. What is the others' reaction to this?"

"Well, half of them have already sided with the Three Pillars of Heaven and agreed to serve them, and that number is still growing. Even with half of them, the Three Pillars of Heaven is already powerful enough to rule this world."

Tian Yang then asked, "Why would they agree to serve the Three Pillars of Heaven? Most wouldn't agree to such a thing even if forced. Did the Three Pillars of Heaven offer them something in exchange for their loyalty?"
"Most likely, but they didn't and wouldn't reveal something like that, so the public has no way of knowing."

Tian Yang pondered for a moment before revealing, "The Enlightened One, who is being influenced by an Eternal, is likely involved with this. Now that Zaaran's invasion has been stopped, another Eternal must be trying to do the same thing."
"Is there anything we can do?" Ren Xia asked.
He shook his head.
"Not right now."
"Let's just hope it doesn't lead to another war..." Ren Xia sighed.
Tian Yang proceeded to spend several years preparing for his visit to the Holy Continent.
"I will be going to the Holy Continent now," he said to Ren Xia once he was prepared.
"Are you sure you don't want me to come with you?"
He nodded.
"Knowing that another Eternal is active, I don't want you to even get close to the Holy Continent... at least until I know what we're dealing with."
Ren Xia knew better than to argue with Tian Yang on this matter by now and quickly gave up on trying to convince him.
"Be safe," she said right as he left the world.
After leaving, Tian Yang traveled directly to the Holy Continent—a place once off-limits but now open to virtually anyone.
"So, this is the Holy Continent, huh? The spiritual energy in this place is ridiculously rich and dense. It's no wonder they made this place their territory."
Tian Yang closed his eyes and took a deep breath.
He opened his eyes a moment later and started looking around with a confused face.
"What the...?"
He began moving his limbs around as if testing them.
It took a moment, but clarity eventually hit him.
"So, this is where the real trial begins, huh?" Yuan muttered after regaining control of his body after reliving Tian Yang's life for hundreds of thousands of years.

chapters.title: Chapter 2336 The Real Beginning of the Unique Trial
paragraphs: After regaining control over his body, Yuan took a moment to ponder his situation and analyze the current condition of his body.

It didn't take long before Yuan realized that he was unable to utilize any skills that did not belong to his current body. For example, he was unable to use God of War's Astral Arts since it was not something Tian Yang learned. This also meant that he was not in his real body but one that was created by the trial.
'So, I have taken over Tian Yang's body, and I am only able to use techniques that he could use...'
Once he understood this, Yuan used his divine sense to scan the Holy Continent.
'As I thought, it's quite weak...'

Despite being at the second level of God Ascension, Tian Yang's soul strength was nowhere near Yuan's level while being a mere Immortal, not to mention how long Tian Yang had cultivated Heaven's Indomitable Soul.
'Tian Yang may have been the first to refine Heaven's Indomitable Soul, but he wasn't the last.'

As someone who learned the most recent Heaven's Indomitable Soul, Yuan could tell that the soul cultivation technique had been refined several more times after Tian Yang's era, hence why his soul strength surpassed Tian Yang despite only having it for a few decades.
Some time later, Yuan made his way to the nearest—and only—city on the Holy Continent: the Heavenly City.

The Heavenly City sprawled over ten thousand miles, making it one of the largest cities in the world. It was so vast that most of its residents were cultivators, and the few mortals who lived there were wealthy merchants who could afford the mini-teleportation formations scattered throughout the city.

In this era the Holy Continent was called the Cultivators' Paradise for its rich, abundant spiritual energy—an environment tailor-made for cultivation. But it wasn't open to everyone, as only those who pledged allegiance to the Three Pillars of Heaven were permitted to enjoy it.

However, since there wasn't any barrier that prevented people from entering, many cultivators would sneak onto its land to cultivate. Of course, if they were caught, they would be executed on the spot.
Upon arriving at the Heavenly City, Yuan was stopped by the guards at the gate.
"Where is your Heavenly Medallion?" asked one of the guards as he inspected Yuan from head to toe.

Another guard proceeded to explain, "You're supposed to have it on your body and visible to the naked eye at all times while you're in the Holy Continent, or you could be mistaken as an invader and killed on the spot."
Yuan shook his head and said, "I don't have one. Where can I get one?"
The guards immediately frowned.
"What the hell? So you're an invader!" They immediately pointed their weapons at him.
Yuan calmly raised his arms and spoke, "Was I supposed to request permission to enter this place before coming here? I wasn't aware of that.
"Identify yourself!"
"Yu—Tian Yang."
"What? Did you just say Tian Yang?"
The guards visibly trembled after hearing his name.
"That's right. You know me?"
"O-Of course! However, we'll need some proof that you're Tian Yang!"
"Evidence, huh?"
Yuan pondered for a moment before releasing some of his aura.
"T-This aura! The God Realm!"

Once the guards recognized Yuan's cultivation, his identity ceased to matter. With fewer than ten God Ascension cultivators in existence, each one commanded immense respect and veneration from everyone, and the Three Pillars of Heaven granted them special permission to enter the Holy Continent.
"Please forgive us for being unable to recognize you, Senior Tian!"
The guards immediately lowered their weapons and bodies to bow to him.
"Please, take my Heavenly Medallion!"
One of the guards even handed his own Heavenly Medallion to Yuan.
Yuan accepted the medallion and asked, "Where can I find the Three Pillars of Heaven?"

"Normally, you'd need to send an audience request and wait in the city for your turn, which could take months if not years. With that being said, the Three Pillars of Heaven have already granted you special permission to visit their estate at your convenience," said one of the guards.
"After all, you're the hero who defeated the Giant Emperor and saved humanity."
Tian Yang had never announced to the world that he defeated Kulas. However, the news was still spread somehow.
"Is that so? Then where do I go to meet them?" Yuan then asked.
"I can guide you there," said the guard who handed his own Heavenly Medallion to Yuan.
"Alright."
After signing out of his post, the guard left the city and led Yuan toward the Three Pillars of Heaven.

"If you don't mind me asking, how did you defeat the Giant Emperor? Was there a trick to it? I heard that not even six God Realm Cultivators working together were able to hurt him, much less stop him."
"I am much stronger than them. That's all there is to it," Yuan calmly replied.
"Is that so... Anyway, I am forever grateful to you for defeating the Giant Emperor. If you hadn't stopped him, he would've likely pushed all of us to extinction."
The guard continued to lick Yuan's boots for several hours until he realized that Yuan had stopped responding long ago.
Eventually, they arrived at their destination.
"We have arrived at the Three Pillars of Heaven's estate, the Heavenly Manor. Please wait here for a moment while I announce your presence."
The guard bowed to Yuan before rushing past the group of individuals waiting outside before disappearing inside.
Yuan gave the group a glance before ignoring them to focus on the massive estate in front of him.
'This place reeks of them...' Yuan shook his head inwardly.
Although he may not be able to use his techniques, his senses were left untouched, so he could still sense Eternal Essence, which enveloped the entire place like a blanket.
Several minutes later, the guard returned with someone by his side—a handsome middle-aged man wearing red robes.
When the group beside Yuan saw the man, they immediately bowed.
"We greet Patriarch Sun!"
