chapters.title: Chapter 2348 Stairway to Heaven's Sudden Disappearance
paragraphs: "W-What did you just say? The Stairway to Heaven has vanished into thin air?"
The Celestial Emperor glared at the messenger with a deep frown on his face.
"When did this happen? And do we have any idea why it happened?" he quickly asked.

"It happened only four days ago," said the messenger. "According to rumors, someone was attacking the Stairway to Heaven before its disappearance, and it wasn't just a single individual. Apparently, there was a witness at every single realm from the First Heaven to the Ninth Heaven, implying it was a coordinated attack."

The messenger continued, "There were also many casualties at the Stairway to Heaven's location. We believe they were all killed by these individuals to keep their identity hidden. Unfortunately, we do not know of their motives at this moment."

The Celestial Emperor pondered for a moment before speaking out loud to himself, "The Stairway to Heaven isn't any ordinary treasure. It's not the first time someone has attacked it, either. Yet, this is the first time it reacted in such a fashion, meaning that these individuals were not ordinary cultivators."
After a moment of silence, he gave a clear command.

"Find out who these individuals are and their motives. With the Stairway to Heaven gone, transportation between the realms will essentially become impossible for most people, and we have no idea when the Stairway to Heaven will return—if it ever will. What a troublesome situation..."
"What should we do if the Stairway to Heaven never returns?" The messenger swallowed nervously at this possibility before asking in a trembling voice.
"We'll have to replace it with something similar," he said.

"The Stairway to Heaven was created many eras ago. Nowadays, there are master blacksmiths who are capable of creating something similar, so it's not completely hopeless. I'll give it a few years to return before we make a new one."
Some time later, the Celestial Emperor made a public announcement, reassuring the world that he would get to the bottom of the situation and replace the Stairway to Heaven if necessary.

Though the Celestial Emperor succeeded in calming the people, it did little to truly ease the situation or resolve the problem. The Stairway to Heaven was still missing, and replacing it could take decades—an unbearably long time for those living in the lower heavens.

Meanwhile, after leaving the Stairway to Heaven, Yuan found himself standing in a vast green plain. Two solitary buildings stood only several meters apart, the only structures in sight. Above him, the sky was a clear blue, and the spiritual energy in the area was unfathomably rich—so dense that it made even the Eighth Heaven's spiritual energy seem pale by comparison.
"This is... my personal world.

Yuan immediately recognized the location, as he'd spent tens of thousands of years in this place just recently. "This place looks exactly as I remember..." Yuan muttered, somewhat surprised by how little had changed. "Anyway, let's get to work."
He immediately retrieved the sword-shaped token given to him by Xiao Cangming, which was entrusted to him by the Immortal Monarch.
"What's that?" Kulas asked out of curiosity.

"The key to my storage in this place, which happens to contain countless treasures that I have gathered throughout many lifetimes. Hopefully, I already have enough materials to craft your new vessel."
"Huh? Why do you need a key to a storage that's within your personal world? It's not like anyone can enter here."

"I don't know," Yuan replied with a nonchalant shrug. "In fact, I don't even remember where I hid the entrance to this place. Fortunately, I remember that I can access this place directly through the Stairway to Heaven."
"How can you forget the entrance to your own world?" Kulas would shake his head if he had one right now.
"Then do you know where it's located? You should know since your soul followed my precious incarnations around."
"Nope. It's not like I am constantly conscious during that time, as I would slumber from time to time, and you tossed me inside the Stairway to Heaven once it was completed."
"Is that so?"
Yuan entered one of the two buildings shortly after and went directly to the basement.
However, before he could even access the basement, he had to deal with the formations that protected it.
Fortunately, these formations recognized his soul and allowed him to bypass them without any issues.
"You'll have to wait here," Yuan stopped Kulas, who attempted to follow him.
"Since these formations only recognize Ren Xia and me, your soul will be obliterated if you try to enter."

"What the hell?! You should've told me that before you even approached this place! To think I almost died just now! Can you imagine how humiliating it would be to perish in such a fashion after surviving so many ordeals?!" Kulas exclaimed, hastily backing away from the door to the basement.
"Are there any more death traps in this place that I should be aware of?" he then asked.
"Not that I remember."
"That's not good enough! I'll wait for you outside just in case." Kulas sighed as he left the house altogether.
"What about me...?" Yu Ning, who was residing within his Dantian, asked in a worried voice.
"You'll be fine."
Moments later, Yuan began descending the staircase to the basement. The path downward seemed endless, the steps stretching as far as the eye could see—reminiscent of the Stairway to Heaven itself.

Eventually, they reached a point where the walls vanished entirely, leaving behind nothing but a pitch-black expanse, as though they had stepped into the void. Yet despite the darkness, Yuan could still see where he was walking.

The steps suddenly began to split into multiple paths like branches on a tree, clearly trying to mislead him. However, with the sword-shaped token in his grasp, Yuan was able to discern the true path.
After what felt like an eternity, Yuan finally reached the end of the path, greeted by a lone golden door that exuded a profound radiance, illuminating the surrounding darkness.

chapters.title: Chapter 2349 Crafting Yu Ning's Vessel
paragraphs: Upon reaching the golden door, Yuan inserted the sword-shaped key into the lone keyhole. As expected, it fit perfectly.
The moment the door opened, a profound ripple swept through the darkness, transforming the void into a massive chamber filled with treasures.
The storage room was unimaginably massive, resembling a limitless space with no visible walls, filled with a sea of treasures that extended beyond sight.
"This is... a lot more than I anticipated..." Yuan's eyes widened at the sight, his jaw slightly loose from shock.
"Heavens... I've never seen so many treasures gathered in one place before!" Yu Ning exclaimed, hardly daring to believe her eyes.
"This is the first time the phrase 'sea of treasures' truly feels appropriate."
There were so many treasures that they formed the very ground beneath Yuan's feet.
"Rather than worrying about not having enough materials, I'm now more concerned about finding them," Yuan sighed. "Let's hope it doesn't take too long."

However, just as he was about to scour the storage with his divine sense, information about every single treasure abruptly flooded his mind—much like when he became the master of the Nameless Tomb and could view all of its contents through the system.
A smile immediately tugged at Yuan's lips, and he said with enthusiasm, "Not only will I be able to craft Kulas a new vessel, but I'll also be able to craft yours, Yu Ning."
"Eh?"
Yu Ning's mind blanked out for a brief moment after hearing Yuan's words. She's been so accustomed to and comfortable living inside his Dantian that she completely forgot about their promise.
"Honestly, I wouldn't mind living inside your Dantian as nothing but a soul forever," she chuckled.
"That's a little..."
"It's just a joke."
Although he had a list of all of the treasures, Yuan still needed to choose which ones to use for their vessels, and that alone took several days.
Eventually, Yuan acquired all of the materials needed to craft not two but three vessels.
"Can't forget about Ji Ran," he mumbled as he tossed the materials into his spatial ring.
"What are you going to do with the rest of these treasures?" Yu Ning then asked.
"It's not like I can take them all with me. And even if I could, I doubt I'll use most of them in my lifetime. If I ever need something, I can simply return here for them," he said.
"That said, I'll take a few treasures that might come in handy soon." Of course, he didn't forget about Xiao Hua and the others, selecting several treasures he believed would benefit them as well.
Once he was done, he left the storage room and retrieved the sword-shaped key.
"Believe it or not, this is not the only stash I have," Yuan suddenly said. "In fact, this is where most of the trash is kept."
"Seriously?" Yu Ning was speechless.
Some time later, Yuan returned to Kulas' side.

"I have the materials to craft your vessel, but I'll need some time to master the technique I'll be using to craft them and practice inside my head. Also, I'll craft your vessel last since it's going to be the most difficult out of the three."
"You're going to craft three vessels? What are you going to do with the other two?" Kulas asked.
Yuan gave a brief explanation, telling him about Yu Ning and Ji Ran.
"I see. Well, take your time."
Yuan nodded and immediately went to work.

First, he retrieved a particular technique he had acquired from the storage—a method for crafting vessels. Although he could imitate what Xiao Cangming had done when creating Xiao Hua's vessel, that approach was outdated, and attempting to replicate such a technique carried far too much risk.
Now that he possessed a more advanced technique—one he could properly study and master—there was no reason to rely on Xiao Cangming's method.
A few hours later—
<You have learned Karmic Vessel Creation Scripture>
<Karmic Vessel Creation Scripture>
<Rank: Supreme>
<Description: A unique technique created by the 7th Sect Leader of the Karmic Soul Sect, who was said to have crafted the perfect vessel using it.>
Although learning the technique took only a few hours, mastering it was a different story, and it took Yuan an entire week.
<Your comprehension of Karmic Vessel Creation Scripture has reached max level>

Once he had mastered the technique, Yuan began running simulations in his mind, crafting vessels within his thoughts just as he once forged treasures mentally as Tian Qiyuan, the Divine Blacksmith, before working on the real thing.
Naturally, this process took far longer than mastering the technique itself. Striving for perfection, Yuan lost track of time, and in the blink of an eye, half a year had passed.
"Okay, I am ready." Yuan declared as he emerged from his training.
"I'll craft your vessel first, Yu Ning."
He immediately retrieved the necessary materials and began working with flawless precision, his movements so practiced that it was as though he had done it millions of times before.
Unlike Xiao Cangming's method, Yuan didn't require a cauldron. In addition to alchemical flames, he employed array symbols and intricate formations to further temper and refine the vessel.

Although the technique was far more advanced, it was also significantly more difficult to employ and demanded much more time. In the end, it took Yuan nearly two weeks to complete Yu Ning's vessel, which took the form of a peerless marble.
"Your new vessel is ready, Yu Ning. You'll need to complete the rest yourself."
"Okay."
Without hesitation, Yu Ning left his Dantian and entered her new vessel.
In the next instant, the marble trembled violently and began to expand, limbs rapidly forming as the vessel took shape.
Within moments, the fist-sized marble transformed into a peerless jadelike beauty with large breasts and round buttocks.
"What do you think?" Yuan asked. "If you don't like it, I can make you another one."
Yu Ning looked at him with her large emerald eyes. Then, without warning, she leaped forward with her arms wide open and wrapped him in a tight embrace.
"I love it!" she said, her voice brimming with joy.

chapters.title: Chapter 2350 Crafting Kulas a New Vessel
paragraphs: After holding Yuan for a full minute—still completely naked—Yu Ning finally released him and said in amazement, "I can't believe how natural this feels. I don't think even my original body was this comfortable."
"That's good to hear, but since it's still new, it'll take some time before you adjust to it and experience everything it has to offer. In the meantime, I'll go get you some clothes..."
Yuan quickly disappeared back inside his house and sifted through Ren Xia's closet to acquire some clothes for Yu Ning.
When he returned outside with her clothes, Yuan noticed that Yu Ning's cultivation had entered the God Ascension realm.

"Look!" she exclaimed with excitement. "My cultivation, which had weakened to the Golden Immortal realm after spending too much time without a physical body, has returned to the God Ascension realm! And I haven't even started cultivating yet! This vessel is truly amazing!"
Yuan hastily handed the clothes to her, who was too much from excitement, and said, "Looks like the vessel is working as intended. Anyway, put these on."
Yu Ning dressed herself unhurriedly, each motion subtly enhancing her beauty.
"How do I look?" she asked with a smile, turning in a graceful circle as her long brown hair danced in the wind.
"So this is what it takes to receive the title Ethereal Immortal Fairy, huh?" Yuan said with a smile.
"I think I look even better than before," she chuckled.
"Are you two done flirting? I am dying to move around with a body," Kulas sighed.
"I still have one more vessel to complete before I work on yours," said Yuan.
Suddenly, Yu Ning lowered herself onto the ground and kneeled before Yuan.
"What are you doing?" he asked with a raised eyebrow.
"I would like to pledge my loyalty to you once again," Yu Ning replied with her head lowered, her voice calm. Yet, if Yuan could see her face, he'd see a layer of tears in her eyes.

"My name is Yu Ning, a Level Seven Array Master. Though my abilities may still be lacking, I ask that you allow me to serve you for the rest of my life. From this moment onward, my skills, my body, and my life all belong to you," Yu Ning swore with unwavering resolve.

Yuan then asked, "Are you sure you want to follow me now? You've just regained your freedom after spending countless years in the Shadow Realm—without a physical body, no less. I wouldn't mind if you took some time to enjoy your new life first. You can always find me in the future. It's not like there is a time limit on these sorts of things, after all.
"Even if you say that, I'm not sure what I want to do, and just wandering the world seems... pointless. Other than improving my skills as an Array Master, I don't know what else to do."
"Think about it for now. I'll need at least another half a year to finish Kulas' vessel, so you have plenty of time," said Yuan.
She nodded.

"I understand." Yuan immediately began working on Ji Ran's vessel. Since he planned to make Ji Ran's vessel similar to Yu Ning's, he only spent a few days practicing in his mind before doing it for real.

Soon after, Ji Ran's vessel was completed. However, since Ji Ran was not present, Yuan sealed the vessel inside a special container to preserve it. Vessels were similar to pills in nature, and if left exposed for too long, their efficacy would slowly deteriorate.
"Finally, it's my turn!" Kulas laughed with excitement.
However, his excitement quickly died down after hearing Yuan's following words.

"Since you're a body refiner, I'll need to craft a vessel durable enough to withstand your cultivation technique. That won't be easy—even for me—and the materials themselves will be difficult to work with."
"So... how long do you think it'll take?" Kulas then asked.
"Who knows? I'll let you know once I practice a few times."
Without another word, Yuan sat down and began his mental simulations.
A few weeks later, Yuan opened his eyes and said, "I'll probably finish within five years."
"Five years?!" Kulas exclaimed.

Yuan frowned and said, "I can rush the process and finish it within a year. However, are you sure you want me to half-ass your new vessel? If it breaks down unexpectedly, I won't make another one for you."
"I wasn't trying to rush you... Take as much time as you need," he responded with a defeated sigh.
"Good, then I'll begin... with more practice."
Yuan closed his eyes again and returned to practicing inside his head.
Meanwhile, Yu Ning spent her time acclimating to her new vessel through exercises and ordinary martial arts. With each passing day, her amazement at the capabilities of her new body only grew.
"Not only does this body absorb spiritual energy with incredible efficiency, but cultivation feels almost effortless," she muttered in amazement. "It's like waking up one day with brand-new talents!"
Time slipped away unnoticed, and before Yuan realized it, three more months had passed since he started his mental practice.
"I am going to start the real deal now," he suddenly announced as he stood up and retrieved the materials he needed for Kulas' vessel.
"About time!"
After taking a deep breath, Yuan started working on the materials. However, preparing just one required immense focus and time, and there was a mountain of materials before him.
In the blink of an eye, two whole weeks passed, and Yuan just finished working on the first material.
Yet, he didn't stop to take a break and immediately started on the next material.
One month... sixth months... a year...
For two whole years, Yuan moved without stopping, his speed and skills improving with every material.
In the end, it took nearly three years for Yuan to prepare all the materials. Now, he had to craft the vessel.
"I am actually ahead of schedule," he said.
"You should take a break," Kulas suggested.
Yuan shook his head and said, "Unfortunately, the materials won't wait for me, so I'll have to continue."
